But where the greater malady is fix'd,
The lesser is scarce felt. Thou'ldst shun a bear;
But if thy flight lay toward the raging sea,
Thou'ldst meet the bear i' the mouth. When the
mind's free,
The body's delicate: the tempest in my mind
Doth from my senses take all feeling else
Save what beats there. Filial ingratitude!
Is it not as this mouth should tear this hand
For lifting food to't? But I will punish home:
No, I will weep no more. In such a night
To shut me out! Pour on; I will endure.
In such a night as this! O Regan, Goneril!
Your old kind father, whose frank heart gave all,--
O, that way madness lies; let me shun that;
No more of that.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Good my lord, enter here.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Prithee, go in thyself: seek thine own ease:
This tempest will not give me leave to ponder
On things would hurt me more. But I'll go in.
In, boy; go first. You houseless poverty,--
Nay, get thee in. I'll pray, and then I'll sleep.
Poor naked wretches, whereso'er you are,
That bide the pelting of this pitiless storm,
How shall your houseless heads and unfed sides,
Your loop'd and window'd raggedness, defend you
From seasons such as these? O, I have ta'en
Too little care of this! Take physic, pomp;
Expose thyself to feel what wretches feel,
That thou mayst shake the superflux to them,
And show the heavens more just.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Within Fathom and half, fathom and half! Poor Tom!

SCENE.STAGEDIR: The Fool runs out from the hovel

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Fool
SPEECH.LINE: Come not in here, nuncle, here's a spirit
Help me, help me!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Give me thy hand. Who's there?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Fool
SPEECH.LINE: A spirit, a spirit: he says his name's poor Tom.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: What art thou that dost grumble there i' the straw?
Come forth.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter EDGAR disguised as a mad man

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Away! the foul fiend follows me!
Through the sharp hawthorn blows the cold wind.
Hum! go to thy cold bed, and warm thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Hast thou given all to thy two daughters?
And art thou come to this?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Who gives any thing to poor Tom? whom the foul
fiend hath led through fire and through flame, and
through ford and whirlipool e'er bog and quagmire;
that hath laid knives under his pillow, and halters
in his pew; set ratsbane by his porridge; made film
proud of heart, to ride on a bay trotting-horse over
four-inched bridges, to course his own shadow for a
traitor. Bless thy five wits! Tom's a-cold,--O, do
de, do de, do de. Bless thee from whirlwinds,
star-blasting, and taking! Do poor Tom some
charity, whom the foul fiend vexes: there could I
have him now,--and there,--and there again, and there.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: What, have his daughters brought him to this pass?
Couldst thou save nothing? Didst thou give them all?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Fool
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, he reserved a blanket, else we had been all shamed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Now, all the plagues that in the pendulous air
Hang fated o'er men's faults light on thy daughters!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: He hath no daughters, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Death, traitor! nothing could have subdued nature
To such a lowness but his unkind daughters.
Is it the fashion, that discarded fathers
Should have thus little mercy on their flesh?
Judicious punishment! 'twas this flesh begot
Those pelican daughters.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Pillicock sat on Pillicock-hill:
Halloo, halloo, loo, loo!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Fool
SPEECH.LINE: This cold night will turn us all to fools and madmen.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Take heed o' the foul fiend: obey thy parents;
keep thy word justly; swear not; commit not with
man's sworn spouse; set not thy sweet heart on proud
array. Tom's a-cold.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: What hast thou been?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: A serving-man, proud in heart and mind; that curled
my hair; wore gloves in my cap; served the lust of
my mistress' heart, and did the act of darkness with
her; swore as many oaths as I spake words, and
broke them in the sweet face of heaven: one that
slept in the contriving of lust, and waked to do it:
wine loved I deeply, dice dearly: and in woman
out-paramoured the Turk: false of heart, light of
ear, bloody of hand; hog in sloth, fox in stealth,
wolf in greediness, dog in madness, lion in prey.
Let not the creaking of shoes nor the rustling of
silks betray thy poor heart to woman: keep thy foot
out of brothels, thy hand out of plackets, thy pen
from lenders' books, and defy the foul fiend.
Still through the hawthorn blows the cold wind:
Says suum, mun, ha, no, nonny.
Dolphin my boy, my boy, sessa! let him trot by.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Why, thou wert better in thy grave than to answer
with thy uncovered body this extremity of the skies.
Is man no more than this? Consider him well. Thou
owest the worm no silk, the beast no hide, the sheep
no wool, the cat no perfume. Ha! here's three on
's are sophisticated! Thou art the thing itself:
unaccommodated man is no more but such a poor bare,
forked animal as thou art. Off, off, you lendings!
come unbutton here.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Fool
SPEECH.LINE: Prithee, nuncle, be contented; 'tis a naughty night
to swim in. Now a little fire in a wild field were
like an old lecher's heart; a small spark, all the
rest on's body cold. Look, here comes a walking fire.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: This is the foul fiend Flibbertigibbet: he begins
at curfew, and walks till the first cock; he gives
the web and the pin, squints the eye, and makes the
hare-lip; mildews the white wheat, and hurts the
poor creature of earth.
S. Withold footed thrice the old;
He met the night-mare, and her nine-fold;
Bid her alight,
And her troth plight,
And, aroint thee, witch, aroint thee!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: How fares your grace?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: What's he?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Who's there? What is't you seek?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: What are you there? Your names?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Poor Tom; that eats the swimming frog, the toad,
the tadpole, the wall-newt and the water; that in
the fury of his heart, when the foul fiend rages,
eats cow-dung for sallets; swallows the old rat and
the ditch-dog; drinks the green mantle of the
standing pool; who is whipped from tithing to
tithing, and stock- punished, and imprisoned; who
hath had three suits to his back, six shirts to his
body, horse to ride, and weapon to wear;
But mice and rats, and such small deer,
Have been Tom's food for seven long year.
Beware my follower. Peace, Smulkin; peace, thou fiend!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: What, hath your grace no better company?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: The prince of darkness is a gentleman:
Modo he's call'd, and Mahu.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Our flesh and blood is grown so vile, my lord,
That it doth hate what gets it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Poor Tom's a-cold.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Go in with me: my duty cannot suffer
To obey in all your daughters' hard commands:
Though their injunction be to bar my doors,
And let this tyrannous night take hold upon you,
Yet have I ventured to come seek you out,
And bring you where both fire and food is ready.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: First let me talk with this philosopher.
What is the cause of thunder?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Good my lord, take his offer; go into the house.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: I'll talk a word with this same learned Theban.
What is your study?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: How to prevent the fiend, and to kill vermin.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Let me ask you one word in private.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Importune him once more to go, my lord;
His wits begin to unsettle.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Canst thou blame him?
His daughters seek his death: ah, that good Kent!
He said it would be thus, poor banish'd man!
Thou say'st the king grows mad; I'll tell thee, friend,
I am almost mad myself: I had a son,
Now outlaw'd from my blood; he sought my life,
But lately, very late: I loved him, friend;
No father his son dearer: truth to tell thee,
The grief hath crazed my wits. What a night's this!
I do beseech your grace,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: O, cry your mercy, sir.
Noble philosopher, your company.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Tom's a-cold.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: In, fellow, there, into the hovel: keep thee warm.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Come let's in all.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: This way, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: With him;
I will keep still with my philosopher.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Good my lord, soothe him; let him take the fellow.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Take him you on.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Sirrah, come on; go along with us.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Come, good Athenian.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: No words, no words: hush.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Child Rowland to the dark tower came,
His word was still,--Fie, foh, and fum,
I smell the blood of a British man.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE V. Gloucester's castle.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: I will have my revenge ere I depart his house.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: How, my lord, I may be censured, that nature thus
gives way to loyalty, something fears me to think
of.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: I now perceive, it was not altogether your
brother's evil disposition made him seek his death;
but a provoking merit, set a-work by a reprovable
badness in himself.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: How malicious is my fortune, that I must repent to
be just! This is the letter he spoke of, which
approves him an intelligent party to the advantages
of France: O heavens! that this treason were not,
or not I the detector!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: o with me to the duchess.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: If the matter of this paper be certain, you have
mighty business in hand.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: True or false, it hath made thee earl of
Gloucester. Seek out where thy father is, that he
may be ready for our apprehension.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: Aside If I find him comforting the king, it will
stuff his suspicion more fully.--I will persevere in
my course of loyalty, though the conflict be sore
between that and my blood.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: I will lay trust upon thee; and thou shalt find a
dearer father in my love.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE VI. A chamber in a farmhouse adjoining the castle.
SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter GLOUCESTER, KING LEAR, KENT, Fool, and EDGAR

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Here is better than the open air; take it
thankfully. I will piece out the comfort with what
addition I can: I will not be long from you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: All the power of his wits have given way to his
impatience: the gods reward your kindness!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Frateretto calls me; and tells me
Nero is an angler in the lake of darkness.
Pray, innocent, and beware the foul fiend.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Fool
SPEECH.LINE: Prithee, nuncle, tell me whether a madman be a
gentleman or a yeoman?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: A king, a king!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Fool
SPEECH.LINE: No, he's a yeoman that has a gentleman to his son;
for he's a mad yeoman that sees his son a gentleman
before him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: To have a thousand with red burning spits
Come hissing in upon 'em,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: The foul fiend bites my back.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Fool
SPEECH.LINE: He's mad that trusts in the tameness of a wolf, a
horse's health, a boy's love, or a whore's oath.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: It shall be done; I will arraign them straight.
Come, sit thou here, most learned justicer;
Thou, sapient sir, sit here. Now, you she foxes!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Look, where he stands and glares!
Wantest thou eyes at trial, madam?
Come o'er the bourn, Bessy, to me,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Fool
SPEECH.LINE: Her boat hath a leak,
And she must not speak
Why she dares not come over to thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: The foul fiend haunts poor Tom in the voice of a
nightingale. Hopdance cries in Tom's belly for two
white herring. Croak not, black angel; I have no
food for thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: How do you, sir? Stand you not so amazed:
Will you lie down and rest upon the cushions?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: I'll see their trial first. Bring in the evidence.
Thou robed man of justice, take thy place;
And thou, his yoke-fellow of equity,
Bench by his side:
you are o' the commission,
Sit you too.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Let us deal justly.
Sleepest or wakest thou, jolly shepherd?
Thy sheep be in the corn;
And for one blast of thy minikin mouth,
Thy sheep shall take no harm.
Pur! the cat is gray.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Arraign her first; 'tis Goneril. I here take my
oath before this honourable assembly, she kicked the
poor king her father.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Fool
SPEECH.LINE: Come hither, mistress. Is your name Goneril?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: She cannot deny it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Fool
SPEECH.LINE: Cry you mercy, I took you for a joint-stool.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: And here's another, whose warp'd looks proclaim
What store her heart is made on. Stop her there!
Arms, arms, sword, fire! Corruption in the place!
False justicer, why hast thou let her 'scape?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Bless thy five wits!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: O pity! Sir, where is the patience now,
That thou so oft have boasted to retain?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Aside My tears begin to take his part so much,
They'll mar my counterfeiting.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: The little dogs and all, Tray, Blanch, and
Sweet-heart, see, they bark at me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Tom will throw his head at them. Avaunt, you curs!
Be thy mouth or black or white,
Tooth that poisons if it bite;
Mastiff, grey-hound, mongrel grim,
Hound or spaniel, brach or lym,
Or bobtail tike or trundle-tail,
Tom will make them weep and wail:
For, with throwing thus my head,
Dogs leap the hatch, and all are fled.
Do de, de, de. Sessa! Come, march to wakes and
fairs and market-towns. Poor Tom, thy horn is dry.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Then let them anatomize Regan; see what breeds
about her heart. Is there any cause in nature that
makes these hard hearts?
You, sir, I entertain for one of my hundred; only I
do not like the fashion of your garments: you will
say they are Persian attire: but let them be changed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Now, good my lord, lie here and rest awhile.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Make no noise, make no noise; draw the curtains:
so, so, so. We'll go to supper i' he morning. So, so, so.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Fool
SPEECH.LINE: And I'll go to bed at noon.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Come hither, friend: where is the king my master?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Here, sir; but trouble him not, his wits are gone.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Good friend, I prithee, take him in thy arms;
I have o'erheard a plot of death upon him:
There is a litter ready; lay him in 't,
And drive towards Dover, friend, where thou shalt meet
Both welcome and protection. Take up thy master:
If thou shouldst dally half an hour, his life,
With thine, and all that offer to defend him,
Stand in assured loss: take up, take up;
And follow me, that will to some provision
Give thee quick conduct.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Oppressed nature sleeps:
This rest might yet have balm'd thy broken senses,
Which, if convenience will not allow,
Stand in hard cure.
Come, help to bear thy master;
Thou must not stay behind.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Come, come, away.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: When we our betters see bearing our woes,
We scarcely think our miseries our foes.
Who alone suffers suffers most i' the mind,
Leaving free things and happy shows behind:
But then the mind much sufferance doth o'er skip,
When grief hath mates, and bearing fellowship.
How light and portable my pain seems now,
When that which makes me bend makes the king bow,
He childed as I father'd! Tom, away!
Mark the high noises; and thyself bewray,
When false opinion, whose wrong thought defiles thee,
In thy just proof, repeals and reconciles thee.
What will hap more to-night, safe 'scape the king!
Lurk, lurk.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE VII. Gloucester's castle.
SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter CORNWALL, REGAN, GONERIL, EDMUND, and Servants

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: Post speedily to my lord your husband; show him
this letter: the army of France is landed. Seek
out the villain Gloucester.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Hang him instantly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Pluck out his eyes.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: Leave him to my displeasure. Edmund, keep you our
sister company: the revenges we are bound to take
upon your traitorous father are not fit for your
beholding. Advise the duke, where you are going, to
a most festinate preparation: we are bound to the
like. Our posts shall be swift and intelligent
betwixt us. Farewell, dear sister: farewell, my
lord of Gloucester.
How now! where's the king?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: My lord of Gloucester hath convey'd him hence:
Some five or six and thirty of his knights,
Hot questrists after him, met him at gate;
Who, with some other of the lords dependants,
Are gone with him towards Dover; where they boast
To have well-armed friends.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: Get horses for your mistress.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Farewell, sweet lord, and sister.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: Edmund, farewell.
Go seek the traitor Gloucester,
Pinion him like a thief, bring him before us.
Though well we may not pass upon his life
Without the form of justice, yet our power
Shall do a courtesy to our wrath, which men
May blame, but not control. Who's there? the traitor?

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter GLOUCESTER, brought in by two or three

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Ingrateful fox! 'tis he.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: Bind fast his corky arms.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: What mean your graces? Good my friends, consider
You are my guests: do me no foul play, friends.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: Bind him, I say.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Hard, hard. O filthy traitor!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Unmerciful lady as you are, I'm none.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: To this chair bind him. Villain, thou shalt find--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: By the kind gods, 'tis most ignobly done
To pluck me by the beard.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: So white, and such a traitor!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Naughty lady,
These hairs, which thou dost ravish from my chin,
Will quicken, and accuse thee: I am your host:
With robbers' hands my hospitable favours
You should not ruffle thus. What will you do?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: Come, sir, what letters had you late from France?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Be simple answerer, for we know the truth.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: And what confederacy have you with the traitors
Late footed in the kingdom?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: To whose hands have you sent the lunatic king? Speak.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: I have a letter guessingly set down,
Which came from one that's of a neutral heart,
And not from one opposed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: Cunning.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: And false.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: Where hast thou sent the king?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: To Dover.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Wherefore to Dover? Wast thou not charged at peril--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: Wherefore to Dover? Let him first answer that.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: I am tied to the stake, and I must stand the course.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Wherefore to Dover, sir?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Because I would not see thy cruel nails
Pluck out his poor old eyes; nor thy fierce sister
In his anointed flesh stick boarish fangs.
The sea, with such a storm as his bare head
In hell-black night endured, would have buoy'd up,
And quench'd the stelled fires:
Yet, poor old heart, he holp the heavens to rain.
If wolves had at thy gate howl'd that stern time,
Thou shouldst have said 'Good porter, turn the key,'
All cruels else subscribed: but I shall see
The winged vengeance overtake such children.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: See't shalt thou never. Fellows, hold the chair.
Upon these eyes of thine I'll set my foot.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: He that will think to live till he be old,
Give me some help! O cruel! O you gods!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: One side will mock another; the other too.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: If you see vengeance,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: First Servant
SPEECH.LINE: Hold your hand, my lord:
I have served you ever since I was a child;
But better service have I never done you
Than now to bid you hold.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: How now, you dog!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: First Servant
SPEECH.LINE: If you did wear a beard upon your chin,
I'd shake it on this quarrel. What do you mean?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: My villain!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: First Servant
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, then, come on, and take the chance of anger.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Give me thy sword. A peasant stand up thus!

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Takes a sword, and runs at him behind

SPEECH.SPEAKER: First Servant
SPEECH.LINE: O, I am slain! My lord, you have one eye left
To see some mischief on him. O!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: Lest it see more, prevent it. Out, vile jelly!
Where is thy lustre now?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: All dark and comfortless. Where's my son Edmund?
Edmund, enkindle all the sparks of nature,
To quit this horrid act.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Out, treacherous villain!
Thou call'st on him that hates thee: it was he
That made the overture of thy treasons to us;
Who is too good to pity thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: O my follies! then Edgar was abused.
Kind gods, forgive me that, and prosper him!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Go thrust him out at gates, and let him smell
His way to Dover.
How is't, my lord? how look you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORNWALL
SPEECH.LINE: I have received a hurt: follow me, lady.
Turn out that eyeless villain; throw this slave
Upon the dunghill. Regan, I bleed apace:
Untimely comes this hurt: give me your arm.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Second Servant
SPEECH.LINE: I'll never care what wickedness I do,
If this man come to good.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Third Servant
SPEECH.LINE: If she live long,
And in the end meet the old course of death,
Women will all turn monsters.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Second Servant
SPEECH.LINE: Let's follow the old earl, and get the Bedlam
To lead him where he would: his roguish madness
Allows itself to any thing.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Third Servant
SPEECH.LINE: Go thou: I'll fetch some flax and whites of eggs
To apply to his bleeding face. Now, heaven help him!

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE I. The heath.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Yet better thus, and known to be contemn'd,
Than still contemn'd and flatter'd. To be worst,
The lowest and most dejected thing of fortune,
Stands still in esperance, lives not in fear:
The lamentable change is from the best;
The worst returns to laughter. Welcome, then,
Thou unsubstantial air that I embrace!
The wretch that thou hast blown unto the worst
Owes nothing to thy blasts. But who comes here?
SPEECH.STAGEDIR: Enter GLOUCESTER, led by an Old Man
SPEECH.LINE: My father, poorly led? World, world, O world!
But that thy strange mutations make us hate thee,
Lie would not yield to age.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Old Man
SPEECH.LINE: O, my good lord, I have been your tenant, and
your father's tenant, these fourscore years.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Away, get thee away; good friend, be gone:
Thy comforts can do me no good at all;
Thee they may hurt.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Old Man
SPEECH.LINE: Alack, sir, you cannot see your way.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: I have no way, and therefore want no eyes;
I stumbled when I saw: full oft 'tis seen,
Our means secure us, and our mere defects
Prove our commodities. O dear son Edgar,
The food of thy abused father's wrath!
Might I but live to see thee in my touch,
I'ld say I had eyes again!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Old Man
SPEECH.LINE: How now! Who's there?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Aside O gods! Who is't can say 'I am at
the worst'?
I am worse than e'er I was.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Old Man
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis poor mad Tom.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Aside And worse I may be yet: the worst is not
So long as we can say 'This is the worst.'

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Old Man
SPEECH.LINE: Fellow, where goest?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Is it a beggar-man?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Old Man
SPEECH.LINE: Madman and beggar too.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: He has some reason, else he could not beg.
I' the last night's storm I such a fellow saw;
Which made me think a man a worm: my son
Came then into my mind; and yet my mind
Was then scarce friends with him: I have heard
more since.
As flies to wanton boys, are we to the gods.
They kill us for their sport.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Aside How should this be?
Bad is the trade that must play fool to sorrow,
Angering itself and others.--Bless thee, master!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Is that the naked fellow?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Old Man
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Then, prithee, get thee gone: if, for my sake,
Thou wilt o'ertake us, hence a mile or twain,
I' the way toward Dover, do it for ancient love;
And bring some covering for this naked soul,
Who I'll entreat to lead me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Old Man
SPEECH.LINE: Alack, sir, he is mad.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis the times' plague, when madmen lead the blind.
Do as I bid thee, or rather do thy pleasure;
Above the rest, be gone.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Old Man
SPEECH.LINE: I'll bring him the best 'parel that I have,
Come on't what will.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Sirrah, naked fellow,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Poor Tom's a-cold.
I cannot daub it further.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Come hither, fellow.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Aside And yet I must.--Bless thy sweet eyes, they bleed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Know'st thou the way to Dover?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Both stile and gate, horse-way and foot-path. Poor
Tom hath been scared out of his good wits: bless
thee, good man's son, from the foul fiend! five
fiends have been in poor Tom at once; of lust, as
Obidicut; Hobbididence, prince of dumbness; Mahu, of
stealing; Modo, of murder; Flibbertigibbet, of
mopping and mowing, who since possesses chambermaids
and waiting-women. So, bless thee, master!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Here, take this purse, thou whom the heavens' plagues
Have humbled to all strokes: that I am wretched
Makes thee the happier: heavens, deal so still!
Let the superfluous and lust-dieted man,
That slaves your ordinance, that will not see
Because he doth not feel, feel your power quickly;
So distribution should undo excess,
And each man have enough. Dost thou know Dover?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, master.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: There is a cliff, whose high and bending head
Looks fearfully in the confined deep:
Bring me but to the very brim of it,
And I'll repair the misery thou dost bear
With something rich about me: from that place
I shall no leading need.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Give me thy arm:
Poor Tom shall lead thee.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE II. Before ALBANY's palace.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Welcome, my lord: I marvel our mild husband
Not met us on the way.
Now, where's your master'?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: Madam, within; but never man so changed.
I told him of the army that was landed;
He smiled at it: I told him you were coming:
His answer was 'The worse:' of Gloucester's treachery,
And of the loyal service of his son,
When I inform'd him, then he call'd me sot,
And told me I had turn'd the wrong side out:
What most he should dislike seems pleasant to him;
What like, offensive.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: To EDMUND Then shall you go no further.
It is the cowish terror of his spirit,
That dares not undertake: he'll not feel wrongs
Which tie him to an answer. Our wishes on the way
May prove effects. Back, Edmund, to my brother;
Hasten his musters and conduct his powers:
I must change arms at home, and give the distaff
Into my husband's hands. This trusty servant
Shall pass between us: ere long you are like to hear,
If you dare venture in your own behalf,
A mistress's command. Wear this; spare speech;
Decline your head: this kiss, if it durst speak,
Would stretch thy spirits up into the air:
Conceive, and fare thee well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: Yours in the ranks of death.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: My most dear Gloucester!
O, the difference of man and man!
To thee a woman's services are due:
My fool usurps my body.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: Madam, here comes my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: I have been worth the whistle.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: O Goneril!
You are not worth the dust which the rude wind
Blows in your face. I fear your disposition:
That nature, which contemns its origin,
Cannot be border'd certain in itself;
She that herself will sliver and disbranch
From her material sap, perforce must wither
And come to deadly use.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: No more; the text is foolish.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Wisdom and goodness to the vile seem vile:
Filths savour but themselves. What have you done?
Tigers, not daughters, what have you perform'd?
A father, and a gracious aged man,
Whose reverence even the head-lugg'd bear would lick,
Most barbarous, most degenerate! have you madded.
Could my good brother suffer you to do it?
A man, a prince, by him so benefited!
If that the heavens do not their visible spirits
Send quickly down to tame these vile offences,
It will come,
Humanity must perforce prey on itself,
Like monsters of the deep.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Milk-liver'd man!
That bear'st a cheek for blows, a head for wrongs;
Who hast not in thy brows an eye discerning
Thine honour from thy suffering; that not know'st
Fools do those villains pity who are punish'd
Ere they have done their mischief. Where's thy drum?
France spreads his banners in our noiseless land;
With plumed helm thy slayer begins threats;
Whiles thou, a moral fool, sit'st still, and criest
'Alack, why does he so?'

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: See thyself, devil!
Proper deformity seems not in the fiend
So horrid as in woman.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: O vain fool!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Thou changed and self-cover'd thing, for shame,
Be-monster not thy feature. Were't my fitness
To let these hands obey my blood,
They are apt enough to dislocate and tear
Thy flesh and bones: howe'er thou art a fiend,
A woman's shape doth shield thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Marry, your manhood now--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: What news?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Messenger
SPEECH.LINE: O, my good lord, the Duke of Cornwall's dead:
Slain by his servant, going to put out
The other eye of Gloucester.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Gloucester's eye!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Messenger
SPEECH.LINE: A servant that he bred, thrill'd with remorse,
Opposed against the act, bending his sword
To his great master; who, thereat enraged,
Flew on him, and amongst them fell'd him dead;
But not without that harmful stroke, which since
Hath pluck'd him after.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: This shows you are above,
You justicers, that these our nether crimes
So speedily can venge! But, O poor Gloucester!
Lost he his other eye?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Messenger
SPEECH.LINE: Both, both, my lord.
This letter, madam, craves a speedy answer;
'Tis from your sister.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Aside One way I like this well;
But being widow, and my Gloucester with her,
May all the building in my fancy pluck
Upon my hateful life: another way,
The news is not so tart.--I'll read, and answer.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Where was his son when they did take his eyes?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Messenger
SPEECH.LINE: Come with my lady hither.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: He is not here.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Messenger
SPEECH.LINE: No, my good lord; I met him back again.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Knows he the wickedness?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Messenger
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, my good lord; 'twas he inform'd against him;
And quit the house on purpose, that their punishment
Might have the freer course.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Gloucester, I live
To thank thee for the love thou show'dst the king,
And to revenge thine eyes. Come hither, friend:
Tell me what more thou know'st.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE III. The French camp near Dover.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Why the King of France is so suddenly gone back
know you the reason?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: Something he left imperfect in the
state, which since his coming forth is thought
of; which imports to the kingdom so much
fear and danger, that his personal return was
most required and necessary.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Who hath he left behind him general?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: The Marshal of France, Monsieur La Far.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Did your letters pierce the queen to any
demonstration of grief?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, sir; she took them, read them in my presence;
And now and then an ample tear trill'd down
Her delicate cheek: it seem'd she was a queen
Over her passion; who, most rebel-like,
Sought to be king o'er her.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: O, then it moved her.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: Not to a rage: patience and sorrow strove
Who should express her goodliest. You have seen
Sunshine and rain at once: her smiles and tears
Were like a better way: those happy smilets,
That play'd on her ripe lip, seem'd not to know
What guests were in her eyes; which parted thence,
As pearls from diamonds dropp'd. In brief,
Sorrow would be a rarity most beloved,
If all could so become it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Made she no verbal question?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: 'Faith, once or twice she heaved the name of 'father'
Pantingly forth, as if it press'd her heart:
Cried 'Sisters! sisters! Shame of ladies! sisters!
Kent! father! sisters! What, i' the storm? i' the night?
Let pity not be believed!' There she shook
The holy water from her heavenly eyes,
And clamour moisten'd: then away she started
To deal with grief alone.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: It is the stars,
The stars above us, govern our conditions;
Else one self mate and mate could not beget
Such different issues. You spoke not with her since?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: No.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Was this before the king return'd?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: No, since.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Well, sir, the poor distressed Lear's i' the town;
Who sometime, in his better tune, remembers
What we are come about, and by no means
Will yield to see his daughter.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: Why, good sir?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: A sovereign shame so elbows him: his own unkindness,
That stripp'd her from his benediction, turn'd her
To foreign casualties, gave her dear rights
To his dog-hearted daughters, these things sting
His mind so venomously, that burning shame
Detains him from Cordelia.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: Alack, poor gentleman!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Of Albany's and Cornwall's powers you heard not?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis so, they are afoot.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Well, sir, I'll bring you to our master Lear,
And leave you to attend him: some dear cause
Will in concealment wrap me up awhile;
When I am known aright, you shall not grieve
Lending me this acquaintance. I pray you, go
Along with me.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE IV. The same. A tent.
SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter, with drum and colours, CORDELIA, Doctor, and Soldiers

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: Alack, 'tis he: why, he was met even now
As mad as the vex'd sea; singing aloud;
Crown'd with rank fumiter and furrow-weeds,
With bur-docks, hemlock, nettles, cuckoo-flowers,
Darnel, and all the idle weeds that grow
In our sustaining corn. A century send forth;
Search every acre in the high-grown field,
And bring him to our eye.
What can man's wisdom
In the restoring his bereaved sense?
He that helps him take all my outward worth.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Doctor
SPEECH.LINE: There is means, madam:
Our foster-nurse of nature is repose,
The which he lacks; that to provoke in him,
Are many simples operative, whose power
Will close the eye of anguish.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: All blest secrets,
All you unpublish'd virtues of the earth,
Spring with my tears! be aidant and remediate
In the good man's distress! Seek, seek for him;
Lest his ungovern'd rage dissolve the life
That wants the means to lead it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Messenger
SPEECH.LINE: News, madam;
The British powers are marching hitherward.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis known before; our preparation stands
In expectation of them. O dear father,
It is thy business that I go about;
Therefore great France
My mourning and important tears hath pitied.
No blown ambition doth our arms incite,
But love, dear love, and our aged father's right:
Soon may I hear and see him!

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE V. Gloucester's castle.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: But are my brother's powers set forth?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, madam.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Himself in person there?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: Madam, with much ado:
Your sister is the better soldier.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Lord Edmund spake not with your lord at home?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: No, madam.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: What might import my sister's letter to him?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: I know not, lady.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: 'Faith, he is posted hence on serious matter.
It was great ignorance, Gloucester's eyes being out,
To let him live: where he arrives he moves
All hearts against us: Edmund, I think, is gone,
In pity of his misery, to dispatch
His nighted life: moreover, to descry
The strength o' the enemy.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: I must needs after him, madam, with my letter.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Our troops set forth to-morrow: stay with us;
The ways are dangerous.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: I may not, madam:
My lady charged my duty in this business.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Why should she write to Edmund? Might not you
Transport her purposes by word? Belike,
Something--I know not what: I'll love thee much,
Let me unseal the letter.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: Madam, I had rather--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: I know your lady does not love her husband;
I am sure of that: and at her late being here
She gave strange oeillades and most speaking looks
To noble Edmund. I know you are of her bosom.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: I, madam?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: I speak in understanding; you are; I know't:
Therefore I do advise you, take this note:
My lord is dead; Edmund and I have talk'd;
And more convenient is he for my hand
Than for your lady's: you may gather more.
If you do find him, pray you, give him this;
And when your mistress hears thus much from you,
I pray, desire her call her wisdom to her.
So, fare you well.
If you do chance to hear of that blind traitor,
Preferment falls on him that cuts him off.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: Would I could meet him, madam! I should show
What party I do follow.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Fare thee well.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE VI. Fields near Dover.
SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter GLOUCESTER, and EDGAR dressed like a peasant

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: When shall we come to the top of that same hill?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: You do climb up it now: look, how we labour.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Methinks the ground is even.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Horrible steep.
Hark, do you hear the sea?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: No, truly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Why, then, your other senses grow imperfect
By your eyes' anguish.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: So may it be, indeed:
Methinks thy voice is alter'd; and thou speak'st
In better phrase and matter than thou didst.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: You're much deceived: in nothing am I changed
But in my garments.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Methinks you're better spoken.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Come on, sir; here's the place: stand still. How fearful
And dizzy 'tis, to cast one's eyes so low!
The crows and choughs that wing the midway air
Show scarce so gross as beetles: half way down
Hangs one that gathers samphire, dreadful trade!
Methinks he seems no bigger than his head:
The fishermen, that walk upon the beach,
Appear like mice; and yond tall anchoring bark,
Diminish'd to her cock; her cock, a buoy
Almost too small for sight: the murmuring surge,
That on the unnumber'd idle pebbles chafes,
Cannot be heard so high. I'll look no more;
Lest my brain turn, and the deficient sight
Topple down headlong.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Set me where you stand.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Give me your hand: you are now within a foot
Of the extreme verge: for all beneath the moon
Would I not leap upright.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Let go my hand.
Here, friend, 's another purse; in it a jewel
Well worth a poor man's taking: fairies and gods
Prosper it with thee! Go thou farther off;
Bid me farewell, and let me hear thee going.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Now fare you well, good sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: With all my heart.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Why I do trifle thus with his despair
Is done to cure it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Kneeling O you mighty gods!
This world I do renounce, and, in your sights,
Shake patiently my great affliction off:
If I could bear it longer, and not fall
To quarrel with your great opposeless wills,
My snuff and loathed part of nature should
Burn itself out. If Edgar live, O, bless him!
Now, fellow, fare thee well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Gone, sir: farewell.
And yet I know not how conceit may rob
The treasury of life, when life itself
Yields to the theft: had he been where he thought,
By this, had thought been past. Alive or dead?
Ho, you sir! friend! Hear you, sir! speak!
Thus might he pass indeed: yet he revives.
What are you, sir?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Away, and let me die.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Hadst thou been aught but gossamer, feathers, air,
So many fathom down precipitating,
Thou'dst shiver'd like an egg: but thou dost breathe;
Hast heavy substance; bleed'st not; speak'st; art sound.
Ten masts at each make not the altitude
Which thou hast perpendicularly fell:
Thy life's a miracle. Speak yet again.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: But have I fall'n, or no?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: From the dread summit of this chalky bourn.
Look up a-height; the shrill-gorged lark so far
Cannot be seen or heard: do but look up.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Alack, I have no eyes.
Is wretchedness deprived that benefit,
To end itself by death? 'Twas yet some comfort,
When misery could beguile the tyrant's rage,
And frustrate his proud will.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Give me your arm:
Up: so. How is 't? Feel you your legs? You stand.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Too well, too well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: This is above all strangeness.
Upon the crown o' the cliff, what thing was that
Which parted from you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: A poor unfortunate beggar.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: As I stood here below, methought his eyes
Were two full moons; he had a thousand noses,
Horns whelk'd and waved like the enridged sea:
It was some fiend; therefore, thou happy father,
Think that the clearest gods, who make them honours
Of men's impossibilities, have preserved thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: I do remember now: henceforth I'll bear
Affliction till it do cry out itself
'Enough, enough,' and die. That thing you speak of,
I took it for a man; often 'twould say
'The fiend, the fiend:' he led me to that place.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Bear free and patient thoughts. But who comes here?
SPEECH.STAGEDIR: Enter KING LEAR, fantastically dressed with wild flowers
SPEECH.LINE: The safer sense will ne'er accommodate
His master thus.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: No, they cannot touch me for coining; I am the
king himself.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: O thou side-piercing sight!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Nature's above art in that respect. There's your
press-money. That fellow handles his bow like a
crow-keeper: draw me a clothier's yard. Look,
look, a mouse! Peace, peace; this piece of toasted
cheese will do 't. There's my gauntlet; I'll prove
it on a giant. Bring up the brown bills. O, well
flown, bird! i' the clout, i' the clout: hewgh!
Give the word.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Sweet marjoram.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Pass.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: I know that voice.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Ha! Goneril, with a white beard! They flattered
me like a dog; and told me I had white hairs in my
beard ere the black ones were there. To say 'ay'
and 'no' to every thing that I said!--'Ay' and 'no'
too was no good divinity. When the rain came to
wet me once, and the wind to make me chatter; when
the thunder would not peace at my bidding; there I
found 'em, there I smelt 'em out. Go to, they are
not men o' their words: they told me I was every
thing; 'tis a lie, I am not ague-proof.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: The trick of that voice I do well remember:
Is 't not the king?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, every inch a king:
When I do stare, see how the subject quakes.
I pardon that man's life. What was thy cause? Adultery?
Thou shalt not die: die for adultery! No:
The wren goes to 't, and the small gilded fly
Does lecher in my sight.
Let copulation thrive; for Gloucester's bastard son
Was kinder to his father than my daughters
Got 'tween the lawful sheets.
To 't, luxury, pell-mell! for I lack soldiers.
Behold yond simpering dame,
Whose face between her forks presages snow;
That minces virtue, and does shake the head
To hear of pleasure's name;
The fitchew, nor the soiled horse, goes to 't
With a more riotous appetite.
Down from the waist they are Centaurs,
Though women all above:
But to the girdle do the gods inherit,
Beneath is all the fiends';
There's hell, there's darkness, there's the
sulphurous pit,
Burning, scalding, stench, consumption; fie,
fie, fie! pah, pah! Give me an ounce of civet,
good apothecary, to sweeten my imagination:
there's money for thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: O, let me kiss that hand!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Let me wipe it first; it smells of mortality.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: O ruin'd piece of nature! This great world
Shall so wear out to nought. Dost thou know me?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: I remember thine eyes well enough. Dost thou squiny
at me? No, do thy worst, blind Cupid! I'll not
love. Read thou this challenge; mark but the
penning of it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Were all the letters suns, I could not see one.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: I would not take this from report; it is,
And my heart breaks at it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Read.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: What, with the case of eyes?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: O, ho, are you there with me? No eyes in your
head, nor no money in your purse? Your eyes are in
a heavy case, your purse in a light; yet you see how
this world goes.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: I see it feelingly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: What, art mad? A man may see how this world goes
with no eyes. Look with thine ears: see how yond
justice rails upon yond simple thief. Hark, in
thine ear: change places; and, handy-dandy, which
is the justice, which is the thief? Thou hast seen
a farmer's dog bark at a beggar?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: And the creature run from the cur? There thou
mightst behold the great image of authority: a
dog's obeyed in office.
Thou rascal beadle, hold thy bloody hand!
Why dost thou lash that whore? Strip thine own back;
Thou hotly lust'st to use her in that kind
For which thou whipp'st her. The usurer hangs the cozener.
Through tatter'd clothes small vices do appear;
Robes and furr'd gowns hide all. Plate sin with gold,
And the strong lance of justice hurtless breaks:
Arm it in rags, a pigmy's straw does pierce it.
None does offend, none, I say, none; I'll able 'em:
Take that of me, my friend, who have the power
To seal the accuser's lips. Get thee glass eyes;
And like a scurvy politician, seem
To see the things thou dost not. Now, now, now, now:
Pull off my boots: harder, harder: so.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: O, matter and impertinency mix'd! Reason in madness!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: If thou wilt weep my fortunes, take my eyes.
I know thee well enough; thy name is Gloucester:
Thou must be patient; we came crying hither:
Thou know'st, the first time that we smell the air,
We wawl and cry. I will preach to thee: mark.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Alack, alack the day!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: When we are born, we cry that we are come
To this great stage of fools: this a good block;
It were a delicate stratagem, to shoe
A troop of horse with felt: I'll put 't in proof;
And when I have stol'n upon these sons-in-law,
Then, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill, kill!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: O, here he is: lay hand upon him. Sir,
Your most dear daughter--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: No rescue? What, a prisoner? I am even
The natural fool of fortune. Use me well;
You shall have ransom. Let me have surgeons;
I am cut to the brains.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: You shall have any thing.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: No seconds? all myself?
Why, this would make a man a man of salt,
To use his eyes for garden water-pots,
Ay, and laying autumn's dust.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: Good sir,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: I will die bravely, like a bridegroom. What!
I will be jovial: come, come; I am a king,
My masters, know you that.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: You are a royal one, and we obey you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Then there's life in't. Nay, if you get it, you
shall get it with running. Sa, sa, sa, sa.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: A sight most pitiful in the meanest wretch,
Past speaking of in a king! Thou hast one daughter,
Who redeems nature from the general curse
Which twain have brought her to.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Hail, gentle sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, speed you: what's your will?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Do you hear aught, sir, of a battle toward?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: Most sure and vulgar: every one hears that,
Which can distinguish sound.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: But, by your favour,
How near's the other army?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: Near and on speedy foot; the main descry
Stands on the hourly thought.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: I thank you, sir: that's all.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: Though that the queen on special cause is here,
Her army is moved on.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: I thank you, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: You ever-gentle gods, take my breath from me:
Let not my worser spirit tempt me again
To die before you please!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Well pray you, father.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Now, good sir, what are you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: A most poor man, made tame to fortune's blows;
Who, by the art of known and feeling sorrows,
Am pregnant to good pity. Give me your hand,
I'll lead you to some biding.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Hearty thanks:
The bounty and the benison of heaven
To boot, and boot!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: A proclaim'd prize! Most happy!
That eyeless head of thine was first framed flesh
To raise my fortunes. Thou old unhappy traitor,
Briefly thyself remember: the sword is out
That must destroy thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Now let thy friendly hand
Put strength enough to't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: Wherefore, bold peasant,
Darest thou support a publish'd traitor? Hence;
Lest that the infection of his fortune take
Like hold on thee. Let go his arm.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Ch'ill not let go, zir, without vurther 'casion.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: Let go, slave, or thou diest!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Good gentleman, go your gait, and let poor volk
pass. An chud ha' bin zwaggered out of my life,
'twould not ha' bin zo long as 'tis by a vortnight.
Nay, come not near th' old man; keep out, che vor
ye, or ise try whether your costard or my ballow be
the harder: ch'ill be plain with you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: Out, dunghill!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Ch'ill pick your teeth, zir: come; no matter vor
your foins.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: They fight, and EDGAR knocks him down

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OSWALD
SPEECH.LINE: Slave, thou hast slain me: villain, take my purse:
If ever thou wilt thrive, bury my body;
And give the letters which thou find'st about me
To Edmund earl of Gloucester; seek him out
Upon the British party: O, untimely death!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: I know thee well: a serviceable villain;
As duteous to the vices of thy mistress
As badness would desire.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: What, is he dead?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Sit you down, father; rest you
Let's see these pockets: the letters that he speaks of
May be my friends. He's dead; I am only sorry
He had no other death's-man. Let us see:
Leave, gentle wax; and, manners, blame us not:
To know our enemies' minds, we'ld rip their hearts;
Their papers, is more lawful.
'Let our reciprocal vows be remembered. You have
many opportunities to cut him off: if your will
want not, time and place will be fruitfully offered.
There is nothing done, if he return the conqueror:
then am I the prisoner, and his bed my goal; from
the loathed warmth whereof deliver me, and supply
the place for your labour.
'Your--wife, so I would say--
'Affectionate servant,
'GONERIL.'
O undistinguish'd space of woman's will!
A plot upon her virtuous husband's life;
And the exchange my brother! Here, in the sands,
Thee I'll rake up, the post unsanctified
Of murderous lechers: and in the mature time
With this ungracious paper strike the sight
Of the death practised duke: for him 'tis well
That of thy death and business I can tell.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: The king is mad: how stiff is my vile sense,
That I stand up, and have ingenious feeling
Of my huge sorrows! Better I were distract:
So should my thoughts be sever'd from my griefs,
And woes by wrong imaginations lose
The knowledge of themselves.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Give me your hand:
Far off, methinks, I hear the beaten drum:
Come, father, I'll bestow you with a friend.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE VII. A tent in the French camp. LEAR on a bed asleep, soft music playing; Gentleman, and others attending.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: O thou good Kent, how shall I live and work,
To match thy goodness? My life will be too short,
And every measure fail me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: To be acknowledged, madam, is o'erpaid.
All my reports go with the modest truth;
Nor more nor clipp'd, but so.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: Be better suited:
These weeds are memories of those worser hours:
I prithee, put them off.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Pardon me, dear madam;
Yet to be known shortens my made intent:
My boon I make it, that you know me not
Till time and I think meet.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: Then be't so, my good lord.
How does the king?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Doctor
SPEECH.LINE: Madam, sleeps still.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: O you kind gods,
Cure this great breach in his abused nature!
The untuned and jarring senses, O, wind up
Of this child-changed father!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Doctor
SPEECH.LINE: So please your majesty
That we may wake the king: he hath slept long.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: Be govern'd by your knowledge, and proceed
I' the sway of your own will. Is he array'd?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, madam; in the heaviness of his sleep
We put fresh garments on him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Doctor
SPEECH.LINE: Be by, good madam, when we do awake him;
I doubt not of his temperance.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: Very well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Doctor
SPEECH.LINE: Please you, draw near. Louder the music there!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: O my dear father! Restoration hang
Thy medicine on my lips; and let this kiss
Repair those violent harms that my two sisters
Have in thy reverence made!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Kind and dear princess!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: Had you not been their father, these white flakes
Had challenged pity of them. Was this a face
To be opposed against the warring winds?
To stand against the deep dread-bolted thunder?
In the most terrible and nimble stroke
Of quick, cross lightning? to watch--poor perdu!--
With this thin helm? Mine enemy's dog,
Though he had bit me, should have stood that night
Against my fire; and wast thou fain, poor father,
To hovel thee with swine, and rogues forlorn,
In short and musty straw? Alack, alack!
'Tis wonder that thy life and wits at once
Had not concluded all. He wakes; speak to him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Doctor
SPEECH.LINE: Madam, do you; 'tis fittest.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: How does my royal lord? How fares your majesty?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: You do me wrong to take me out o' the grave:
Thou art a soul in bliss; but I am bound
Upon a wheel of fire, that mine own tears
Do scald like moulten lead.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, do you know me?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: You are a spirit, I know: when did you die?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: Still, still, far wide!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Doctor
SPEECH.LINE: He's scarce awake: let him alone awhile.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Where have I been? Where am I? Fair daylight?
I am mightily abused. I should e'en die with pity,
To see another thus. I know not what to say.
I will not swear these are my hands: let's see;
I feel this pin prick. Would I were assured
Of my condition!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: O, look upon me, sir,
And hold your hands in benediction o'er me:
No, sir, you must not kneel.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Pray, do not mock me:
I am a very foolish fond old man,
Fourscore and upward, not an hour more nor less;
And, to deal plainly,
I fear I am not in my perfect mind.
Methinks I should know you, and know this man;
Yet I am doubtful for I am mainly ignorant
What place this is; and all the skill I have
Remembers not these garments; nor I know not
Where I did lodge last night. Do not laugh at me;
For, as I am a man, I think this lady
To be my child Cordelia.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: And so I am, I am.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Be your tears wet? yes, 'faith. I pray, weep not:
If you have poison for me, I will drink it.
I know you do not love me; for your sisters
Have, as I do remember, done me wrong:
You have some cause, they have not.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: No cause, no cause.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Am I in France?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: In your own kingdom, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Do not abuse me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Doctor
SPEECH.LINE: Be comforted, good madam: the great rage,
You see, is kill'd in him: and yet it is danger
To make him even o'er the time he has lost.
Desire him to go in; trouble him no more
Till further settling.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: Will't please your highness walk?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: You must bear with me:
Pray you now, forget and forgive: I am old and foolish.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Exeunt all but KENT and Gentleman

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: Holds it true, sir, that the Duke of Cornwall was so slain?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Most certain, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: Who is conductor of his people?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: As 'tis said, the bastard son of Gloucester.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: They say Edgar, his banished son, is with the Earl
of Kent in Germany.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: Report is changeable. 'Tis time to look about; the
powers of the kingdom approach apace.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Gentleman
SPEECH.LINE: The arbitrement is like to be bloody. Fare you
well, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KENT
SPEECH.LINE: My point and period will be throughly wrought,
Or well or ill, as this day's battle's fought.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE I. The British camp, near Dover.
SCENE.STAGEDIR:
Enter, with drum and colours, EDMUND, REGAN, Gentlemen, and Soldiers.
EDMUND Know of the duke if his last purpose hold, Or whether since he is advised by aught To change the course: he's full of alteration And self-reproving: bring his constant pleasure.
[To a Gentleman, who goes out

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Our sister's man is certainly miscarried.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis to be doubted, madam.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Now, sweet lord,
You know the goodness I intend upon you:
Tell me--but truly--but then speak the truth,
Do you not love my sister?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: In honour'd love.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: But have you never found my brother's way
To the forfended place?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: That thought abuses you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: I am doubtful that you have been conjunct
And bosom'd with her, as far as we call hers.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: No, by mine honour, madam.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: I never shall endure her: dear my lord,
Be not familiar with her.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: Fear me not:
She and the duke her husband!

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter, with drum and colours, ALBANY, GONERIL, and Soldiers

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Aside I had rather lose the battle than that sister
Should loosen him and me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Our very loving sister, well be-met.
Sir, this I hear; the king is come to his daughter,
With others whom the rigor of our state
Forced to cry out. Where I could not be honest,
I never yet was valiant: for this business,
It toucheth us, as France invades our land,
Not bolds the king, with others, whom, I fear,
Most just and heavy causes make oppose.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, you speak nobly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Why is this reason'd?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Combine together 'gainst the enemy;
For these domestic and particular broils
Are not the question here.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Let's then determine
With the ancient of war on our proceedings.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: I shall attend you presently at your tent.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Sister, you'll go with us?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: No.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis most convenient; pray you, go with us.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Aside O, ho, I know the riddle.--I will go.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: As they are going out, enter EDGAR disguised

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: If e'er your grace had speech with man so poor,
Hear me one word.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: I'll overtake you. Speak.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Exeunt all but ALBANY and EDGAR

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Before you fight the battle, ope this letter.
If you have victory, let the trumpet sound
For him that brought it: wretched though I seem,
I can produce a champion that will prove
What is avouched there. If you miscarry,
Your business of the world hath so an end,
And machination ceases. Fortune love you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Stay till I have read the letter.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: I was forbid it.
When time shall serve, let but the herald cry,
And I'll appear again.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Why, fare thee well: I will o'erlook thy paper.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: The enemy's in view; draw up your powers.
Here is the guess of their true strength and forces
By diligent discovery; but your haste
Is now urged on you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: We will greet the time.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: To both these sisters have I sworn my love;
Each jealous of the other, as the stung
Are of the adder. Which of them shall I take?
Both? one? or neither? Neither can be enjoy'd,
If both remain alive: to take the widow
Exasperates, makes mad her sister Goneril;
And hardly shall I carry out my side,
Her husband being alive. Now then we'll use
His countenance for the battle; which being done,
Let her who would be rid of him devise
His speedy taking off. As for the mercy
Which he intends to Lear and to Cordelia,
The battle done, and they within our power,
Shall never see his pardon; for my state
Stands on me to defend, not to debate.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE II. A field between the two camps.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Here, father, take the shadow of this tree
For your good host; pray that the right may thrive:
If ever I return to you again,
I'll bring you comfort.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: Grace go with you, sir!

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Alarum and retreat within. Re-enter EDGAR

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Away, old man; give me thy hand; away!
King Lear hath lost, he and his daughter ta'en:
Give me thy hand; come on.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: No farther, sir; a man may rot even here.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: What, in ill thoughts again? Men must endure
Their going hence, even as their coming hither;
Ripeness is all: come on.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GLOUCESTER
SPEECH.LINE: And that's true too.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE III. The British camp near Dover.
SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter, in conquest, with drum and colours, EDMUND, KING LEAR and CORDELIA, prisoners; Captain, Soldiers, &c

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: Some officers take them away: good guard,
Until their greater pleasures first be known
That are to censure them.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CORDELIA
SPEECH.LINE: We are not the first
Who, with best meaning, have incurr'd the worst.
For thee, oppressed king, am I cast down;
Myself could else out-frown false fortune's frown.
Shall we not see these daughters and these sisters?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: No, no, no, no! Come, let's away to prison:
We two alone will sing like birds i' the cage:
When thou dost ask me blessing, I'll kneel down,
And ask of thee forgiveness: so we'll live,
And pray, and sing, and tell old tales, and laugh
At gilded butterflies, and hear poor rogues
Talk of court news; and we'll talk with them too,
Who loses and who wins; who's in, who's out;
And take upon's the mystery of things,
As if we were God's spies: and we'll wear out,
In a wall'd prison, packs and sects of great ones,
That ebb and flow by the moon.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: Take them away.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: KING LEAR
SPEECH.LINE: Upon such sacrifices, my Cordelia,
The gods themselves throw incense. Have I caught thee?
He that parts us shall bring a brand from heaven,
And fire us hence like foxes. Wipe thine eyes;
The good-years shall devour them, flesh and fell,
Ere they shall make us weep: we'll see 'em starve
first. Come.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Exeunt KING LEAR and CORDELIA, guarded

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: Come hither, captain; hark.
Take thou this note;
go follow them to prison:
One step I have advanced thee; if thou dost
As this instructs thee, thou dost make thy way
To noble fortunes: know thou this, that men
Are as the time is: to be tender-minded
Does not become a sword: thy great employment
Will not bear question; either say thou'lt do 't,
Or thrive by other means.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Captain
SPEECH.LINE: I'll do 't, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: About it; and write happy when thou hast done.
Mark, I say, instantly; and carry it so
As I have set it down.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Captain
SPEECH.LINE: I cannot draw a cart, nor eat dried oats;
If it be man's work, I'll do 't.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Flourish. Enter ALBANY, GONERIL, REGAN, another Captain, and Soldiers

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, you have shown to-day your valiant strain,
And fortune led you well: you have the captives
That were the opposites of this day's strife:
We do require them of you, so to use them
As we shall find their merits and our safety
May equally determine.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, I thought it fit
To send the old and miserable king
To some retention and appointed guard;
Whose age has charms in it, whose title more,
To pluck the common bosom on his side,
An turn our impress'd lances in our eyes
Which do command them. With him I sent the queen;
My reason all the same; and they are ready
To-morrow, or at further space, to appear
Where you shall hold your session. At this time
We sweat and bleed: the friend hath lost his friend;
And the best quarrels, in the heat, are cursed
By those that feel their sharpness:
The question of Cordelia and her father
Requires a fitter place.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, by your patience,
I hold you but a subject of this war,
Not as a brother.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: That's as we list to grace him.
Methinks our pleasure might have been demanded,
Ere you had spoke so far. He led our powers;
Bore the commission of my place and person;
The which immediacy may well stand up,
And call itself your brother.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Not so hot:
In his own grace he doth exalt himself,
More than in your addition.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: In my rights,
By me invested, he compeers the best.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: That were the most, if he should husband you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Jesters do oft prove prophets.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Holla, holla!
That eye that told you so look'd but a-squint.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Lady, I am not well; else I should answer
From a full-flowing stomach. General,
Take thou my soldiers, prisoners, patrimony;
Dispose of them, of me; the walls are thine:
Witness the world, that I create thee here
My lord and master.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Mean you to enjoy him?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: The let-alone lies not in your good will.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: Nor in thine, lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Half-blooded fellow, yes.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: To EDMUND Let the drum strike, and prove my title thine.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Stay yet; hear reason. Edmund, I arrest thee
On capital treason; and, in thine attaint,
This gilded serpent
For your claim, fair sister,
I bar it in the interest of my wife:
'Tis she is sub-contracted to this lord,
And I, her husband, contradict your bans.
If you will marry, make your loves to me,
My lady is bespoke.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: An interlude!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Thou art arm'd, Gloucester: let the trumpet sound:
If none appear to prove upon thy head
Thy heinous, manifest, and many treasons,
There is my pledge;
I'll prove it on thy heart,
Ere I taste bread, thou art in nothing less
Than I have here proclaim'd thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: Sick, O, sick!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Aside If not, I'll ne'er trust medicine.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: There's my exchange:
what in the world he is
That names me traitor, villain-like he lies:
Call by thy trumpet: he that dares approach,
On him, on you, who not? I will maintain
My truth and honour firmly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: A herald, ho!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: A herald, ho, a herald!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Trust to thy single virtue; for thy soldiers,
All levied in my name, have in my name
Took their discharge.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: REGAN
SPEECH.LINE: My sickness grows upon me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: She is not well; convey her to my tent.
Come hither, herald,--Let the trumpet sound,
And read out this.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Captain
SPEECH.LINE: Sound, trumpet!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Herald
SPEECH.LINE: Reads 'If any man of quality or degree within
the lists of the army will maintain upon Edmund,
supposed Earl of Gloucester, that he is a manifold
traitor, let him appear by the third sound of the
trumpet: he is bold in his defence.'

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: Sound!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Herald
SPEECH.LINE: Again!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Herald
SPEECH.LINE: Again!

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter EDGAR, at the third sound, armed, with a trumpet before him

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Ask him his purposes, why he appears
Upon this call o' the trumpet.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Herald
SPEECH.LINE: What are you?
Your name, your quality? and why you answer
This present summons?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Know, my name is lost;
By treason's tooth bare-gnawn and canker-bit:
Yet am I noble as the adversary
I come to cope.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Which is that adversary?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: What's he that speaks for Edmund Earl of Gloucester?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: Himself: what say'st thou to him?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Draw thy sword,
That, if my speech offend a noble heart,
Thy arm may do thee justice: here is mine.
Behold, it is the privilege of mine honours,
My oath, and my profession: I protest,
Maugre thy strength, youth, place, and eminence,
Despite thy victor sword and fire-new fortune,
Thy valour and thy heart, thou art a traitor;
False to thy gods, thy brother, and thy father;
Conspirant 'gainst this high-illustrious prince;
And, from the extremest upward of thy head
To the descent and dust below thy foot,
A most toad-spotted traitor. Say thou 'No,'
This sword, this arm, and my best spirits, are bent
To prove upon thy heart, whereto I speak,
Thou liest.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: In wisdom I should ask thy name;
But, since thy outside looks so fair and warlike,
And that thy tongue some say of breeding breathes,
What safe and nicely I might well delay
By rule of knighthood, I disdain and spurn:
Back do I toss these treasons to thy head;
With the hell-hated lie o'erwhelm thy heart;
Which, for they yet glance by and scarcely bruise,
This sword of mine shall give them instant way,
Where they shall rest for ever. Trumpets, speak!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Save him, save him!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: This is practise, Gloucester:
By the law of arms thou wast not bound to answer
An unknown opposite; thou art not vanquish'd,
But cozen'd and beguiled.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Shut your mouth, dame,
Or with this paper shall I stop it: Hold, sir:
Thou worse than any name, read thine own evil:
No tearing, lady: I perceive you know it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Say, if I do, the laws are mine, not thine:
Who can arraign me for't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Most monstrous! oh!
Know'st thou this paper?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONERIL
SPEECH.LINE: Ask me not what I know.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Go after her: she's desperate; govern her.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: What you have charged me with, that have I done;
And more, much more; the time will bring it out:
'Tis past, and so am I. But what art thou
That hast this fortune on me? If thou'rt noble,
I do forgive thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Let's exchange charity.
I am no less in blood than thou art, Edmund;
If more, the more thou hast wrong'd me.
My name is Edgar, and thy father's son.
The gods are just, and of our pleasant vices
Make instruments to plague us:
The dark and vicious place where thee he got
Cost him his eyes.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: Thou hast spoken right, 'tis true;
The wheel is come full circle: I am here.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Methought thy very gait did prophesy
A royal nobleness: I must embrace thee:
Let sorrow split my heart, if ever I
Did hate thee or thy father!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: Worthy prince, I know't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: Where have you hid yourself?
How have you known the miseries of your father?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: By nursing them, my lord. List a brief tale;
And when 'tis told, O, that my heart would burst!
The bloody proclamation to escape,
That follow'd me so near,--O, our lives' sweetness!
That we the pain of death would hourly die
Rather than die at once!--taught me to shift
Into a madman's rags; to assume a semblance
That very dogs disdain'd: and in this habit
Met I my father with his bleeding rings,
Their precious stones new lost: became his guide,
Led him, begg'd for him, saved him from despair;
Never,--O fault!--reveal'd myself unto him,
Until some half-hour past, when I was arm'd:
Not sure, though hoping, of this good success,
I ask'd his blessing, and from first to last
Told him my pilgrimage: but his flaw'd heart,
Alack, too weak the conflict to support!
'Twixt two extremes of passion, joy and grief,
Burst smilingly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDMUND
SPEECH.LINE: This speech of yours hath moved me,
And shall perchance do good: but speak you on;
You look as you had something more to say.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALBANY
SPEECH.LINE: If there be more, more woeful, hold it in;
For I am almost ready to dissolve,
Hearing of this.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EDGAR
SPEECH.LINE: This would have seem'd a period
To such as love not sorrow; but another,
To amplify too much, would make much more,
And top extremity.
