SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: 'Twas never merry world since, of two usuries, the
merriest was put down, and the worser allowed by
order of law a furred gown to keep him warm; and
furred with fox and lamb-skins too, to signify, that
craft, being richer than innocency, stands for the facing.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ELBOW
SPEECH.LINE: Come your way, sir. 'Bless you, good father friar.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: And you, good brother father. What offence hath
this man made you, sir?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ELBOW
SPEECH.LINE: Marry, sir, he hath offended the law: and, sir, we
take him to be a thief too, sir; for we have found
upon him, sir, a strange picklock, which we have
sent to the deputy.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Fie, sirrah! a bawd, a wicked bawd!
The evil that thou causest to be done,
That is thy means to live. Do thou but think
What 'tis to cram a maw or clothe a back
From such a filthy vice: say to thyself,
From their abominable and beastly touches
I drink, I eat, array myself, and live.
Canst thou believe thy living is a life,
So stinkingly depending? Go mend, go mend.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: Indeed, it does stink in some sort, sir; but yet,
sir, I would prove--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, if the devil have given thee proofs for sin,
Thou wilt prove his. Take him to prison, officer:
Correction and instruction must both work
Ere this rude beast will profit.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ELBOW
SPEECH.LINE: He must before the deputy, sir; he has given him
warning: the deputy cannot abide a whoremaster: if
he be a whoremonger, and comes before him, he were
as good go a mile on his errand.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: That we were all, as some would seem to be,
From our faults, as faults from seeming, free!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ELBOW
SPEECH.LINE: His neck will come to your waist,--a cord, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: I spy comfort; I cry bail. Here's a gentleman and a
friend of mine.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: How now, noble Pompey! What, at the wheels of
Caesar? art thou led in triumph? What, is there
none of Pygmalion's images, newly made woman, to be
had now, for putting the hand in the pocket and
extracting it clutch'd? What reply, ha? What
sayest thou to this tune, matter and method? Is't
not drowned i' the last rain, ha? What sayest
thou, Trot? Is the world as it was, man? Which is
the way? Is it sad, and few words? or how? The
trick of it?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Still thus, and thus; still worse!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: How doth my dear morsel, thy mistress? Procures she
still, ha?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: Troth, sir, she hath eaten up all her beef, and she
is herself in the tub.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, 'tis good; it is the right of it; it must be
so: ever your fresh whore and your powdered bawd:
an unshunned consequence; it must be so. Art going
to prison, Pompey?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: Yes, faith, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, 'tis not amiss, Pompey. Farewell: go, say I
sent thee thither. For debt, Pompey? or how?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ELBOW
SPEECH.LINE: For being a bawd, for being a bawd.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Well, then, imprison him: if imprisonment be the
due of a bawd, why, 'tis his right: bawd is he
doubtless, and of antiquity too; bawd-born.
Farewell, good Pompey. Commend me to the prison,
Pompey: you will turn good husband now, Pompey; you
will keep the house.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: I hope, sir, your good worship will be my bail.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: No, indeed, will I not, Pompey; it is not the wear.
I will pray, Pompey, to increase your bondage: If
you take it not patiently, why, your mettle is the
more. Adieu, trusty Pompey. 'Bless you, friar.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: And you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Does Bridget paint still, Pompey, ha?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ELBOW
SPEECH.LINE: Come your ways, sir; come.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: You will not bail me, then, sir?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Then, Pompey, nor now. What news abroad, friar?
what news?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ELBOW
SPEECH.LINE: Come your ways, sir; come.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Go to kennel, Pompey; go.
What news, friar, of the duke?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: I know none. Can you tell me of any?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Some say he is with the Emperor of Russia; other
some, he is in Rome: but where is he, think you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: I know not where; but wheresoever, I wish him well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: It was a mad fantastical trick of him to steal from
the state, and usurp the beggary he was never born
to. Lord Angelo dukes it well in his absence; he
puts transgression to 't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: He does well in 't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: A little more lenity to lechery would do no harm in
him: something too crabbed that way, friar.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: It is too general a vice, and severity must cure it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Yes, in good sooth, the vice is of a great kindred;
it is well allied: but it is impossible to extirp
it quite, friar, till eating and drinking be put
down. They say this Angelo was not made by man and
woman after this downright way of creation: is it
true, think you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: How should he be made, then?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Some report a sea-maid spawned him; some, that he
was begot between two stock-fishes. But it is
certain that when he makes water his urine is
congealed ice; that I know to be true: and he is a
motion generative; that's infallible.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: You are pleasant, sir, and speak apace.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, what a ruthless thing is this in him, for the
rebellion of a codpiece to take away the life of a
man! Would the duke that is absent have done this?
Ere he would have hanged a man for the getting a
hundred bastards, he would have paid for the nursing
a thousand: he had some feeling of the sport: he
knew the service, and that instructed him to mercy.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: I never heard the absent duke much detected for
women; he was not inclined that way.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: O, sir, you are deceived.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis not possible.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Who, not the duke? yes, your beggar of fifty; and
his use was to put a ducat in her clack-dish: the
duke had crotchets in him. He would be drunk too;
that let me inform you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: You do him wrong, surely.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, I was an inward of his. A shy fellow was the
duke: and I believe I know the cause of his
withdrawing.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: What, I prithee, might be the cause?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: No, pardon; 'tis a secret must be locked within the
teeth and the lips: but this I can let you
understand, the greater file of the subject held the
duke to be wise.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Wise! why, no question but he was.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: A very superficial, ignorant, unweighing fellow.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Either this is the envy in you, folly, or mistaking:
the very stream of his life and the business he hath
helmed must upon a warranted need give him a better
proclamation. Let him be but testimonied in his own
bringings-forth, and he shall appear to the
envious a scholar, a statesman and a soldier.
Therefore you speak unskilfully: or if your
knowledge be more it is much darkened in your malice.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, I know him, and I love him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Love talks with better knowledge, and knowledge with
dearer love.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Come, sir, I know what I know.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: I can hardly believe that, since you know not what
you speak. But, if ever the duke return, as our
prayers are he may, let me desire you to make your
answer before him. If it be honest you have spoke,
you have courage to maintain it: I am bound to call
upon you; and, I pray you, your name?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, my name is Lucio; well known to the duke.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: He shall know you better, sir, if I may live to
report you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: I fear you not.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: O, you hope the duke will return no more; or you
imagine me too unhurtful an opposite. But indeed I
can do you little harm; you'll forswear this again.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: I'll be hanged first: thou art deceived in me,
friar. But no more of this. Canst thou tell if
Claudio die to-morrow or no?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Why should he die, sir?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Why? For filling a bottle with a tundish. I would
the duke we talk of were returned again: the
ungenitured agent will unpeople the province with
continency; sparrows must not build in his
house-eaves, because they are lecherous. The duke
yet would have dark deeds darkly answered; he would
never bring them to light: would he were returned!
Marry, this Claudio is condemned for untrussing.
Farewell, good friar: I prithee, pray for me. The
duke, I say to thee again, would eat mutton on
Fridays. He's not past it yet, and I say to thee,
he would mouth with a beggar, though she smelt brown
bread and garlic: say that I said so. Farewell.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: No might nor greatness in mortality
Can censure 'scape; back-wounding calumny
The whitest virtue strikes. What king so strong
Can tie the gall up in the slanderous tongue?
But who comes here?

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter ESCALUS, Provost, and Officers with MISTRESS OVERDONE

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: Go; away with her to prison!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MISTRESS OVERDONE
SPEECH.LINE: Good my lord, be good to me; your honour is accounted
a merciful man; good my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: Double and treble admonition, and still forfeit in
the same kind! This would make mercy swear and play
the tyrant.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: A bawd of eleven years' continuance, may it please
your honour.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MISTRESS OVERDONE
SPEECH.LINE: My lord, this is one Lucio's information against me.
Mistress Kate Keepdown was with child by him in the
duke's time; he promised her marriage: his child
is a year and a quarter old, come Philip and Jacob:
I have kept it myself; and see how he goes about to abuse me!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: That fellow is a fellow of much licence: let him be
called before us. Away with her to prison! Go to;
no more words.
Provost, my brother Angelo will not be altered;
Claudio must die to-morrow: let him be furnished
with divines, and have all charitable preparation.
if my brother wrought by my pity, it should not be
so with him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: So please you, this friar hath been with him, and
advised him for the entertainment of death.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: Good even, good father.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Bliss and goodness on you!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: Of whence are you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Not of this country, though my chance is now
To use it for my time: I am a brother
Of gracious order, late come from the See
In special business from his holiness.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: What news abroad i' the world?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: None, but that there is so great a fever on
goodness, that the dissolution of it must cure it:
novelty is only in request; and it is as dangerous
to be aged in any kind of course, as it is virtuous
to be constant in any undertaking. There is scarce
truth enough alive to make societies secure; but
security enough to make fellowships accurst: much
upon this riddle runs the wisdom of the world. This
news is old enough, yet it is every day's news. I
pray you, sir, of what disposition was the duke?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: One that, above all other strifes, contended
especially to know himself.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: What pleasure was he given to?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: Rather rejoicing to see another merry, than merry at
any thing which professed to make him rejoice: a
gentleman of all temperance. But leave we him to
his events, with a prayer they may prove prosperous;
and let me desire to know how you find Claudio
prepared. I am made to understand that you have
lent him visitation.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: He professes to have received no sinister measure
from his judge, but most willingly humbles himself
to the determination of justice: yet had he framed
to himself, by the instruction of his frailty, many
deceiving promises of life; which I by my good
leisure have discredited to him, and now is he
resolved to die.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: You have paid the heavens your function, and the
prisoner the very debt of your calling. I have
laboured for the poor gentleman to the extremest
shore of my modesty: but my brother justice have I
found so severe, that he hath forced me to tell him
he is indeed Justice.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: If his own life answer the straitness of his
proceeding, it shall become him well; wherein if he
chance to fail, he hath sentenced himself.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: I am going to visit the prisoner. Fare you well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Peace be with you!
He who the sword of heaven will bear
Should be as holy as severe;
Pattern in himself to know,
Grace to stand, and virtue go;
More nor less to others paying
Than by self-offences weighing.
Shame to him whose cruel striking
Kills for faults of his own liking!
Twice treble shame on Angelo,
To weed my vice and let his grow!
O, what may man within him hide,
Though angel on the outward side!
How may likeness made in crimes,
Making practise on the times,
To draw with idle spiders' strings
Most ponderous and substantial things!
Craft against vice I must apply:
With Angelo to-night shall lie
His old betrothed but despised;
So disguise shall, by the disguised,
Pay with falsehood false exacting,
And perform an old contracting.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE I. The moated grange at ST. LUKE's.

SPEECH.LINE: Take, O, take those lips away,
That so sweetly were forsworn;
And those eyes, the break of day,
Lights that do mislead the morn:
But my kisses bring again, bring again;
Seals of love, but sealed in vain, sealed in vain.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: Break off thy song, and haste thee quick away:
Here comes a man of comfort, whose advice
Hath often still'd my brawling discontent.
SPEECH.STAGEDIR: Enter DUKE VINCENTIO disguised as before
SPEECH.LINE: I cry you mercy, sir; and well could wish
You had not found me here so musical:
Let me excuse me, and believe me so,
My mirth it much displeased, but pleased my woe.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis good; though music oft hath such a charm
To make bad good, and good provoke to harm.
I pray, you, tell me, hath any body inquired
for me here to-day? much upon this time have
I promised here to meet.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: You have not been inquired after:
I have sat here all day.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: I do constantly believe you. The time is come even
now. I shall crave your forbearance a little: may
be I will call upon you anon, for some advantage to yourself.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: I am always bound to you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Very well met, and well come.
What is the news from this good deputy?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: He hath a garden circummured with brick,
Whose western side is with a vineyard back'd;
And to that vineyard is a planched gate,
That makes his opening with this bigger key:
This other doth command a little door
Which from the vineyard to the garden leads;
There have I made my promise
Upon the heavy middle of the night
To call upon him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: But shall you on your knowledge find this way?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: I have ta'en a due and wary note upon't:
With whispering and most guilty diligence,
In action all of precept, he did show me
The way twice o'er.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Are there no other tokens
Between you 'greed concerning her observance?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: No, none, but only a repair i' the dark;
And that I have possess'd him my most stay
Can be but brief; for I have made him know
I have a servant comes with me along,
That stays upon me, whose persuasion is
I come about my brother.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis well borne up.
I have not yet made known to Mariana
A word of this. What, ho! within! come forth!
I pray you, be acquainted with this maid;
She comes to do you good.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: I do desire the like.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Do you persuade yourself that I respect you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: Good friar, I know you do, and have found it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Take, then, this your companion by the hand,
Who hath a story ready for your ear.
I shall attend your leisure: but make haste;
The vaporous night approaches.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: Will't please you walk aside?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: O place and greatness! millions of false eyes
Are stuck upon thee: volumes of report
Run with these false and most contrarious quests
Upon thy doings: thousand escapes of wit
Make thee the father of their idle dreams
And rack thee in their fancies.
Welcome, how agreed?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: She'll take the enterprise upon her, father,
If you advise it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: It is not my consent,
But my entreaty too.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: Little have you to say
When you depart from him, but, soft and low,
'Remember now my brother.'

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: Fear me not.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Nor, gentle daughter, fear you not at all.
He is your husband on a pre-contract:
To bring you thus together, 'tis no sin,
Sith that the justice of your title to him
Doth flourish the deceit. Come, let us go:
Our corn's to reap, for yet our tithe's to sow.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE II. A room in the prison.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Come hither, sirrah. Can you cut off a man's head?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: If the man be a bachelor, sir, I can; but if he be a
married man, he's his wife's head, and I can never
cut off a woman's head.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Come, sir, leave me your snatches, and yield me a
direct answer. To-morrow morning are to die Claudio
and Barnardine. Here is in our prison a common
executioner, who in his office lacks a helper: if
you will take it on you to assist him, it shall
redeem you from your gyves; if not, you shall have
your full time of imprisonment and your deliverance
with an unpitied whipping, for you have been a
notorious bawd.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, I have been an unlawful bawd time out of mind;
but yet I will be content to be a lawful hangman. I
would be glad to receive some instruction from my
fellow partner.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: What, ho! Abhorson! Where's Abhorson, there?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ABHORSON
SPEECH.LINE: Do you call, sir?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Sirrah, here's a fellow will help you to-morrow in
your execution. If you think it meet, compound with
him by the year, and let him abide here with you; if
not, use him for the present and dismiss him. He
cannot plead his estimation with you; he hath been a bawd.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ABHORSON
SPEECH.LINE: A bawd, sir? fie upon him! he will discredit our mystery.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Go to, sir; you weigh equally; a feather will turn
the scale.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: Pray, sir, by your good favour,--for surely, sir, a
good favour you have, but that you have a hanging
look,--do you call, sir, your occupation a mystery?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ABHORSON
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, sir; a mystery

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: Painting, sir, I have heard say, is a mystery; and
your whores, sir, being members of my occupation,
using painting, do prove my occupation a mystery:
but what mystery there should be in hanging, if I
should be hanged, I cannot imagine.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ABHORSON
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, it is a mystery.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: Proof?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ABHORSON
SPEECH.LINE: Every true man's apparel fits your thief: if it be
too little for your thief, your true man thinks it
big enough; if it be too big for your thief, your
thief thinks it little enough: so every true man's
apparel fits your thief.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Are you agreed?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, I will serve him; for I do find your hangman is
a more penitent trade than your bawd; he doth
oftener ask forgiveness.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: You, sirrah, provide your block and your axe
to-morrow four o'clock.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ABHORSON
SPEECH.LINE: Come on, bawd; I will instruct thee in my trade; follow.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: I do desire to learn, sir: and I hope, if you have
occasion to use me for your own turn, you shall find
me yare; for truly, sir, for your kindness I owe you
a good turn.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Call hither Barnardine and Claudio:
The one has my pity; not a jot the other,
Being a murderer, though he were my brother.
Look, here's the warrant, Claudio, for thy death:
'Tis now dead midnight, and by eight to-morrow
Thou must be made immortal. Where's Barnardine?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CLAUDIO
SPEECH.LINE: As fast lock'd up in sleep as guiltless labour
When it lies starkly in the traveller's bones:
He will not wake.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Who can do good on him?
Well, go, prepare yourself.
But, hark, what noise?
Heaven give your spirits comfort!
By and by.
I hope it is some pardon or reprieve
For the most gentle Claudio.
SPEECH.STAGEDIR: Enter DUKE VINCENTIO disguised as before
SPEECH.LINE: Welcome father.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: The best and wholesomest spirts of the night
Envelope you, good Provost! Who call'd here of late?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: None, since the curfew rung.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Not Isabel?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: No.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: They will, then, ere't be long.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: What comfort is for Claudio?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: There's some in hope.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: It is a bitter deputy.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Not so, not so; his life is parallel'd
Even with the stroke and line of his great justice:
He doth with holy abstinence subdue
That in himself which he spurs on his power
To qualify in others: were he meal'd with that
Which he corrects, then were he tyrannous;
But this being so, he's just.
Now are they come.
This is a gentle provost: seldom when
The steeled gaoler is the friend of men.
How now! what noise? That spirit's possessed with haste
That wounds the unsisting postern with these strokes.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: There he must stay until the officer
Arise to let him in: he is call'd up.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Have you no countermand for Claudio yet,
But he must die to-morrow?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: None, sir, none.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: As near the dawning, provost, as it is,
You shall hear more ere morning.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Happily
You something know; yet I believe there comes
No countermand; no such example have we:
Besides, upon the very siege of justice
Lord Angelo hath to the public ear
Profess'd the contrary.
This is his lordship's man.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: And here comes Claudio's pardon.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Messenger
SPEECH.LINE: My lord hath sent you this note; and by me this
further charge, that you swerve not from the
smallest article of it, neither in time, matter, or
other circumstance. Good morrow; for, as I take it,
it is almost day.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: I shall obey him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Aside This is his pardon, purchased by such sin
For which the pardoner himself is in.
Hence hath offence his quick celerity,
When it is born in high authority:
When vice makes mercy, mercy's so extended,
That for the fault's love is the offender friended.
Now, sir, what news?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: I told you. Lord Angelo, belike thinking me remiss
in mine office, awakens me with this unwonted
putting-on; methinks strangely, for he hath not used it before.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Pray you, let's hear.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: 'Whatsoever you may hear to the contrary, let
Claudio be executed by four of the clock; and in the
afternoon Barnardine: for my better satisfaction,
let me have Claudio's head sent me by five. Let
this be duly performed; with a thought that more
depends on it than we must yet deliver. Thus fail
not to do your office, as you will answer it at your peril.'
What say you to this, sir?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: What is that Barnardine who is to be executed in the
afternoon?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: A Bohemian born, but here nursed un and bred; one
that is a prisoner nine years old.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: How came it that the absent duke had not either
delivered him to his liberty or executed him? I
have heard it was ever his manner to do so.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: His friends still wrought reprieves for him: and,
indeed, his fact, till now in the government of Lord
Angelo, came not to an undoubtful proof.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: It is now apparent?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Most manifest, and not denied by himself.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Hath he born himself penitently in prison? how
seems he to be touched?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: A man that apprehends death no more dreadfully but
as a drunken sleep; careless, reckless, and fearless
of what's past, present, or to come; insensible of
mortality, and desperately mortal.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: He wants advice.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: He will hear none: he hath evermore had the liberty
of the prison; give him leave to escape hence, he
would not: drunk many times a day, if not many days
entirely drunk. We have very oft awaked him, as if
to carry him to execution, and showed him a seeming
warrant for it: it hath not moved him at all.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: More of him anon. There is written in your brow,
provost, honesty and constancy: if I read it not
truly, my ancient skill beguiles me; but, in the
boldness of my cunning, I will lay myself in hazard.
Claudio, whom here you have warrant to execute, is
no greater forfeit to the law than Angelo who hath
sentenced him. To make you understand this in a
manifested effect, I crave but four days' respite;
for the which you are to do me both a present and a
dangerous courtesy.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Pray, sir, in what?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: In the delaying death.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: A lack, how may I do it, having the hour limited,
and an express command, under penalty, to deliver
his head in the view of Angelo? I may make my case
as Claudio's, to cross this in the smallest.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: By the vow of mine order I warrant you, if my
instructions may be your guide. Let this Barnardine
be this morning executed, and his head born to Angelo.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Angelo hath seen them both, and will discover the favour.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: O, death's a great disguiser; and you may add to it.
Shave the head, and tie the beard; and say it was
the desire of the penitent to be so bared before his
death: you know the course is common. If any thing
fall to you upon this, more than thanks and good
fortune, by the saint whom I profess, I will plead
against it with my life.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Pardon me, good father; it is against my oath.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Were you sworn to the duke, or to the deputy?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: To him, and to his substitutes.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: You will think you have made no offence, if the duke
avouch the justice of your dealing?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: But what likelihood is in that?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Not a resemblance, but a certainty. Yet since I see
you fearful, that neither my coat, integrity, nor
persuasion can with ease attempt you, I will go
further than I meant, to pluck all fears out of you.
Look you, sir, here is the hand and seal of the
duke: you know the character, I doubt not; and the
signet is not strange to you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: I know them both.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: The contents of this is the return of the duke: you
shall anon over-read it at your pleasure; where you
shall find, within these two days he will be here.
This is a thing that Angelo knows not; for he this
very day receives letters of strange tenor;
perchance of the duke's death; perchance entering
into some monastery; but, by chance, nothing of what
is writ. Look, the unfolding star calls up the
shepherd. Put not yourself into amazement how these
things should be: all difficulties are but easy
when they are known. Call your executioner, and off
with Barnardine's head: I will give him a present
shrift and advise him for a better place. Yet you
are amazed; but this shall absolutely resolve you.
Come away; it is almost clear dawn.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE III. Another room in the same.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: I am as well acquainted here as I was in our house
of profession: one would think it were Mistress
Overdone's own house, for here be many of her old
customers. First, here's young Master Rash; he's in
for a commodity of brown paper and old ginger,
ninescore and seventeen pounds; of which he made
five marks, ready money: marry, then ginger was not
much in request, for the old women were all dead.
Then is there here one Master Caper, at the suit of
Master Three-pile the mercer, for some four suits of
peach-coloured satin, which now peaches him a
beggar. Then have we here young Dizy, and young
Master Deep-vow, and Master Copperspur, and Master
Starve-lackey the rapier and dagger man, and young
Drop-heir that killed lusty Pudding, and Master
Forthlight the tilter, and brave Master Shooty the
great traveller, and wild Half-can that stabbed
Pots, and, I think, forty more; all great doers in
our trade, and are now 'for the Lord's sake.'

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ABHORSON
SPEECH.LINE: Sirrah, bring Barnardine hither.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: Master Barnardine! you must rise and be hanged.
Master Barnardine!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ABHORSON
SPEECH.LINE: What, ho, Barnardine!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BARNARDINE
SPEECH.LINE: Within A pox o' your throats! Who makes that
noise there? What are you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: Your friends, sir; the hangman. You must be so
good, sir, to rise and be put to death.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BARNARDINE
SPEECH.LINE: Within Away, you rogue, away! I am sleepy.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ABHORSON
SPEECH.LINE: Tell him he must awake, and that quickly too.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: Pray, Master Barnardine, awake till you are
executed, and sleep afterwards.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ABHORSON
SPEECH.LINE: Go in to him, and fetch him out.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: He is coming, sir, he is coming; I hear his straw rustle.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ABHORSON
SPEECH.LINE: Is the axe upon the block, sirrah?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: Very ready, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BARNARDINE
SPEECH.LINE: How now, Abhorson? what's the news with you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ABHORSON
SPEECH.LINE: Truly, sir, I would desire you to clap into your
prayers; for, look you, the warrant's come.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BARNARDINE
SPEECH.LINE: You rogue, I have been drinking all night; I am not
fitted for 't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: POMPEY
SPEECH.LINE: O, the better, sir; for he that drinks all night,
and is hanged betimes in the morning, may sleep the
sounder all the next day.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ABHORSON
SPEECH.LINE: Look you, sir; here comes your ghostly father: do
we jest now, think you?

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter DUKE VINCENTIO disguised as before

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, induced by my charity, and hearing how hastily
you are to depart, I am come to advise you, comfort
you and pray with you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BARNARDINE
SPEECH.LINE: Friar, not I I have been drinking hard all night,
and I will have more time to prepare me, or they
shall beat out my brains with billets: I will not
consent to die this day, that's certain.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: O, sir, you must: and therefore I beseech you
Look forward on the journey you shall go.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BARNARDINE
SPEECH.LINE: I swear I will not die to-day for any man's
persuasion.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: But hear you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BARNARDINE
SPEECH.LINE: Not a word: if you have any thing to say to me,
come to my ward; for thence will not I to-day.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Unfit to live or die: O gravel heart!
After him, fellows; bring him to the block.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Now, sir, how do you find the prisoner?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: A creature unprepared, unmeet for death;
And to transport him in the mind he is
Were damnable.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Here in the prison, father,
There died this morning of a cruel fever
One Ragozine, a most notorious pirate,
A man of Claudio's years; his beard and head
Just of his colour. What if we do omit
This reprobate till he were well inclined;
And satisfy the deputy with the visage
Of Ragozine, more like to Claudio?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: O, 'tis an accident that heaven provides!
Dispatch it presently; the hour draws on
Prefix'd by Angelo: see this be done,
And sent according to command; whiles I
Persuade this rude wretch willingly to die.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: This shall be done, good father, presently.
But Barnardine must die this afternoon:
And how shall we continue Claudio,
To save me from the danger that might come
If he were known alive?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Let this be done.
Put them in secret holds, both Barnardine and Claudio:
Ere twice the sun hath made his journal greeting
To the under generation, you shall find
Your safety manifested.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: I am your free dependant.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Quick, dispatch, and send the head to Angelo.
Now will I write letters to Angelo,--
The provost, he shall bear them, whose contents
Shall witness to him I am near at home,
And that, by great injunctions, I am bound
To enter publicly: him I'll desire
To meet me at the consecrated fount
A league below the city; and from thence,
By cold gradation and well-balanced form,
We shall proceed with Angelo.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Here is the head; I'll carry it myself.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Convenient is it. Make a swift return;
For I would commune with you of such things
That want no ear but yours.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: I'll make all speed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: Within Peace, ho, be here!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: The tongue of Isabel. She's come to know
If yet her brother's pardon be come hither:
But I will keep her ignorant of her good,
To make her heavenly comforts of despair,
When it is least expected.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: Ho, by your leave!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Good morning to you, fair and gracious daughter.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: The better, given me by so holy a man.
Hath yet the deputy sent my brother's pardon?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: He hath released him, Isabel, from the world:
His head is off and sent to Angelo.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, but it is not so.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: It is no other: show your wisdom, daughter,
In your close patience.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: O, I will to him and pluck out his eyes!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: You shall not be admitted to his sight.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: Unhappy Claudio! wretched Isabel!
Injurious world! most damned Angelo!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: This nor hurts him nor profits you a jot;
Forbear it therefore; give your cause to heaven.
Mark what I say, which you shall find
By every syllable a faithful verity:
The duke comes home to-morrow; nay, dry your eyes;
One of our convent, and his confessor,
Gives me this instance: already he hath carried
Notice to Escalus and Angelo,
Who do prepare to meet him at the gates,
There to give up their power. If you can, pace your wisdom
In that good path that I would wish it go,
And you shall have your bosom on this wretch,
Grace of the duke, revenges to your heart,
And general honour.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: I am directed by you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: This letter, then, to Friar Peter give;
'Tis that he sent me of the duke's return:
Say, by this token, I desire his company
At Mariana's house to-night. Her cause and yours
I'll perfect him withal, and he shall bring you
Before the duke, and to the head of Angelo
Accuse him home and home. For my poor self,
I am combined by a sacred vow
And shall be absent. Wend you with this letter:
Command these fretting waters from your eyes
With a light heart; trust not my holy order,
If I pervert your course. Who's here?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Good even. Friar, where's the provost?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Not within, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: O pretty Isabella, I am pale at mine heart to see
thine eyes so red: thou must be patient. I am fain
to dine and sup with water and bran; I dare not for
my head fill my belly; one fruitful meal would set
me to 't. But they say the duke will be here
to-morrow. By my troth, Isabel, I loved thy brother:
if the old fantastical duke of dark corners had been
at home, he had lived.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, the duke is marvellous little beholding to your
reports; but the best is, he lives not in them.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Friar, thou knowest not the duke so well as I do:
he's a better woodman than thou takest him for.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Well, you'll answer this one day. Fare ye well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, tarry; I'll go along with thee
I can tell thee pretty tales of the duke.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: You have told me too many of him already, sir, if
they be true; if not true, none were enough.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: I was once before him for getting a wench with child.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Did you such a thing?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Yes, marry, did I but I was fain to forswear it;
they would else have married me to the rotten medlar.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, your company is fairer than honest. Rest you well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: By my troth, I'll go with thee to the lane's end:
if bawdy talk offend you, we'll have very little of
it. Nay, friar, I am a kind of burr; I shall stick.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE IV. A room in ANGELO's house.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: Every letter he hath writ hath disvouched other.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: In most uneven and distracted manner. His actions
show much like to madness: pray heaven his wisdom be
not tainted! And why meet him at the gates, and
redeliver our authorities there

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: I guess not.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: And why should we proclaim it in an hour before his
entering, that if any crave redress of injustice,
they should exhibit their petitions in the street?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: He shows his reason for that: to have a dispatch of
complaints, and to deliver us from devices
hereafter, which shall then have no power to stand
against us.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: Well, I beseech you, let it be proclaimed betimes
i' the morn; I'll call you at your house: give
notice to such men of sort and suit as are to meet
him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: I shall, sir. Fare you well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: Good night.
This deed unshapes me quite, makes me unpregnant
And dull to all proceedings. A deflower'd maid!
And by an eminent body that enforced
The law against it! But that her tender shame
Will not proclaim against her maiden loss,
How might she tongue me! Yet reason dares her no;
For my authority bears of a credent bulk,
That no particular scandal once can touch
But it confounds the breather. He should have lived,
Save that riotous youth, with dangerous sense,
Might in the times to come have ta'en revenge,
By so receiving a dishonour'd life
With ransom of such shame. Would yet he had lived!
A lack, when once our grace we have forgot,
Nothing goes right: we would, and we would not.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE V. Fields without the town.
SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter DUKE VINCENTIO in his own habit, and FRIAR PETER

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: These letters at fit time deliver me
The provost knows our purpose and our plot.
The matter being afoot, keep your instruction,
And hold you ever to our special drift;
Though sometimes you do blench from this to that,
As cause doth minister. Go call at Flavius' house,
And tell him where I stay: give the like notice
To Valentinus, Rowland, and to Crassus,
And bid them bring the trumpets to the gate;
But send me Flavius first.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FRIAR PETER
SPEECH.LINE: It shall be speeded well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: I thank thee, Varrius; thou hast made good haste:
Come, we will walk. There's other of our friends
Will greet us here anon, my gentle Varrius.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE VI. Street near the city gate.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: To speak so indirectly I am loath:
I would say the truth; but to accuse him so,
That is your part: yet I am advised to do it;
He says, to veil full purpose.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: Be ruled by him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: Besides, he tells me that, if peradventure
He speak against me on the adverse side,
I should not think it strange; for 'tis a physic
That's bitter to sweet end.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: I would Friar Peter--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: O, peace! the friar is come.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FRIAR PETER
SPEECH.LINE: Come, I have found you out a stand most fit,
Where you may have such vantage on the duke,
He shall not pass you. Twice have the trumpets sounded;
The generous and gravest citizens
Have hent the gates, and very near upon
The duke is entering: therefore, hence, away!

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE I. The city gate.
SCENE.STAGEDIR: MARIANA veiled, ISABELLA, and FRIAR PETER, at their stand. Enter DUKE VINCENTIO, VARRIUS, Lords, ANGELO, ESCALUS, LUCIO, Provost, Officers, and Citizens, at several doors

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: My very worthy cousin, fairly met!
Our old and faithful friend, we are glad to see you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: Happy return be to your royal grace!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Many and hearty thankings to you both.
We have made inquiry of you; and we hear
Such goodness of your justice, that our soul
Cannot but yield you forth to public thanks,
Forerunning more requital.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: You make my bonds still greater.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: O, your desert speaks loud; and I should wrong it,
To lock it in the wards of covert bosom,
When it deserves, with characters of brass,
A forted residence 'gainst the tooth of time
And razure of oblivion. Give me your hand,
And let the subject see, to make them know
That outward courtesies would fain proclaim
Favours that keep within. Come, Escalus,
You must walk by us on our other hand;
And good supporters are you.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: FRIAR PETER and ISABELLA come forward

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FRIAR PETER
SPEECH.LINE: Now is your time: speak loud and kneel before him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: Justice, O royal duke! Vail your regard
Upon a wrong'd, I would fain have said, a maid!
O worthy prince, dishonour not your eye
By throwing it on any other object
Till you have heard me in my true complaint
And given me justice, justice, justice, justice!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Relate your wrongs; in what? by whom? be brief.
Here is Lord Angelo shall give you justice:
Reveal yourself to him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: O worthy duke,
You bid me seek redemption of the devil:
Hear me yourself; for that which I must speak
Must either punish me, not being believed,
Or wring redress from you. Hear me, O hear me, here!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: My lord, her wits, I fear me, are not firm:
She hath been a suitor to me for her brother
Cut off by course of justice,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: By course of justice!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: And she will speak most bitterly and strange.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: Most strange, but yet most truly, will I speak:
That Angelo's forsworn; is it not strange?
That Angelo's a murderer; is 't not strange?
That Angelo is an adulterous thief,
An hypocrite, a virgin-violator;
Is it not strange and strange?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, it is ten times strange.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: It is not truer he is Angelo
Than this is all as true as it is strange:
Nay, it is ten times true; for truth is truth
To the end of reckoning.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Away with her! Poor soul,
She speaks this in the infirmity of sense.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: O prince, I conjure thee, as thou believest
There is another comfort than this world,
That thou neglect me not, with that opinion
That I am touch'd with madness! Make not impossible
That which but seems unlike: 'tis not impossible
But one, the wicked'st caitiff on the ground,
May seem as shy, as grave, as just, as absolute
As Angelo; even so may Angelo,
In all his dressings, characts, titles, forms,
Be an arch-villain; believe it, royal prince:
If he be less, he's nothing; but he's more,
Had I more name for badness.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: By mine honesty,
If she be mad,--as I believe no other,--
Her madness hath the oddest frame of sense,
Such a dependency of thing on thing,
As e'er I heard in madness.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: O gracious duke,
Harp not on that, nor do not banish reason
For inequality; but let your reason serve
To make the truth appear where it seems hid,
And hide the false seems true.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Many that are not mad
Have, sure, more lack of reason. What would you say?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: I am the sister of one Claudio,
Condemn'd upon the act of fornication
To lose his head; condemn'd by Angelo:
I, in probation of a sisterhood,
Was sent to by my brother; one Lucio
As then the messenger,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: That's I, an't like your grace:
I came to her from Claudio, and desired her
To try her gracious fortune with Lord Angelo
For her poor brother's pardon.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: That's he indeed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: You were not bid to speak.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: No, my good lord;
Nor wish'd to hold my peace.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: I wish you now, then;
Pray you, take note of it: and when you have
A business for yourself, pray heaven you then
Be perfect.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: I warrant your honour.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: The warrants for yourself; take heed to't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: This gentleman told somewhat of my tale,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Right.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: It may be right; but you are i' the wrong
To speak before your time. Proceed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: I went
To this pernicious caitiff deputy,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: That's somewhat madly spoken.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: Pardon it;
The phrase is to the matter.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Mended again. The matter; proceed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: In brief, to set the needless process by,
How I persuaded, how I pray'd, and kneel'd,
How he refell'd me, and how I replied,--
For this was of much length,--the vile conclusion
I now begin with grief and shame to utter:
He would not, but by gift of my chaste body
To his concupiscible intemperate lust,
Release my brother; and, after much debatement,
My sisterly remorse confutes mine honour,
And I did yield to him: but the next morn betimes,
His purpose surfeiting, he sends a warrant
For my poor brother's head.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: This is most likely!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: O, that it were as like as it is true!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: By heaven, fond wretch, thou knowist not what thou speak'st,
Or else thou art suborn'd against his honour
In hateful practise. First, his integrity
Stands without blemish. Next, it imports no reason
That with such vehemency he should pursue
Faults proper to himself: if he had so offended,
He would have weigh'd thy brother by himself
And not have cut him off. Some one hath set you on:
Confess the truth, and say by whose advice
Thou camest here to complain.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: And is this all?
Then, O you blessed ministers above,
Keep me in patience, and with ripen'd time
Unfold the evil which is here wrapt up
In countenance! Heaven shield your grace from woe,
As I, thus wrong'd, hence unbelieved go!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: I know you'ld fain be gone. An officer!
To prison with her! Shall we thus permit
A blasting and a scandalous breath to fall
On him so near us? This needs must be a practise.
Who knew of Your intent and coming hither?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: One that I would were here, Friar Lodowick.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: A ghostly father, belike. Who knows that Lodowick?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: My lord, I know him; 'tis a meddling friar;
I do not like the man: had he been lay, my lord
For certain words he spake against your grace
In your retirement, I had swinged him soundly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Words against me? this is a good friar, belike!
And to set on this wretched woman here
Against our substitute! Let this friar be found.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: But yesternight, my lord, she and that friar,
I saw them at the prison: a saucy friar,
A very scurvy fellow.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FRIAR PETER
SPEECH.LINE: Blessed be your royal grace!
I have stood by, my lord, and I have heard
Your royal ear abused. First, hath this woman
Most wrongfully accused your substitute,
Who is as free from touch or soil with her
As she from one ungot.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: We did believe no less.
Know you that Friar Lodowick that she speaks of?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FRIAR PETER
SPEECH.LINE: I know him for a man divine and holy;
Not scurvy, nor a temporary meddler,
As he's reported by this gentleman;
And, on my trust, a man that never yet
Did, as he vouches, misreport your grace.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: My lord, most villanously; believe it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FRIAR PETER
SPEECH.LINE: Well, he in time may come to clear himself;
But at this instant he is sick my lord,
Of a strange fever. Upon his mere request,
Being come to knowledge that there was complaint
Intended 'gainst Lord Angelo, came I hither,
To speak, as from his mouth, what he doth know
Is true and false; and what he with his oath
And all probation will make up full clear,
Whensoever he's convented. First, for this woman.
To justify this worthy nobleman,
So vulgarly and personally accused,
Her shall you hear disproved to her eyes,
Till she herself confess it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Good friar, let's hear it.
SPEECH.STAGEDIR: ISABELLA is carried off guarded; and MARIANA comes forward
SPEECH.LINE: Do you not smile at this, Lord Angelo?
O heaven, the vanity of wretched fools!
Give us some seats. Come, cousin Angelo;
In this I'll be impartial; be you judge
Of your own cause. Is this the witness, friar?
First, let her show her face, and after speak.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: Pardon, my lord; I will not show my face
Until my husband bid me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: What, are you married?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: No, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Are you a maid?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: No, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: A widow, then?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: Neither, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, you are nothing then: neither maid, widow, nor wife?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: My lord, she may be a punk; for many of them are
neither maid, widow, nor wife.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Silence that fellow: I would he had some cause
To prattle for himself.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Well, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: My lord; I do confess I ne'er was married;
And I confess besides I am no maid:
I have known my husband; yet my husband
Knows not that ever he knew me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: He was drunk then, my lord: it can be no better.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: For the benefit of silence, would thou wert so too!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Well, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: This is no witness for Lord Angelo.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: Now I come to't my lord
She that accuses him of fornication,
In self-same manner doth accuse my husband,
And charges him my lord, with such a time
When I'll depose I had him in mine arms
With all the effect of love.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: Charges she more than me?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: Not that I know.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: No? you say your husband.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: Why, just, my lord, and that is Angelo,
Who thinks he knows that he ne'er knew my body,
But knows he thinks that he knows Isabel's.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: This is a strange abuse. Let's see thy face.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: My husband bids me; now I will unmask.
This is that face, thou cruel Angelo,
Which once thou sworest was worth the looking on;
This is the hand which, with a vow'd contract,
Was fast belock'd in thine; this is the body
That took away the match from Isabel,
And did supply thee at thy garden-house
In her imagined person.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Know you this woman?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Carnally, she says.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Sirrah, no more!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Enough, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: My lord, I must confess I know this woman:
And five years since there was some speech of marriage
Betwixt myself and her; which was broke off,
Partly for that her promised proportions
Came short of composition, but in chief
For that her reputation was disvalued
In levity: since which time of five years
I never spake with her, saw her, nor heard from her,
Upon my faith and honour.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: Noble prince,
As there comes light from heaven and words from breath,
As there is sense in truth and truth in virtue,
I am affianced this man's wife as strongly
As words could make up vows: and, my good lord,
But Tuesday night last gone in's garden-house
He knew me as a wife. As this is true,
Let me in safety raise me from my knees
Or else for ever be confixed here,
A marble monument!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: I did but smile till now:
Now, good my lord, give me the scope of justice
My patience here is touch'd. I do perceive
These poor informal women are no more
But instruments of some more mightier member
That sets them on: let me have way, my lord,
To find this practise out.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, with my heart
And punish them to your height of pleasure.
Thou foolish friar, and thou pernicious woman,
Compact with her that's gone, think'st thou thy oaths,
Though they would swear down each particular saint,
Were testimonies against his worth and credit
That's seal'd in approbation? You, Lord Escalus,
Sit with my cousin; lend him your kind pains
To find out this abuse, whence 'tis derived.
There is another friar that set them on;
Let him be sent for.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FRIAR PETER
SPEECH.LINE: Would he were here, my lord! for he indeed
Hath set the women on to this complaint:
Your provost knows the place where he abides
And he may fetch him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Go do it instantly.
And you, my noble and well-warranted cousin,
Whom it concerns to hear this matter forth,
Do with your injuries as seems you best,
In any chastisement: I for a while will leave you;
But stir not you till you have well determined
Upon these slanderers.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: My lord, we'll do it throughly.
Signior Lucio, did not you say you knew that
Friar Lodowick to be a dishonest person?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Cucullus non facit monachum:' honest in nothing
but in his clothes; and one that hath spoke most
villanous speeches of the duke.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: We shall entreat you to abide here till he come and
enforce them against him: we shall find this friar a
notable fellow.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: As any in Vienna, on my word.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: Call that same Isabel here once again; I would speak with her.
Pray you, my lord, give me leave to question; you
shall see how I'll handle her.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Not better than he, by her own report.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: Say you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Marry, sir, I think, if you handled her privately,
she would sooner confess: perchance, publicly,
she'll be ashamed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: I will go darkly to work with her.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: That's the way; for women are light at midnight.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Re-enter Officers with ISABELLA; and Provost with the DUKE VINCENTIO in his friar's habit

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: Come on, mistress: here's a gentlewoman denies all
that you have said.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: My lord, here comes the rascal I spoke of; here with
the provost.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: In very good time: speak not you to him till we
call upon you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Mum.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: Come, sir: did you set these women on to slander
Lord Angelo? they have confessed you did.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis false.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: How! know you where you are?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Respect to your great place! and let the devil
Be sometime honour'd for his burning throne!
Where is the duke? 'tis he should hear me speak.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: The duke's in us; and we will hear you speak:
Look you speak justly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Boldly, at least. But, O, poor souls,
Come you to seek the lamb here of the fox?
Good night to your redress! Is the duke gone?
Then is your cause gone too. The duke's unjust,
Thus to retort your manifest appeal,
And put your trial in the villain's mouth
Which here you come to accuse.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: This is the rascal; this is he I spoke of.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: Why, thou unreverend and unhallow'd friar,
Is't not enough thou hast suborn'd these women
To accuse this worthy man, but, in foul mouth
And in the witness of his proper ear,
To call him villain? and then to glance from him
To the duke himself, to tax him with injustice?
Take him hence; to the rack with him! We'll touse you
Joint by joint, but we will know his purpose.
What 'unjust'!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Be not so hot; the duke
Dare no more stretch this finger of mine than he
Dare rack his own: his subject am I not,
Nor here provincial. My business in this state
Made me a looker on here in Vienna,
Where I have seen corruption boil and bubble
Till it o'er-run the stew; laws for all faults,
But faults so countenanced, that the strong statutes
Stand like the forfeits in a barber's shop,
As much in mock as mark.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: Slander to the state! Away with him to prison!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: What can you vouch against him, Signior Lucio?
Is this the man that you did tell us of?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis he, my lord. Come hither, goodman baldpate:
do you know me?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: I remember you, sir, by the sound of your voice: I
met you at the prison, in the absence of the duke.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: O, did you so? And do you remember what you said of the duke?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Most notedly, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Do you so, sir? And was the duke a fleshmonger, a
fool, and a coward, as you then reported him to be?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: You must, sir, change persons with me, ere you make
that my report: you, indeed, spoke so of him; and
much more, much worse.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: O thou damnable fellow! Did not I pluck thee by the
nose for thy speeches?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: I protest I love the duke as I love myself.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: Hark, how the villain would close now, after his
treasonable abuses!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: Such a fellow is not to be talked withal. Away with
him to prison! Where is the provost? Away with him
to prison! lay bolts enough upon him: let him
speak no more. Away with those giglots too, and
with the other confederate companion!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: To Provost Stay, sir; stay awhile.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: What, resists he? Help him, Lucio.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Come, sir; come, sir; come, sir; foh, sir! Why, you
bald-pated, lying rascal, you must be hooded, must
you? Show your knave's visage, with a pox to you!
show your sheep-biting face, and be hanged an hour!
Will't not off?

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Pulls off the friar's hood, and discovers DUKE VINCENTIO

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Thou art the first knave that e'er madest a duke.
First, provost, let me bail these gentle three.
Sneak not away, sir; for the friar and you
Must have a word anon. Lay hold on him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: This may prove worse than hanging.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: To ESCALUS What you have spoke I pardon: sit you down:
We'll borrow place of him.
Sir, by your leave.
Hast thou or word, or wit, or impudence,
That yet can do thee office? If thou hast,
Rely upon it till my tale be heard,
And hold no longer out.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: O my dread lord,
I should be guiltier than my guiltiness,
To think I can be undiscernible,
When I perceive your grace, like power divine,
Hath look'd upon my passes. Then, good prince,
No longer session hold upon my shame,
But let my trial be mine own confession:
Immediate sentence then and sequent death
Is all the grace I beg.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Come hither, Mariana.
Say, wast thou e'er contracted to this woman?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: I was, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Go take her hence, and marry her instantly.
Do you the office, friar; which consummate,
Return him here again. Go with him, provost.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Exeunt ANGELO, MARIANA, FRIAR PETER and Provost

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: My lord, I am more amazed at his dishonour
Than at the strangeness of it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Come hither, Isabel.
Your friar is now your prince: as I was then
Advertising and holy to your business,
Not changing heart with habit, I am still
Attorney'd at your service.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: O, give me pardon,
That I, your vassal, have employ'd and pain'd
Your unknown sovereignty!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: You are pardon'd, Isabel:
And now, dear maid, be you as free to us.
Your brother's death, I know, sits at your heart;
And you may marvel why I obscured myself,
Labouring to save his life, and would not rather
Make rash remonstrance of my hidden power
Than let him so be lost. O most kind maid,
It was the swift celerity of his death,
Which I did think with slower foot came on,
That brain'd my purpose. But, peace be with him!
That life is better life, past fearing death,
Than that which lives to fear: make it your comfort,
So happy is your brother.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: I do, my lord.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Re-enter ANGELO, MARIANA, FRIAR PETER, and Provost

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: For this new-married man approaching here,
Whose salt imagination yet hath wrong'd
Your well defended honour, you must pardon
For Mariana's sake: but as he adjudged your brother,--
Being criminal, in double violation
Of sacred chastity and of promise-breach
Thereon dependent, for your brother's life,--
The very mercy of the law cries out
Most audible, even from his proper tongue,
'An Angelo for Claudio, death for death!'
Haste still pays haste, and leisure answers leisure;
Like doth quit like, and MEASURE still FOR MEASURE.
Then, Angelo, thy fault's thus manifested;
Which, though thou wouldst deny, denies thee vantage.
We do condemn thee to the very block
Where Claudio stoop'd to death, and with like haste.
Away with him!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: O my most gracious lord,
I hope you will not mock me with a husband.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: It is your husband mock'd you with a husband.
Consenting to the safeguard of your honour,
I thought your marriage fit; else imputation,
For that he knew you, might reproach your life
And choke your good to come; for his possessions,
Although by confiscation they are ours,
We do instate and widow you withal,
To buy you a better husband.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: O my dear lord,
I crave no other, nor no better man.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Never crave him; we are definitive.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: Gentle my liege,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: You do but lose your labour.
Away with him to death!
Now, sir, to you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: O my good lord! Sweet Isabel, take my part;
Lend me your knees, and all my life to come
I'll lend you all my life to do you service.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Against all sense you do importune her:
Should she kneel down in mercy of this fact,
Her brother's ghost his paved bed would break,
And take her hence in horror.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: Isabel,
Sweet Isabel, do yet but kneel by me;
Hold up your hands, say nothing; I'll speak all.
They say, best men are moulded out of faults;
And, for the most, become much more the better
For being a little bad: so may my husband.
O Isabel, will you not lend a knee?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: He dies for Claudio's death.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ISABELLA
SPEECH.LINE: Most bounteous sir,
Look, if it please you, on this man condemn'd,
As if my brother lived: I partly think
A due sincerity govern'd his deeds,
Till he did look on me: since it is so,
Let him not die. My brother had but justice,
In that he did the thing for which he died:
For Angelo,
His act did not o'ertake his bad intent,
And must be buried but as an intent
That perish'd by the way: thoughts are no subjects;
Intents but merely thoughts.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MARIANA
SPEECH.LINE: Merely, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Your suit's unprofitable; stand up, I say.
I have bethought me of another fault.
Provost, how came it Claudio was beheaded
At an unusual hour?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: It was commanded so.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Had you a special warrant for the deed?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: No, my good lord; it was by private message.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: For which I do discharge you of your office:
Give up your keys.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: Pardon me, noble lord:
I thought it was a fault, but knew it not;
Yet did repent me, after more advice;
For testimony whereof, one in the prison,
That should by private order else have died,
I have reserved alive.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: What's he?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: His name is Barnardine.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: I would thou hadst done so by Claudio.
Go fetch him hither; let me look upon him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ESCALUS
SPEECH.LINE: I am sorry, one so learned and so wise
As you, Lord Angelo, have still appear'd,
Should slip so grossly, both in the heat of blood.
And lack of temper'd judgment afterward.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANGELO
SPEECH.LINE: I am sorry that such sorrow I procure:
And so deep sticks it in my penitent heart
That I crave death more willingly than mercy;
'Tis my deserving, and I do entreat it.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Re-enter Provost, with BARNARDINE, CLAUDIO muffled, and JULIET

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Which is that Barnardine?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: This, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: There was a friar told me of this man.
Sirrah, thou art said to have a stubborn soul.
That apprehends no further than this world,
And squarest thy life according. Thou'rt condemn'd:
But, for those earthly faults, I quit them all;
And pray thee take this mercy to provide
For better times to come. Friar, advise him;
I leave him to your hand. What muffled fellow's that?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Provost
SPEECH.LINE: This is another prisoner that I saved.
Who should have died when Claudio lost his head;
As like almost to Claudio as himself.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: To ISABELLA If he be like your brother, for his sake
Is he pardon'd; and, for your lovely sake,
Give me your hand and say you will be mine.
He is my brother too: but fitter time for that.
By this Lord Angelo perceives he's safe;
Methinks I see a quickening in his eye.
Well, Angelo, your evil quits you well:
Look that you love your wife; her worth worth yours.
I find an apt remission in myself;
And yet here's one in place I cannot pardon.
You, sirrah, that knew me for a fool, a coward,
One all of luxury, an ass, a madman;
Wherein have I so deserved of you,
That you extol me thus?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Faith, my lord. I spoke it but according to the
trick. If you will hang me for it, you may; but I
had rather it would please you I might be whipt.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Whipt first, sir, and hanged after.
Proclaim it, provost, round about the city.
Is any woman wrong'd by this lewd fellow,
As I have heard him swear himself there's one
Whom he begot with child, let her appear,
And he shall marry her: the nuptial finish'd,
Let him be whipt and hang'd.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: I beseech your highness, do not marry me to a whore.
Your highness said even now, I made you a duke:
good my lord, do not recompense me in making me a cuckold.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Upon mine honour, thou shalt marry her.
Thy slanders I forgive; and therewithal
Remit thy other forfeits. Take him to prison;
And see our pleasure herein executed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LUCIO
SPEECH.LINE: Marrying a punk, my lord, is pressing to death,
whipping, and hanging.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DUKE VINCENTIO
SPEECH.LINE: Slandering a prince deserves it.
She, Claudio, that you wrong'd, look you restore.
Joy to you, Mariana! Love her, Angelo:
I have confess'd her and I know her virtue.
Thanks, good friend Escalus, for thy much goodness:
There's more behind that is more gratulate.
Thanks, provost, for thy care and secrecy:
We shill employ thee in a worthier place.
Forgive him, Angelo, that brought you home
The head of Ragozine for Claudio's:
The offence pardons itself. Dear Isabel,
I have a motion much imports your good;
Whereto if you'll a willing ear incline,
What's mine is yours and what is yours is mine.
So, bring us to our palace; where we'll show
What's yet behind, that's meet you all should know.

PERSONAE.TITLE: Dramatis Personae
PERSONAE.PERSONA: WILLIAM PAGE, a boy, son to Page.
SIR HUGH EVANS, a Welsh parson.
MISTRESS QUICKLY, servant to Doctor Caius.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE I. Windsor. Before PAGE's house.
SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter SHALLOW, SLENDER, and SIR HUGH EVANS

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: Sir Hugh, persuade me not; I will make a Star-
chamber matter of it: if he were twenty Sir John
Falstaffs, he shall not abuse Robert Shallow, esquire.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SLENDER
SPEECH.LINE: In the county of Gloucester, justice of peace and
'Coram.'

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, cousin Slender, and 'Custalourum.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SLENDER
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, and 'Rato-lorum' too; and a gentleman born,
master parson; who writes himself 'Armigero,' in any
bill, warrant, quittance, or obligation, 'Armigero.'

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, that I do; and have done any time these three
hundred years.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SLENDER
SPEECH.LINE: All his successors gone before him hath done't; and
all his ancestors that come after him may: they may
give the dozen white luces in their coat.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: It is an old coat.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SIR HUGH EVANS
SPEECH.LINE: The dozen white louses do become an old coat well;
it agrees well, passant; it is a familiar beast to
man, and signifies love.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: The luce is the fresh fish; the salt fish is an old coat.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SLENDER
SPEECH.LINE: I may quarter, coz.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: You may, by marrying.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SIR HUGH EVANS
SPEECH.LINE: It is marring indeed, if he quarter it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: Not a whit.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SIR HUGH EVANS
SPEECH.LINE: Yes, py'r lady; if he has a quarter of your coat,
there is but three skirts for yourself, in my
simple conjectures: but that is all one. If Sir
John Falstaff have committed disparagements unto
you, I am of the church, and will be glad to do my
benevolence to make atonements and compremises
between you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: The council shall bear it; it is a riot.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SIR HUGH EVANS
SPEECH.LINE: It is not meet the council hear a riot; there is no
fear of Got in a riot: the council, look you, shall
desire to hear the fear of Got, and not to hear a
riot; take your vizaments in that.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: Ha! o' my life, if I were young again, the sword
should end it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SIR HUGH EVANS
SPEECH.LINE: It is petter that friends is the sword, and end it:
and there is also another device in my prain, which
peradventure prings goot discretions with it: there
is Anne Page, which is daughter to Master Thomas
Page, which is pretty virginity.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SLENDER
SPEECH.LINE: Mistress Anne Page? She has brown hair, and speaks
small like a woman.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SIR HUGH EVANS
SPEECH.LINE: It is that fery person for all the orld, as just as
you will desire; and seven hundred pounds of moneys,
and gold and silver, is her grandsire upon his
death's-bed--Got deliver to a joyful resurrections!
--give, when she is able to overtake seventeen years
old: it were a goot motion if we leave our pribbles
and prabbles, and desire a marriage between Master
Abraham and Mistress Anne Page.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SLENDER
SPEECH.LINE: Did her grandsire leave her seven hundred pound?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SIR HUGH EVANS
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, and her father is make her a petter penny.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SLENDER
SPEECH.LINE: I know the young gentlewoman; she has good gifts.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SIR HUGH EVANS
SPEECH.LINE: Seven hundred pounds and possibilities is goot gifts.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: Well, let us see honest Master Page. Is Falstaff there?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SIR HUGH EVANS
SPEECH.LINE: Shall I tell you a lie? I do despise a liar as I do
despise one that is false, or as I despise one that
is not true. The knight, Sir John, is there; and, I
beseech you, be ruled by your well-willers. I will
peat the door for Master Page.
What, hoa! Got pless your house here!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PAGE
SPEECH.LINE: Within Who's there?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SIR HUGH EVANS
SPEECH.LINE: Here is Got's plessing, and your friend, and Justice
Shallow; and here young Master Slender, that
peradventures shall tell you another tale, if
matters grow to your likings.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PAGE
SPEECH.LINE: I am glad to see your worships well.
I thank you for my venison, Master Shallow.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: Master Page, I am glad to see you: much good do it
your good heart! I wished your venison better; it
was ill killed. How doth good Mistress Page?--and I
thank you always with my heart, la! with my heart.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PAGE
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, I thank you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, I thank you; by yea and no, I do.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PAGE
SPEECH.LINE: I am glad to see you, good Master Slender.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SLENDER
SPEECH.LINE: How does your fallow greyhound, sir? I heard say he
was outrun on Cotsall.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PAGE
SPEECH.LINE: It could not be judged, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SLENDER
SPEECH.LINE: You'll not confess, you'll not confess.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: That he will not. 'Tis your fault, 'tis your fault;
'tis a good dog.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PAGE
SPEECH.LINE: A cur, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, he's a good dog, and a fair dog: can there be
more said? he is good and fair. Is Sir John
Falstaff here?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PAGE
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, he is within; and I would I could do a good
office between you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SIR HUGH EVANS
SPEECH.LINE: It is spoke as a Christians ought to speak.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SHALLOW
SPEECH.LINE: He hath wronged me, Master Page.
