The meat it feeds on; that cuckold lives in bliss
Who, certain of his fate, loves not his wronger;
But, O, what damned minutes tells he o'er
Who dotes, yet doubts, suspects, yet strongly loves!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: O misery!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Poor and content is rich and rich enough,
But riches fineless is as poor as winter
To him that ever fears he shall be poor.
Good heaven, the souls of all my tribe defend
From jealousy!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, why is this?
Think'st thou I'ld make a lie of jealousy,
To follow still the changes of the moon
With fresh suspicions? No; to be once in doubt
Is once to be resolved: exchange me for a goat,
When I shall turn the business of my soul
To such exsufflicate and blown surmises,
Matching thy inference. 'Tis not to make me jealous
To say my wife is fair, feeds well, loves company,
Is free of speech, sings, plays and dances well;
Where virtue is, these are more virtuous:
Nor from mine own weak merits will I draw
The smallest fear or doubt of her revolt;
For she had eyes, and chose me. No, Iago;
I'll see before I doubt; when I doubt, prove;
And on the proof, there is no more but this,--
Away at once with love or jealousy!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I am glad of it; for now I shall have reason
To show the love and duty that I bear you
With franker spirit: therefore, as I am bound,
Receive it from me. I speak not yet of proof.
Look to your wife; observe her well with Cassio;
Wear your eye thus, not jealous nor secure:
I would not have your free and noble nature,
Out of self-bounty, be abused; look to't:
I know our country disposition well;
In Venice they do let heaven see the pranks
They dare not show their husbands; their best conscience
Is not to leave't undone, but keep't unknown.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Dost thou say so?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: She did deceive her father, marrying you;
And when she seem'd to shake and fear your looks,
She loved them most.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: And so she did.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, go to then;
She that, so young, could give out such a seeming,
To seal her father's eyes up close as oak-
He thought 'twas witchcraft--but I am much to blame;
I humbly do beseech you of your pardon
For too much loving you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I am bound to thee for ever.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I see this hath a little dash'd your spirits.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Not a jot, not a jot.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I' faith, I fear it has.
I hope you will consider what is spoke
Comes from my love. But I do see you're moved:
I am to pray you not to strain my speech
To grosser issues nor to larger reach
Than to suspicion.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I will not.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Should you do so, my lord,
My speech should fall into such vile success
As my thoughts aim not at. Cassio's my worthy friend--
My lord, I see you're moved.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: No, not much moved:
I do not think but Desdemona's honest.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Long live she so! and long live you to think so!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: And yet, how nature erring from itself,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, there's the point: as--to be bold with you--
Not to affect many proposed matches
Of her own clime, complexion, and degree,
Whereto we see in all things nature tends--
Foh! one may smell in such a will most rank,
Foul disproportion thoughts unnatural.
But pardon me; I do not in position
Distinctly speak of her; though I may fear
Her will, recoiling to her better judgment,
May fall to match you with her country forms
And happily repent.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Farewell, farewell:
If more thou dost perceive, let me know more;
Set on thy wife to observe: leave me, Iago:

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Going My lord, I take my leave.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Why did I marry? This honest creature doubtless
Sees and knows more, much more, than he unfolds.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Returning My lord, I would I might entreat
your honour
To scan this thing no further; leave it to time:
Though it be fit that Cassio have his place,
For sure, he fills it up with great ability,
Yet, if you please to hold him off awhile,
You shall by that perceive him and his means:
Note, if your lady strain his entertainment
With any strong or vehement importunity;
Much will be seen in that. In the mean time,
Let me be thought too busy in my fears--
As worthy cause I have to fear I am--
And hold her free, I do beseech your honour.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Fear not my government.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I once more take my leave.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: This fellow's of exceeding honesty,
And knows all qualities, with a learned spirit,
Of human dealings. If I do prove her haggard,
Though that her jesses were my dear heartstrings,
I'ld whistle her off and let her down the wind,
To pray at fortune. Haply, for I am black
And have not those soft parts of conversation
That chamberers have, or for I am declined
Into the vale of years,--yet that's not much--
She's gone. I am abused; and my relief
Must be to loathe her. O curse of marriage,
That we can call these delicate creatures ours,
And not their appetites! I had rather be a toad,
And live upon the vapour of a dungeon,
Than keep a corner in the thing I love
For others' uses. Yet, 'tis the plague of great ones;
Prerogatived are they less than the base;
'Tis destiny unshunnable, like death:
Even then this forked plague is fated to us
When we do quicken. Desdemona comes:
If she be false, O, then heaven mocks itself!
I'll not believe't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: How now, my dear Othello!
Your dinner, and the generous islanders
By you invited, do attend your presence.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I am to blame.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Why do you speak so faintly?
Are you not well?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I have a pain upon my forehead here.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: 'Faith, that's with watching; 'twill away again:
Let me but bind it hard, within this hour
It will be well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Your napkin is too little:
SPEECH.STAGEDIR: He puts the handkerchief from him; and it drops
SPEECH.LINE: Let it alone. Come, I'll go in with you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I am very sorry that you are not well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: I am glad I have found this napkin:
This was her first remembrance from the Moor:
My wayward husband hath a hundred times
Woo'd me to steal it; but she so loves the token,
For he conjured her she should ever keep it,
That she reserves it evermore about her
To kiss and talk to. I'll have the work ta'en out,
And give't Iago: what he will do with it
Heaven knows, not I;
I nothing but to please his fantasy.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: How now! what do you here alone?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Do not you chide; I have a thing for you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: A thing for me? it is a common thing--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Ha!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: To have a foolish wife.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: O, is that all? What will you give me now
For the same handkerchief?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: What handkerchief?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: What handkerchief?
Why, that the Moor first gave to Desdemona;
That which so often you did bid me steal.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Hast stol'n it from her?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: No, 'faith; she let it drop by negligence.
And, to the advantage, I, being here, took't up.
Look, here it is.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: A good wench; give it me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: What will you do with 't, that you have been
so earnest
To have me filch it?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Snatching it Why, what's that to you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: If it be not for some purpose of import,
Give't me again: poor lady, she'll run mad
When she shall lack it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Be not acknown on 't; I have use for it.
Go, leave me.
I will in Cassio's lodging lose this napkin,
And let him find it. Trifles light as air
Are to the jealous confirmations strong
As proofs of holy writ: this may do something.
The Moor already changes with my poison:
Dangerous conceits are, in their natures, poisons.
Which at the first are scarce found to distaste,
But with a little act upon the blood.
Burn like the mines of Sulphur. I did say so:
Look, where he comes!
Not poppy, nor mandragora,
Nor all the drowsy syrups of the world,
Shall ever medicine thee to that sweet sleep
Which thou owedst yesterday.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Ha! ha! false to me?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, how now, general! no more of that.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Avaunt! be gone! thou hast set me on the rack:
I swear 'tis better to be much abused
Than but to know't a little.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: How now, my lord!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: What sense had I of her stol'n hours of lust?
I saw't not, thought it not, it harm'd not me:
I slept the next night well, was free and merry;
I found not Cassio's kisses on her lips:
He that is robb'd, not wanting what is stol'n,
Let him not know't, and he's not robb'd at all.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I am sorry to hear this.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I had been happy, if the general camp,
Pioners and all, had tasted her sweet body,
So I had nothing known. O, now, for ever
Farewell the tranquil mind! farewell content!
Farewell the plumed troop, and the big wars,
That make ambition virtue! O, farewell!
Farewell the neighing steed, and the shrill trump,
The spirit-stirring drum, the ear-piercing fife,
The royal banner, and all quality,
Pride, pomp and circumstance of glorious war!
And, O you mortal engines, whose rude throats
The immortal Jove's dead clamours counterfeit,
Farewell! Othello's occupation's gone!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Is't possible, my lord?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Villain, be sure thou prove my love a whore,
Be sure of it; give me the ocular proof:
Or by the worth of man's eternal soul,
Thou hadst been better have been born a dog
Than answer my waked wrath!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Is't come to this?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Make me to see't; or, at the least, so prove it,
That the probation bear no hinge nor loop
To hang a doubt on; or woe upon thy life!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: My noble lord,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: If thou dost slander her and torture me,
Never pray more; abandon all remorse;
On horror's head horrors accumulate;
Do deeds to make heaven weep, all earth amazed;
For nothing canst thou to damnation add
Greater than that.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: O grace! O heaven forgive me!
Are you a man? have you a soul or sense?
God be wi' you; take mine office. O wretched fool.
That livest to make thine honesty a vice!
O monstrous world! Take note, take note, O world,
To be direct and honest is not safe.
I thank you for this profit; and from hence
I'll love no friend, sith love breeds such offence.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, stay: thou shouldst be honest.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I should be wise, for honesty's a fool
And loses that it works for.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: By the world,
I think my wife be honest and think she is not;
I think that thou art just and think thou art not.
I'll have some proof. Her name, that was as fresh
As Dian's visage, is now begrimed and black
As mine own face. If there be cords, or knives,
Poison, or fire, or suffocating streams,
I'll not endure it. Would I were satisfied!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I see, sir, you are eaten up with passion:
I do repent me that I put it to you.
You would be satisfied?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Would! nay, I will.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: And may: but, how? how satisfied, my lord?
Would you, the supervisor, grossly gape on--
Behold her topp'd?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Death and damnation! O!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: It were a tedious difficulty, I think,
To bring them to that prospect: damn them then,
If ever mortal eyes do see them bolster
More than their own! What then? how then?
What shall I say? Where's satisfaction?
It is impossible you should see this,
Were they as prime as goats, as hot as monkeys,
As salt as wolves in pride, and fools as gross
As ignorance made drunk. But yet, I say,
If imputation and strong circumstances,
Which lead directly to the door of truth,
Will give you satisfaction, you may have't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Give me a living reason she's disloyal.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I do not like the office:
But, sith I am enter'd in this cause so far,
Prick'd to't by foolish honesty and love,
I will go on. I lay with Cassio lately;
And, being troubled with a raging tooth,
I could not sleep.
There are a kind of men so loose of soul,
That in their sleeps will mutter their affairs:
One of this kind is Cassio:
In sleep I heard him say 'Sweet Desdemona,
Let us be wary, let us hide our loves;'
And then, sir, would he gripe and wring my hand,
Cry 'O sweet creature!' and then kiss me hard,
As if he pluck'd up kisses by the roots
That grew upon my lips: then laid his leg
Over my thigh, and sigh'd, and kiss'd; and then
Cried 'Cursed fate that gave thee to the Moor!'

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: O monstrous! monstrous!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, this was but his dream.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: But this denoted a foregone conclusion:
'Tis a shrewd doubt, though it be but a dream.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: And this may help to thicken other proofs
That do demonstrate thinly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I'll tear her all to pieces.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, but be wise: yet we see nothing done;
She may be honest yet. Tell me but this,
Have you not sometimes seen a handkerchief
Spotted with strawberries in your wife's hand?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I gave her such a one; 'twas my first gift.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I know not that; but such a handkerchief--
I am sure it was your wife's--did I to-day
See Cassio wipe his beard with.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: If it be that--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: If it be that, or any that was hers,
It speaks against her with the other proofs.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: O, that the slave had forty thousand lives!
One is too poor, too weak for my revenge.
Now do I see 'tis true. Look here, Iago;
All my fond love thus do I blow to heaven.
'Tis gone.
Arise, black vengeance, from thy hollow cell!
Yield up, O love, thy crown and hearted throne
To tyrannous hate! Swell, bosom, with thy fraught,
For 'tis of aspics' tongues!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Yet be content.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: O, blood, blood, blood!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Patience, I say; your mind perhaps may change.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Never, Iago: Like to the Pontic sea,
Whose icy current and compulsive course
Ne'er feels retiring ebb, but keeps due on
To the Propontic and the Hellespont,
Even so my bloody thoughts, with violent pace,
Shall ne'er look back, ne'er ebb to humble love,
Till that a capable and wide revenge
Swallow them up. Now, by yond marble heaven,
In the due reverence of a sacred vow
I here engage my words.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Do not rise yet.
Witness, you ever-burning lights above,
You elements that clip us round about,
Witness that here Iago doth give up
The execution of his wit, hands, heart,
To wrong'd Othello's service! Let him command,
And to obey shall be in me remorse,
What bloody business ever.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I greet thy love,
Not with vain thanks, but with acceptance bounteous,
And will upon the instant put thee to't:
Within these three days let me hear thee say
That Cassio's not alive.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: My friend is dead; 'tis done at your request:
But let her live.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Damn her, lewd minx! O, damn her!
Come, go with me apart; I will withdraw,
To furnish me with some swift means of death
For the fair devil. Now art thou my lieutenant.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I am your own for ever.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE IV. Before the castle.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Do you know, sirrah, where Lieutenant Cassio lies?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Clown
SPEECH.LINE: I dare not say he lies any where.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Why, man?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Clown
SPEECH.LINE: He's a soldier, and for one to say a soldier lies,
is stabbing.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Go to: where lodges he?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Clown
SPEECH.LINE: To tell you where he lodges, is to tell you where I lie.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Can any thing be made of this?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Clown
SPEECH.LINE: I know not where he lodges, and for me to devise a
lodging and say he lies here or he lies there, were
to lie in mine own throat.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Can you inquire him out, and be edified by report?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Clown
SPEECH.LINE: I will catechise the world for him; that is, make
questions, and by them answer.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Seek him, bid him come hither: tell him I have
moved my lord on his behalf, and hope all will be well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: Clown
SPEECH.LINE: To do this is within the compass of man's wit: and
therefore I will attempt the doing it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Where should I lose that handkerchief, Emilia?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: I know not, madam.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Believe me, I had rather have lost my purse
Full of crusadoes: and, but my noble Moor
Is true of mind and made of no such baseness
As jealous creatures are, it were enough
To put him to ill thinking.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Is he not jealous?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Who, he? I think the sun where he was born
Drew all such humours from him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Look, where he comes.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I will not leave him now till Cassio
Be call'd to him.
How is't with you, my lord

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Well, my good lady.
O, hardness to dissemble!--
How do you, Desdemona?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Well, my good lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Give me your hand: this hand is moist, my lady.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: It yet hath felt no age nor known no sorrow.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: This argues fruitfulness and liberal heart:
Hot, hot, and moist: this hand of yours requires
A sequester from liberty, fasting and prayer,
Much castigation, exercise devout;
For here's a young and sweating devil here,
That commonly rebels. 'Tis a good hand,
A frank one.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: You may, indeed, say so;
For 'twas that hand that gave away my heart.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: A liberal hand: the hearts of old gave hands;
But our new heraldry is hands, not hearts.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I cannot speak of this. Come now, your promise.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: What promise, chuck?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I have sent to bid Cassio come speak with you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I have a salt and sorry rheum offends me;
Lend me thy handkerchief.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Here, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: That which I gave you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I have it not about me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Not?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: No, indeed, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: That is a fault.
That handkerchief
Did an Egyptian to my mother give;
She was a charmer, and could almost read
The thoughts of people: she told her, while
she kept it,
'Twould make her amiable and subdue my father
Entirely to her love, but if she lost it
Or made gift of it, my father's eye
Should hold her loathed and his spirits should hunt
After new fancies: she, dying, gave it me;
And bid me, when my fate would have me wive,
To give it her. I did so: and take heed on't;
Make it a darling like your precious eye;
To lose't or give't away were such perdition
As nothing else could match.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Is't possible?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis true: there's magic in the web of it:
A sibyl, that had number'd in the world
The sun to course two hundred compasses,
In her prophetic fury sew'd the work;
The worms were hallow'd that did breed the silk;
And it was dyed in mummy which the skilful
Conserved of maidens' hearts.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Indeed! is't true?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Most veritable; therefore look to't well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Then would to God that I had never seen't!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Ha! wherefore?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Why do you speak so startingly and rash?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Is't lost? is't gone? speak, is it out
o' the way?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Heaven bless us!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Say you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: It is not lost; but what an if it were?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: How!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I say, it is not lost.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Fetch't, let me see't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Why, so I can, sir, but I will not now.
This is a trick to put me from my suit:
Pray you, let Cassio be received again.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Fetch me the handkerchief: my mind misgives.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Come, come;
You'll never meet a more sufficient man.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: The handkerchief!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I pray, talk me of Cassio.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: The handkerchief!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: A man that all his time
Hath founded his good fortunes on your love,
Shared dangers with you,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: The handkerchief!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: In sooth, you are to blame.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Away!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Is not this man jealous?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I ne'er saw this before.
Sure, there's some wonder in this handkerchief:
I am most unhappy in the loss of it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis not a year or two shows us a man:
They are all but stomachs, and we all but food;
To eat us hungerly, and when they are full,
They belch us. Look you, Cassio and my husband!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: There is no other way; 'tis she must do't:
And, lo, the happiness! go, and importune her.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: How now, good Cassio! what's the news with you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: Madam, my former suit: I do beseech you
That by your virtuous means I may again
Exist, and be a member of his love
Whom I with all the office of my heart
Entirely honour: I would not be delay'd.
If my offence be of such mortal kind
That nor my service past, nor present sorrows,
Nor purposed merit in futurity,
Can ransom me into his love again,
But to know so must be my benefit;
So shall I clothe me in a forced content,
And shut myself up in some other course,
To fortune's alms.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Alas, thrice-gentle Cassio!
My advocation is not now in tune;
My lord is not my lord; nor should I know him,
Were he in favour as in humour alter'd.
So help me every spirit sanctified,
As I have spoken for you all my best
And stood within the blank of his displeasure
For my free speech! you must awhile be patient:
What I can do I will; and more I will
Than for myself I dare: let that suffice you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Is my lord angry?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: He went hence but now,
And certainly in strange unquietness.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Can he be angry? I have seen the cannon,
When it hath blown his ranks into the air,
And, like the devil, from his very arm
Puff'd his own brother:--and can he be angry?
Something of moment then: I will go meet him:
There's matter in't indeed, if he be angry.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I prithee, do so.
Something, sure, of state,
Either from Venice, or some unhatch'd practise
Made demonstrable here in Cyprus to him,
Hath puddled his clear spirit: and in such cases
Men's natures wrangle with inferior things,
Though great ones are their object. 'Tis even so;
For let our finger ache, and it indues
Our other healthful members even to that sense
Of pain: nay, we must think men are not gods,
Nor of them look for such observances
As fit the bridal. Beshrew me much, Emilia,
I was, unhandsome warrior as I am,
Arraigning his unkindness with my soul;
But now I find I had suborn'd the witness,
And he's indicted falsely.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Pray heaven it be state-matters, as you think,
And no conception nor no jealous toy
Concerning you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Alas the day! I never gave him cause.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: But jealous souls will not be answer'd so;
They are not ever jealous for the cause,
But jealous for they are jealous: 'tis a monster
Begot upon itself, born on itself.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Heaven keep that monster from Othello's mind!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Lady, amen.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I will go seek him. Cassio, walk hereabout:
If I do find him fit, I'll move your suit
And seek to effect it to my uttermost.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: I humbly thank your ladyship.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: Save you, friend Cassio!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: What make you from home?
How is it with you, my most fair Bianca?
I' faith, sweet love, I was coming to your house.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: And I was going to your lodging, Cassio.
What, keep a week away? seven days and nights?
Eight score eight hours? and lovers' absent hours,
More tedious than the dial eight score times?
O weary reckoning!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: Pardon me, Bianca:
I have this while with leaden thoughts been press'd:
But I shall, in a more continuate time,
Strike off this score of absence. Sweet Bianca,
Take me this work out.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: O Cassio, whence came this?
This is some token from a newer friend:
To the felt absence now I feel a cause:
Is't come to this? Well, well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: Go to, woman!
Throw your vile guesses in the devil's teeth,
From whence you have them. You are jealous now
That this is from some mistress, some remembrance:
No, in good troth, Bianca.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: Why, whose is it?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: I know not, sweet: I found it in my chamber.
I like the work well: ere it be demanded--
As like enough it will--I'ld have it copied:
Take it, and do't; and leave me for this time.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: Leave you! wherefore?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: I do attend here on the general;
And think it no addition, nor my wish,
To have him see me woman'd.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: Why, I pray you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: Not that I love you not.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: But that you do not love me.
I pray you, bring me on the way a little,
And say if I shall see you soon at night.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis but a little way that I can bring you;
For I attend here: but I'll see you soon.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis very good; I must be circumstanced.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE I. Cyprus. Before the castle.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Will you think so?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Think so, Iago!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: What,
To kiss in private?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: An unauthorized kiss.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Or to be naked with her friend in bed
An hour or more, not meaning any harm?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Naked in bed, Iago, and not mean harm!
It is hypocrisy against the devil:
They that mean virtuously, and yet do so,
The devil their virtue tempts, and they tempt heaven.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: So they do nothing, 'tis a venial slip:
But if I give my wife a handkerchief,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: What then?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, then, 'tis hers, my lord; and, being hers,
She may, I think, bestow't on any man.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: She is protectress of her honour too:
May she give that?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Her honour is an essence that's not seen;
They have it very oft that have it not:
But, for the handkerchief,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: By heaven, I would most gladly have forgot it.
Thou said'st, it comes o'er my memory,
As doth the raven o'er the infected house,
Boding to all--he had my handkerchief.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, what of that?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: That's not so good now.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: What,
If I had said I had seen him do you wrong?
Or heard him say,--as knaves be such abroad,
Who having, by their own importunate suit,
Or voluntary dotage of some mistress,
Convinced or supplied them, cannot choose
But they must blab--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Hath he said any thing?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: He hath, my lord; but be you well assured,
No more than he'll unswear.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: What hath he said?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Faith, that he did--I know not what he did.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: What? what?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Lie--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: With her?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: With her, on her; what you will.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Lie with her! lie on her! We say lie on her, when
they belie her. Lie with her! that's fulsome.
--Handkerchief--confessions--handkerchief!--To
confess, and be hanged for his labour;--first, to be
hanged, and then to confess.--I tremble at it.
Nature would not invest herself in such shadowing
passion without some instruction. It is not words
that shake me thus. Pish! Noses, ears, and lips.
--Is't possible?--Confess--handkerchief!--O devil!--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Work on,
My medicine, work! Thus credulous fools are caught;
And many worthy and chaste dames even thus,
All guiltless, meet reproach. What, ho! my lord!
My lord, I say! Othello!
How now, Cassio!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: What's the matter?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: My lord is fall'n into an epilepsy:
This is his second fit; he had one yesterday.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: Rub him about the temples.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: No, forbear;
The lethargy must have his quiet course:
If not, he foams at mouth and by and by
Breaks out to savage madness. Look he stirs:
Do you withdraw yourself a little while,
He will recover straight: when he is gone,
I would on great occasion speak with you.
How is it, general? have you not hurt your head?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Dost thou mock me?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I mock you! no, by heaven.
Would you would bear your fortune like a man!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: A horned man's a monster and a beast.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: There's many a beast then in a populous city,
And many a civil monster.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Did he confess it?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Good sir, be a man;
Think every bearded fellow that's but yoked
May draw with you: there's millions now alive
That nightly lie in those unproper beds
Which they dare swear peculiar: your case is better.
O, 'tis the spite of hell, the fiend's arch-mock,
To lip a wanton in a secure couch,
And to suppose her chaste! No, let me know;
And knowing what I am, I know what she shall be.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: O, thou art wise; 'tis certain.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Stand you awhile apart;
Confine yourself but in a patient list.
Whilst you were here o'erwhelmed with your grief--
A passion most unsuiting such a man--
Cassio came hither: I shifted him away,
And laid good 'scuse upon your ecstasy,
Bade him anon return and here speak with me;
The which he promised. Do but encave yourself,
And mark the fleers, the gibes, and notable scorns,
That dwell in every region of his face;
For I will make him tell the tale anew,
Where, how, how oft, how long ago, and when
He hath, and is again to cope your wife:
I say, but mark his gesture. Marry, patience;
Or I shall say you are all in all in spleen,
And nothing of a man.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Dost thou hear, Iago?
I will be found most cunning in my patience;
But--dost thou hear?--most bloody.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: That's not amiss;
But yet keep time in all. Will you withdraw?
Now will I question Cassio of Bianca,
A housewife that by selling her desires
Buys herself bread and clothes: it is a creature
That dotes on Cassio; as 'tis the strumpet's plague
To beguile many and be beguiled by one:
He, when he hears of her, cannot refrain
From the excess of laughter. Here he comes:
As he shall smile, Othello shall go mad;
And his unbookish jealousy must construe
Poor Cassio's smiles, gestures and light behavior,
Quite in the wrong. How do you now, lieutenant?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: The worser that you give me the addition
Whose want even kills me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Ply Desdemona well, and you are sure on't.
Now, if this suit lay in Bianco's power,
How quickly should you speed!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: Alas, poor caitiff!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Look, how he laughs already!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I never knew woman love man so.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: Alas, poor rogue! I think, i' faith, she loves me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Now he denies it faintly, and laughs it out.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Do you hear, Cassio?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Now he importunes him
To tell it o'er: go to; well said, well said.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: She gives it out that you shall marry hey:
Do you intend it?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: Ha, ha, ha!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Do you triumph, Roman? do you triumph?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: I marry her! what? a customer! Prithee, bear some
charity to my wit: do not think it so unwholesome.
Ha, ha, ha!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: So, so, so, so: they laugh that win.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Faith, the cry goes that you shall marry her.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: Prithee, say true.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I am a very villain else.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Have you scored me? Well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: This is the monkey's own giving out: she is
persuaded I will marry her, out of her own love and
flattery, not out of my promise.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Iago beckons me; now he begins the story.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: She was here even now; she haunts me in every place.
I was the other day talking on the sea-bank with
certain Venetians; and thither comes the bauble,
and, by this hand, she falls me thus about my neck--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Crying 'O dear Cassio!' as it were: his gesture
imports it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: So hangs, and lolls, and weeps upon me; so hales,
and pulls me: ha, ha, ha!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Now he tells how she plucked him to my chamber. O,
I see that nose of yours, but not that dog I shall
throw it to.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: Well, I must leave her company.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Before me! look, where she comes.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis such another fitchew! marry a perfumed one.
What do you mean by this haunting of me?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: Let the devil and his dam haunt you! What did you
mean by that same handkerchief you gave me even now?
I was a fine fool to take it. I must take out the
work?--A likely piece of work, that you should find
it in your chamber, and not know who left it there!
This is some minx's token, and I must take out the
work? There; give it your hobby-horse: wheresoever
you had it, I'll take out no work on't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: How now, my sweet Bianca! how now! how now!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: By heaven, that should be my handkerchief!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: An you'll come to supper to-night, you may; an you
will not, come when you are next prepared for.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: After her, after her.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Faith, I must; she'll rail in the street else.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Will you sup there?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Faith, I intend so.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Well, I may chance to see you; for I would very fain
speak with you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: Prithee, come; will you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Go to; say no more.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Advancing How shall I murder him, Iago?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Did you perceive how he laughed at his vice?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: O Iago!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: And did you see the handkerchief?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Was that mine?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Yours by this hand: and to see how he prizes the
foolish woman your wife! she gave it him, and he
hath given it his whore.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I would have him nine years a-killing.
A fine woman! a fair woman! a sweet woman!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, you must forget that.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, let her rot, and perish, and be damned to-night;
for she shall not live: no, my heart is turned to
stone; I strike it, and it hurts my hand. O, the
world hath not a sweeter creature: she might lie by
an emperor's side and command him tasks.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, that's not your way.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Hang her! I do but say what she is: so delicate
with her needle: an admirable musician: O! she
will sing the savageness out of a bear: of so high
and plenteous wit and invention:--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: She's the worse for all this.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: O, a thousand thousand times: and then, of so
gentle a condition!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, too gentle.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, that's certain: but yet the pity of it, Iago!
O Iago, the pity of it, Iago!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: If you are so fond over her iniquity, give her
patent to offend; for, if it touch not you, it comes
near nobody.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I will chop her into messes: cuckold me!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: O, 'tis foul in her.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: With mine officer!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: That's fouler.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Get me some poison, Iago; this night: I'll not
expostulate with her, lest her body and beauty
unprovide my mind again: this night, Iago.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Do it not with poison, strangle her in her bed, even
the bed she hath contaminated.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Good, good: the justice of it pleases: very good.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: And for Cassio, let me be his undertaker: you
shall hear more by midnight.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Excellent good.
What trumpet is that same?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Something from Venice, sure. 'Tis Lodovico
Come from the duke: and, see, your wife is with him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: Save you, worthy general!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: With all my heart, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: The duke and senators of Venice greet you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I kiss the instrument of their pleasures.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: And what's the news, good cousin Lodovico?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I am very glad to see you, signior
Welcome to Cyprus.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: I thank you. How does Lieutenant Cassio?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Lives, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Cousin, there's fall'n between him and my lord
An unkind breach: but you shall make all well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Are you sure of that?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: My lord?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Reads 'This fail you not to do, as you will--'

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: He did not call; he's busy in the paper.
Is there division 'twixt my lord and Cassio?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: A most unhappy one: I would do much
To atone them, for the love I bear to Cassio.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Fire and brimstone!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: My lord?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Are you wise?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: What, is he angry?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: May be the letter moved him;
For, as I think, they do command him home,
Deputing Cassio in his government.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Trust me, I am glad on't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Indeed!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: My lord?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I am glad to see you mad.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Why, sweet Othello,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Striking her Devil!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I have not deserved this.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: My lord, this would not be believed in Venice,
Though I should swear I saw't: 'tis very much:
Make her amends; she weeps.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: O devil, devil!
If that the earth could teem with woman's tears,
Each drop she falls would prove a crocodile.
Out of my sight!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I will not stay to offend you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: Truly, an obedient lady:
I do beseech your lordship, call her back.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Mistress!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: My lord?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: What would you with her, sir?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: Who, I, my lord?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay; you did wish that I would make her turn:
Sir, she can turn, and turn, and yet go on,
And turn again; and she can weep, sir, weep;
And she's obedient, as you say, obedient,
Very obedient. Proceed you in your tears.
Concerning this, sir,--O well-painted passion!--
I am commanded home. Get you away;
I'll send for you anon. Sir, I obey the mandate,
And will return to Venice. Hence, avaunt!
Cassio shall have my place. And, sir, tonight,
I do entreat that we may sup together:
You are welcome, sir, to Cyprus.--Goats and monkeys!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: Is this the noble Moor whom our full senate
Call all in all sufficient? Is this the nature
Whom passion could not shake? whose solid virtue
The shot of accident, nor dart of chance,
Could neither graze nor pierce?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: He is much changed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: Are his wits safe? is he not light of brain?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: He's that he is: I may not breathe my censure
What he might be: if what he might he is not,
I would to heaven he were!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: What, strike his wife!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Faith, that was not so well; yet would I knew
That stroke would prove the worst!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: Is it his use?
Or did the letters work upon his blood,
And new-create this fault?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Alas, alas!
It is not honesty in me to speak
What I have seen and known. You shall observe him,
And his own courses will denote him so
That I may save my speech: do but go after,
And mark how he continues.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: I am sorry that I am deceived in him.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE II. A room in the castle.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: You have seen nothing then?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Nor ever heard, nor ever did suspect.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Yes, you have seen Cassio and she together.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: But then I saw no harm, and then I heard
Each syllable that breath made up between them.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: What, did they never whisper?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Never, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Nor send you out o' the way?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Never.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: To fetch her fan, her gloves, her mask, nor nothing?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Never, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: That's strange.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: I durst, my lord, to wager she is honest,
Lay down my soul at stake: if you think other,
Remove your thought; it doth abuse your bosom.
If any wretch have put this in your head,
Let heaven requite it with the serpent's curse!
For, if she be not honest, chaste, and true,
There's no man happy; the purest of their wives
Is foul as slander.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Bid her come hither: go.
She says enough; yet she's a simple bawd
That cannot say as much. This is a subtle whore,
A closet lock and key of villanous secrets
And yet she'll kneel and pray; I have seen her do't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: My lord, what is your will?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Pray, chuck, come hither.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: What is your pleasure?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Let me see your eyes;
Look in my face.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: What horrible fancy's this?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: To EMILIA Some of your function, mistress;
Leave procreants alone and shut the door;
Cough, or cry 'hem,' if any body come:
Your mystery, your mystery: nay, dispatch.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Upon my knees, what doth your speech import?
I understand a fury in your words.
But not the words.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, what art thou?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Your wife, my lord; your true
And loyal wife.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Come, swear it, damn thyself
Lest, being like one of heaven, the devils themselves
Should fear to seize thee: therefore be double damn'd:
Swear thou art honest.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Heaven doth truly know it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Heaven truly knows that thou art false as hell.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: To whom, my lord? with whom? how am I false?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: O Desdemona! away! away! away!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Alas the heavy day! Why do you weep?
Am I the motive of these tears, my lord?
If haply you my father do suspect
An instrument of this your calling back,
Lay not your blame on me: If you have lost him,
Why, I have lost him too.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Had it pleased heaven
To try me with affliction; had they rain'd
All kinds of sores and shames on my bare head.
Steep'd me in poverty to the very lips,
Given to captivity me and my utmost hopes,
I should have found in some place of my soul
A drop of patience: but, alas, to make me
A fixed figure for the time of scorn
To point his slow unmoving finger at!
Yet could I bear that too; well, very well:
But there, where I have garner'd up my heart,
Where either I must live, or bear no life;
The fountain from the which my current runs,
Or else dries up; to be discarded thence!
Or keep it as a cistern for foul toads
To knot and gender in! Turn thy complexion there,
Patience, thou young and rose-lipp'd cherubin,--
Ay, there, look grim as hell!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I hope my noble lord esteems me honest.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: O, ay; as summer flies are in the shambles,
That quicken even with blowing. O thou weed,
Who art so lovely fair and smell'st so sweet
That the sense aches at thee, would thou hadst
ne'er been born!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Alas, what ignorant sin have I committed?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Was this fair paper, this most goodly book,
Made to write 'whore' upon? What committed!
Committed! O thou public commoner!
I should make very forges of my cheeks,
That would to cinders burn up modesty,
Did I but speak thy deeds. What committed!
Heaven stops the nose at it and the moon winks,
The bawdy wind that kisses all it meets
Is hush'd within the hollow mine of earth,
And will not hear it. What committed!
Impudent strumpet!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: By heaven, you do me wrong.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Are you not a strumpet?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: No, as I am a Christian:
If to preserve this vessel for my lord
From any other foul unlawful touch
Be not to be a strumpet, I am none.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: What, not a whore?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: No, as I shall be saved.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Is't possible?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: O, heaven forgive us!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I cry you mercy, then:
I took you for that cunning whore of Venice
That married with Othello.
You, mistress,
That have the office opposite to Saint Peter,
And keep the gate of hell!
You, you, ay, you!
We have done our course; there's money for your pains:
I pray you, turn the key and keep our counsel.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Alas, what does this gentleman conceive?
How do you, madam? how do you, my good lady?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: 'Faith, half asleep.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Good madam, what's the matter with my lord?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: With who?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Why, with my lord, madam.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Who is thy lord?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: He that is yours, sweet lady.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I have none: do not talk to me, Emilia;
I cannot weep; nor answer have I none,
But what should go by water. Prithee, tonight
Lay on my bed my wedding sheets: remember;
And call thy husband hither.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Here's a change indeed!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis meet I should be used so, very meet.
How have I been behaved, that he might stick
The small'st opinion on my least misuse?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: What is your pleasure, madam?
How is't with you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I cannot tell. Those that do teach young babes
Do it with gentle means and easy tasks:
He might have chid me so; for, in good faith,
I am a child to chiding.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: What's the matter, lady?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Alas, Iago, my lord hath so bewhored her.
Thrown such despite and heavy terms upon her,
As true hearts cannot bear.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Am I that name, Iago?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: What name, fair lady?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Such as she says my lord did say I was.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: He call'd her whore: a beggar in his drink
Could not have laid such terms upon his callat.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Why did he so?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I do not know; I am sure I am none such.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Do not weep, do not weep. Alas the day!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Hath she forsook so many noble matches,
Her father and her country and her friends,
To be call'd whore? would it not make one weep?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: It is my wretched fortune.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Beshrew him for't!
How comes this trick upon him?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, heaven doth know.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: I will be hang'd, if some eternal villain,
Some busy and insinuating rogue,
Some cogging, cozening slave, to get some office,
Have not devised this slander; I'll be hang'd else.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Fie, there is no such man; it is impossible.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: If any such there be, heaven pardon him!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: A halter pardon him! and hell gnaw his bones!
Why should he call her whore? who keeps her company?
What place? what time? what form? what likelihood?
The Moor's abused by some most villanous knave,
Some base notorious knave, some scurvy fellow.
O heaven, that such companions thou'ldst unfold,
And put in every honest hand a whip
To lash the rascals naked through the world
Even from the east to the west!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Speak within door.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: O, fie upon them! Some such squire he was
That turn'd your wit the seamy side without,
And made you to suspect me with the Moor.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: You are a fool; go to.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: O good Iago,
What shall I do to win my lord again?
Good friend, go to him; for, by this light of heaven,
I know not how I lost him. Here I kneel:
If e'er my will did trespass 'gainst his love,
Either in discourse of thought or actual deed,
Or that mine eyes, mine ears, or any sense,
Delighted them in any other form;
Or that I do not yet, and ever did.
And ever will--though he do shake me off
To beggarly divorcement--love him dearly,
Comfort forswear me! Unkindness may do much;
And his unkindness may defeat my life,
But never taint my love. I cannot say 'whore:'
It does abhor me now I speak the word;
To do the act that might the addition earn
Not the world's mass of vanity could make me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I pray you, be content; 'tis but his humour:
The business of the state does him offence,
And he does chide with you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: If 'twere no other--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis but so, I warrant.
Hark, how these instruments summon to supper!
The messengers of Venice stay the meat;
Go in, and weep not; all things shall be well.
How now, Roderigo!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: I do not find that thou dealest justly with me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: What in the contrary?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: Every day thou daffest me with some device, Iago;
and rather, as it seems to me now, keepest from me
all conveniency than suppliest me with the least
advantage of hope. I will indeed no longer endure
it, nor am I yet persuaded to put up in peace what
already I have foolishly suffered.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Will you hear me, Roderigo?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Faith, I have heard too much, for your words and
performances are no kin together.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: You charge me most unjustly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: With nought but truth. I have wasted myself out of
my means. The jewels you have had from me to
deliver to Desdemona would half have corrupted a
votarist: you have told me she hath received them
and returned me expectations and comforts of sudden
respect and acquaintance, but I find none.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Well; go to; very well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: Very well! go to! I cannot go to, man; nor 'tis
not very well: nay, I think it is scurvy, and begin
to find myself fobbed in it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Very well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: I tell you 'tis not very well. I will make myself
known to Desdemona: if she will return me my
jewels, I will give over my suit and repent my
unlawful solicitation; if not, assure yourself I
will seek satisfaction of you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: You have said now.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, and said nothing but what I protest intendment of doing.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, now I see there's mettle in thee, and even from
this instant to build on thee a better opinion than
ever before. Give me thy hand, Roderigo: thou hast
taken against me a most just exception; but yet, I
protest, I have dealt most directly in thy affair.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: It hath not appeared.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I grant indeed it hath not appeared, and your
suspicion is not without wit and judgment. But,
Roderigo, if thou hast that in thee indeed, which I
have greater reason to believe now than ever, I mean
purpose, courage and valour, this night show it: if
thou the next night following enjoy not Desdemona,
take me from this world with treachery and devise
engines for my life.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: Well, what is it? is it within reason and compass?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, there is especial commission come from Venice
to depute Cassio in Othello's place.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: Is that true? why, then Othello and Desdemona
return again to Venice.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: O, no; he goes into Mauritania and takes away with
him the fair Desdemona, unless his abode be
lingered here by some accident: wherein none can be
so determinate as the removing of Cassio.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: How do you mean, removing of him?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, by making him uncapable of Othello's place;
knocking out his brains.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: And that you would have me to do?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, if you dare do yourself a profit and a right.
He sups to-night with a harlotry, and thither will I
go to him: he knows not yet of his horrorable
fortune. If you will watch his going thence, which
I will fashion to fall out between twelve and one,
you may take him at your pleasure: I will be near
to second your attempt, and he shall fall between
us. Come, stand not amazed at it, but go along with
me; I will show you such a necessity in his death
that you shall think yourself bound to put it on
him. It is now high suppertime, and the night grows
to waste: about it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: I will hear further reason for this.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: And you shall be satisfied.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE III. Another room In the castle.
SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter OTHELLO, LODOVICO, DESDEMONA, EMILIA and Attendants

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: I do beseech you, sir, trouble yourself no further.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: O, pardon me: 'twill do me good to walk.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: Madam, good night; I humbly thank your ladyship.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Your honour is most welcome.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Will you walk, sir?
O,--Desdemona,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: My lord?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Get you to bed on the instant; I will be returned
forthwith: dismiss your attendant there: look it be done.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I will, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: How goes it now? he looks gentler than he did.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: He says he will return incontinent:
He hath commanded me to go to bed,
And bade me to dismiss you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Dismiss me!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: It was his bidding: therefore, good Emilia,.
Give me my nightly wearing, and adieu:
We must not now displease him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: I would you had never seen him!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: So would not I my love doth so approve him,
That even his stubbornness, his cheques, his frowns--
Prithee, unpin me,--have grace and favour in them.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: I have laid those sheets you bade me on the bed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: All's one. Good faith, how foolish are our minds!
If I do die before thee prithee, shroud me
In one of those same sheets.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Come, come you talk.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: My mother had a maid call'd Barbara:
She was in love, and he she loved proved mad
And did forsake her: she had a song of 'willow;'
An old thing 'twas, but it express'd her fortune,
And she died singing it: that song to-night
Will not go from my mind; I have much to do,
But to go hang my head all at one side,
And sing it like poor Barbara. Prithee, dispatch.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Shall I go fetch your night-gown?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: No, unpin me here.
This Lodovico is a proper man.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: A very handsome man.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: He speaks well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: I know a lady in Venice would have walked barefoot
to Palestine for a touch of his nether lip.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Singing The poor soul sat sighing by a sycamore tree,
Sing all a green willow:
Her hand on her bosom, her head on her knee,
Sing willow, willow, willow:
The fresh streams ran by her, and murmur'd her moans;
Sing willow, willow, willow;
Her salt tears fell from her, and soften'd the stones;
Lay by these:--
Sing willow, willow, willow;
Prithee, hie thee; he'll come anon:--
Sing all a green willow must be my garland.
Let nobody blame him; his scorn I approve,-
Nay, that's not next.--Hark! who is't that knocks?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: It's the wind.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Singing I call'd my love false love; but what
said he then?
Sing willow, willow, willow:
If I court moe women, you'll couch with moe men!
So, get thee gone; good night Ate eyes do itch;
Doth that bode weeping?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis neither here nor there.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I have heard it said so. O, these men, these men!
Dost thou in conscience think,--tell me, Emilia,--
That there be women do abuse their husbands
In such gross kind?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: There be some such, no question.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Wouldst thou do such a deed for all the world?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Why, would not you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: No, by this heavenly light!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Nor I neither by this heavenly light;
I might do't as well i' the dark.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Wouldst thou do such a deed for all the world?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: The world's a huge thing: it is a great price.
For a small vice.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: In troth, I think thou wouldst not.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: In troth, I think I should; and undo't when I had
done. Marry, I would not do such a thing for a
joint-ring, nor for measures of lawn, nor for
gowns, petticoats, nor caps, nor any petty
exhibition; but for the whole world,--why, who would
not make her husband a cuckold to make him a
monarch? I should venture purgatory for't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Beshrew me, if I would do such a wrong
For the whole world.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Why the wrong is but a wrong i' the world: and
having the world for your labour, tis a wrong in your
own world, and you might quickly make it right.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I do not think there is any such woman.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Yes, a dozen; and as many to the vantage as would
store the world they played for.
But I do think it is their husbands' faults
If wives do fall: say that they slack their duties,
And pour our treasures into foreign laps,
Or else break out in peevish jealousies,
Throwing restraint upon us; or say they strike us,
Or scant our former having in despite;
Why, we have galls, and though we have some grace,
Yet have we some revenge. Let husbands know
Their wives have sense like them: they see and smell
And have their palates both for sweet and sour,
As husbands have. What is it that they do
When they change us for others? Is it sport?
I think it is: and doth affection breed it?
I think it doth: is't frailty that thus errs?
It is so too: and have not we affections,
Desires for sport, and frailty, as men have?
Then let them use us well: else let them know,
The ills we do, their ills instruct us so.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Good night, good night: heaven me such uses send,
Not to pick bad from bad, but by bad mend!

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE I. Cyprus. A street.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Here, stand behind this bulk; straight will he come:
Wear thy good rapier bare, and put it home:
Quick, quick; fear nothing; I'll be at thy elbow:
It makes us, or it mars us; think on that,
And fix most firm thy resolution.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: Be near at hand; I may miscarry in't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Here, at thy hand: be bold, and take thy stand.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: I have no great devotion to the deed;
And yet he hath given me satisfying reasons:
'Tis but a man gone. Forth, my sword: he dies.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I have rubb'd this young quat almost to the sense,
And he grows angry. Now, whether he kill Cassio,
Or Cassio him, or each do kill the other,
Every way makes my gain: live Roderigo,
He calls me to a restitution large
Of gold and jewels that I bobb'd from him,
As gifts to Desdemona;
It must not be: if Cassio do remain,
He hath a daily beauty in his life
That makes me ugly; and, besides, the Moor
May unfold me to him; there stand I in much peril:
No, he must die. But so: I hear him coming.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: I know his gait, 'tis he.--Villain, thou diest!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: That thrust had been mine enemy indeed,
But that my coat is better than thou know'st
I will make proof of thine.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: O, I am slain!

SCENE.STAGEDIR: IAGO from behind wounds CASSIO in the leg, and exit

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: I am maim'd for ever. Help, ho! murder! murder!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: The voice of Cassio: Iago keeps his word.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: O, villain that I am!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: It is even so.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: O, help, ho! light! a surgeon!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis he:--O brave Iago, honest and just,
That hast such noble sense of thy friend's wrong!
Thou teachest me. Minion, your dear lies dead,
And your unblest fate hies: strumpet, I come.
Forth of my heart those charms, thine eyes, are blotted;
Thy bed, lust-stain'd, shall with lust's blood be spotted.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: What, ho! no watch? no passage? murder! murder!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GRATIANO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Tis some mischance; the cry is very direful.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: O, help!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: Hark!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: O wretched villain!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: Two or three groan: it is a heavy night:
These may be counterfeits: let's think't unsafe
To come in to the cry without more help.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: Nobody come? then shall I bleed to death.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: Hark!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GRATIANO
SPEECH.LINE: Here's one comes in his shirt, with light and weapons.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Who's there? whose noise is this that ones on murder?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: We do not know.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Did not you hear a cry?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: Here, here! for heaven's sake, help me!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: What's the matter?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GRATIANO
SPEECH.LINE: This is Othello's ancient, as I take it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: The same indeed; a very valiant fellow.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: What are you here that cry so grievously?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: Iago? O, I am spoil'd, undone by villains!
Give me some help.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: O me, lieutenant! what villains have done this?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: I think that one of them is hereabout,
And cannot make away.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: O treacherous villains!
What are you there? come in, and give some help.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: O, help me here!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: That's one of them.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: O murderous slave! O villain!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: RODERIGO
SPEECH.LINE: O damn'd Iago! O inhuman dog!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Kill men i' the dark!--Where be these bloody thieves?--
How silent is this town!--Ho! murder! murder!--
What may you be? are you of good or evil?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: As you shall prove us, praise us.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Signior Lodovico?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: LODOVICO
SPEECH.LINE: He, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: I cry you mercy. Here's Cassio hurt by villains.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GRATIANO
SPEECH.LINE: Cassio!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: How is't, brother!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: My leg is cut in two.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Marry, heaven forbid!
Light, gentlemen; I'll bind it with my shirt.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: What is the matter, ho? who is't that cried?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Who is't that cried!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: O my dear Cassio! my sweet Cassio! O Cassio,
Cassio, Cassio!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: O notable strumpet! Cassio, may you suspect
Who they should be that have thus many led you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: No.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GRATIANO
SPEECH.LINE: I am to find you thus: I have been to seek you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Lend me a garter. So. O, for a chair,
To bear him easily hence!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: Alas, he faints! O Cassio, Cassio, Cassio!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Gentlemen all, I do suspect this trash
To be a party in this injury.
Patience awhile, good Cassio. Come, come;
Lend me a light. Know we this face or no?
Alas my friend and my dear countryman
Roderigo! no:--yes, sure: O heaven! Roderigo.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GRATIANO
SPEECH.LINE: What, of Venice?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Even he, sir; did you know him?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GRATIANO
SPEECH.LINE: Know him! ay.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Signior Gratiano? I cry you gentle pardon;
These bloody accidents must excuse my manners,
That so neglected you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GRATIANO
SPEECH.LINE: I am glad to see you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: How do you, Cassio? O, a chair, a chair!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GRATIANO
SPEECH.LINE: Roderigo!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: He, he 'tis he.
O, that's well said; the chair!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GRATIANO
SPEECH.LINE: Some good man bear him carefully from hence;
I'll fetch the general's surgeon.
For you, mistress,
Save you your labour. He that lies slain
here, Cassio,
Was my dear friend: what malice was between you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CASSIO
SPEECH.LINE: None in the world; nor do I know the man.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: To BIANCA What, look you pale? O, bear him out
o' the air.
SPEECH.STAGEDIR: CASSIO and RODERIGO are borne off
SPEECH.LINE: Stay you, good gentlemen. Look you pale, mistress?
Do you perceive the gastness of her eye?
Nay, if you stare, we shall hear more anon.
Behold her well; I pray you, look upon her:
Do you see, gentlemen? nay, guiltiness will speak,
Though tongues were out of use.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: 'Las, what's the matter? what's the matter, husband?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Cassio hath here been set on in the dark
By Roderigo and fellows that are scaped:
He's almost slain, and Roderigo dead.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Alas, good gentleman! alas, good Cassio!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: This is the fruit of whoring. Prithee, Emilia,
Go know of Cassio where he supp'd to-night.
What, do you shake at that?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: He supp'd at my house; but I therefore shake not.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: O, did he so? I charge you, go with me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Fie, fie upon thee, strumpet!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: BIANCA
SPEECH.LINE: I am no strumpet; but of life as honest
As you that thus abuse me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: As I! foh! fie upon thee!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IAGO
SPEECH.LINE: Kind gentlemen, let's go see poor Cassio dress'd.
Come, mistress, you must tell's another tale.
Emilia run you to the citadel,
And tell my lord and lady what hath happ'd.
Will you go on? I pray.
This is the night
That either makes me or fordoes me quite.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE II. A bedchamber in the castle: DESDEMONA in bed asleep; a light burning.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: It is the cause, it is the cause, my soul,--
Let me not name it to you, you chaste stars!--
It is the cause. Yet I'll not shed her blood;
Nor scar that whiter skin of hers than snow,
And smooth as monumental alabaster.
Yet she must die, else she'll betray more men.
Put out the light, and then put out the light:
If I quench thee, thou flaming minister,
I can again thy former light restore,
Should I repent me: but once put out thy light,
Thou cunning'st pattern of excelling nature,
I know not where is that Promethean heat
That can thy light relume. When I have pluck'd the rose,
I cannot give it vital growth again.
It must needs wither: I'll smell it on the tree.
Ah balmy breath, that dost almost persuade
Justice to break her sword! One more, one more.
Be thus when thou art dead, and I will kill thee,
And love thee after. One more, and this the last:
So sweet was ne'er so fatal. I must weep,
But they are cruel tears: this sorrow's heavenly;
It strikes where it doth love. She wakes.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Who's there? Othello?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay. Desdemona.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Will you come to bed, my lord?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Have you pray'd to-night, Desdemona?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, my lord.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: If you bethink yourself of any crime
Unreconciled as yet to heaven and grace,
Solicit for it straight.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Alas, my lord, what do you mean by that?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Well, do it, and be brief; I will walk by:
I would not kill thy unprepared spirit;
No; heaven forfend! I would not kill thy soul.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Talk you of killing?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, I do.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Then heaven
Have mercy on me!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Amen, with all my heart!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: If you say so, I hope you will not kill me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Hum!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: And yet I fear you; for you are fatal then
When your eyes roll so: why I should fear I know not,
Since guiltiness I know not; but yet I feel I fear.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Think on thy sins.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: They are loves I bear to you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, and for that thou diest.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: That death's unnatural that kills for loving.
Alas, why gnaw you so your nether lip?
Some bloody passion shakes your very frame:
These are portents; but yet I hope, I hope,
They do not point on me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Peace, and be still!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: I will so. What's the matter?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: That handkerchief which I so loved and gave thee
Thou gavest to Cassio.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: No, by my life and soul!
Send for the man, and ask him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Sweet soul, take heed,
Take heed of perjury; thou art on thy deathbed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, but not yet to die.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Yes, presently:
Therefore confess thee freely of thy sin;
For to deny each article with oath
Cannot remove nor choke the strong conception
That I do groan withal. Thou art to die.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Then Lord have mercy on me!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: I say, amen.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: And have you mercy too! I never did
Offend you in my life; never loved Cassio
But with such general warranty of heaven
As I might love: I never gave him token.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: By heaven, I saw my handkerchief in's hand.
O perjured woman! thou dost stone my heart,
And makest me call what I intend to do
A murder, which I thought a sacrifice:
I saw the handkerchief.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: He found it then;
I never gave it him: send for him hither;
Let him confess a truth.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: He hath confess'd.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: What, my lord?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: That he hath used thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: How? unlawfully?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: He will not say so.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: No, his mouth is stopp'd;
Honest Iago hath ta'en order for't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: O! my fear interprets: what, is he dead?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Had all his hairs been lives, my great revenge
Had stomach for them all.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Alas! he is betray'd and I undone.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Out, strumpet! weep'st thou for him to my face?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: O, banish me, my lord, but kill me not!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Down, strumpet!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: Kill me to-morrow: let me live to-night!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, if you strive--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: But half an hour!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Being done, there is no pause.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: DESDEMONA
SPEECH.LINE: But while I say one prayer!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: It is too late.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Within My lord, my lord! what, ho! my lord, my lord!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: What noise is this? Not dead? not yet quite dead?
I that am cruel am yet merciful;
I would not have thee linger in thy pain: So, so.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Within What, ho! my lord, my lord!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Who's there?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: EMILIA
SPEECH.LINE: Within O, good my lord, I would speak a word with you!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: OTHELLO
SPEECH.LINE: Yes: 'tis Emilia. By and by. She's dead.
'Tis like she comes to speak of Cassio's death.--
The noise was here. Ha! no more moving?
Still as the grave. Shall she come in? were't good?--
I think she stirs again:--no. What's best to do?
