And show'd thee all the qualities o' the isle,
The fresh springs, brine-pits, barren place and fertile:
Cursed be I that did so! All the charms
Of Sycorax, toads, beetles, bats, light on you!
For I am all the subjects that you have,
Which first was mine own king: and here you sty me
In this hard rock, whiles you do keep from me
The rest o' the island.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Thou most lying slave,
Whom stripes may move, not kindness! I have used thee,
Filth as thou art, with human care, and lodged thee
In mine own cell, till thou didst seek to violate
The honour of my child.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: O ho, O ho! would't had been done!
Thou didst prevent me; I had peopled else
This isle with Calibans.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Abhorred slave,
Which any print of goodness wilt not take,
Being capable of all ill! I pitied thee,
Took pains to make thee speak, taught thee each hour
One thing or other: when thou didst not, savage,
Know thine own meaning, but wouldst gabble like
A thing most brutish, I endow'd thy purposes
With words that made them known. But thy vile race,
Though thou didst learn, had that in't which
good natures
Could not abide to be with; therefore wast thou
Deservedly confined into this rock,
Who hadst deserved more than a prison.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: You taught me language; and my profit on't
Is, I know how to curse. The red plague rid you
For learning me your language!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Hag-seed, hence!
Fetch us in fuel; and be quick, thou'rt best,
To answer other business. Shrug'st thou, malice?
If thou neglect'st or dost unwillingly
What I command, I'll rack thee with old cramps,
Fill all thy bones with aches, make thee roar
That beasts shall tremble at thy din.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: No, pray thee.
I must obey: his art is of such power,
It would control my dam's god, Setebos,
and make a vassal of him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: So, slave; hence!
SPEECH.STAGEDIR: Re-enter ARIEL, invisible, playing and singing; FERDINAND following
SPEECH.LINE: Come unto these yellow sands,
And then take hands:
Courtsied when you have and kiss'd
The wild waves whist,
Foot it featly here and there;
And, sweet sprites, the burthen bear.
Hark, hark!
The watch-dogs bark!
Hark, hark! I hear
The strain of strutting chanticleer
Cry, Cock-a-diddle-dow.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: Where should this music be? i' the air or the earth?
It sounds no more: and sure, it waits upon
Some god o' the island. Sitting on a bank,
Weeping again the king my father's wreck,
This music crept by me upon the waters,
Allaying both their fury and my passion
With its sweet air: thence I have follow'd it,
Or it hath drawn me rather. But 'tis gone.
No, it begins again.
Full fathom five thy father lies;
Of his bones are coral made;
Those are pearls that were his eyes:
Nothing of him that doth fade
But doth suffer a sea-change
Into something rich and strange.
Sea-nymphs hourly ring his knell
Hark! now I hear them,--Ding-dong, bell.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: The ditty does remember my drown'd father.
This is no mortal business, nor no sound
That the earth owes. I hear it now above me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: The fringed curtains of thine eye advance
And say what thou seest yond.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: What is't? a spirit?
Lord, how it looks about! Believe me, sir,
It carries a brave form. But 'tis a spirit.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: No, wench; it eats and sleeps and hath such senses
As we have, such. This gallant which thou seest
Was in the wreck; and, but he's something stain'd
With grief that's beauty's canker, thou mightst call him
A goodly person: he hath lost his fellows
And strays about to find 'em.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: I might call him
A thing divine, for nothing natural
I ever saw so noble.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Aside It goes on, I see,
As my soul prompts it. Spirit, fine spirit! I'll free thee
Within two days for this.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: Most sure, the goddess
On whom these airs attend! Vouchsafe my prayer
May know if you remain upon this island;
And that you will some good instruction give
How I may bear me here: my prime request,
Which I do last pronounce, is, O you wonder!
If you be maid or no?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: No wonder, sir;
But certainly a maid.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: My language! heavens!
I am the best of them that speak this speech,
Were I but where 'tis spoken.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: How? the best?
What wert thou, if the King of Naples heard thee?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: A single thing, as I am now, that wonders
To hear thee speak of Naples. He does hear me;
And that he does I weep: myself am Naples,
Who with mine eyes, never since at ebb, beheld
The king my father wreck'd.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: Alack, for mercy!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: Yes, faith, and all his lords; the Duke of Milan
And his brave son being twain.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Aside The Duke of Milan
And his more braver daughter could control thee,
If now 'twere fit to do't. At the first sight
They have changed eyes. Delicate Ariel,
I'll set thee free for this.
A word, good sir;
I fear you have done yourself some wrong: a word.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: Why speaks my father so ungently? This
Is the third man that e'er I saw, the first
That e'er I sigh'd for: pity move my father
To be inclined my way!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: O, if a virgin,
And your affection not gone forth, I'll make you
The queen of Naples.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Soft, sir! one word more.
They are both in either's powers; but this swift business
I must uneasy make, lest too light winning
Make the prize light.
One word more; I charge thee
That thou attend me: thou dost here usurp
The name thou owest not; and hast put thyself
Upon this island as a spy, to win it
From me, the lord on't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: No, as I am a man.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: There's nothing ill can dwell in such a temple:
If the ill spirit have so fair a house,
Good things will strive to dwell with't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Follow me.
Speak not you for him; he's a traitor. Come;
I'll manacle thy neck and feet together:
Sea-water shalt thou drink; thy food shall be
The fresh-brook muscles, wither'd roots and husks
Wherein the acorn cradled. Follow.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: No;
I will resist such entertainment till
Mine enemy has more power.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Draws, and is charmed from moving

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: O dear father,
Make not too rash a trial of him, for
He's gentle and not fearful.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: What? I say,
My foot my tutor? Put thy sword up, traitor;
Who makest a show but darest not strike, thy conscience
Is so possess'd with guilt: come from thy ward,
For I can here disarm thee with this stick
And make thy weapon drop.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: Beseech you, father.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Hence! hang not on my garments.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, have pity;
I'll be his surety.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Silence! one word more
Shall make me chide thee, if not hate thee. What!
An advocate for an imposter! hush!
Thou think'st there is no more such shapes as he,
Having seen but him and Caliban: foolish wench!
To the most of men this is a Caliban
And they to him are angels.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: My affections
Are then most humble; I have no ambition
To see a goodlier man.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Come on; obey:
Thy nerves are in their infancy again
And have no vigour in them.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: So they are;
My spirits, as in a dream, are all bound up.
My father's loss, the weakness which I feel,
The wreck of all my friends, nor this man's threats,
To whom I am subdued, are but light to me,
Might I but through my prison once a day
Behold this maid: all corners else o' the earth
Let liberty make use of; space enough
Have I in such a prison.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Aside It works.
Come on.
Thou hast done well, fine Ariel!
Follow me.
Hark what thou else shalt do me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: Be of comfort;
My father's of a better nature, sir,
Than he appears by speech: this is unwonted
Which now came from him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Thou shalt be free
As mountain winds: but then exactly do
All points of my command.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: To the syllable.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Come, follow. Speak not for him.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE I. Another part of the island.
SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter ALONSO, SEBASTIAN, ANTONIO, GONZALO, ADRIAN, FRANCISCO, and others

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Beseech you, sir, be merry; you have cause,
So have we all, of joy; for our escape
Is much beyond our loss. Our hint of woe
Is common; every day some sailor's wife,
The masters of some merchant and the merchant
Have just our theme of woe; but for the miracle,
I mean our preservation, few in millions
Can speak like us: then wisely, good sir, weigh
Our sorrow with our comfort.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: Prithee, peace.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: He receives comfort like cold porridge.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: The visitor will not give him o'er so.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Look he's winding up the watch of his wit;
by and by it will strike.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Sir,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: One: tell.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: When every grief is entertain'd that's offer'd,
Comes to the entertainer--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: A dollar.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Dolour comes to him, indeed: you
have spoken truer than you purposed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: You have taken it wiselier than I meant you should.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Therefore, my lord,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Fie, what a spendthrift is he of his tongue!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: I prithee, spare.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Well, I have done: but yet,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: He will be talking.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Which, of he or Adrian, for a good
wager, first begins to crow?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: The old cock.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: The cockerel.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Done. The wager?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: A laughter.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: A match!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ADRIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Though this island seem to be desert,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Ha, ha, ha! So, you're paid.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ADRIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Uninhabitable and almost inaccessible,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Yet,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ADRIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Yet,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: He could not miss't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ADRIAN
SPEECH.LINE: It must needs be of subtle, tender and delicate
temperance.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Temperance was a delicate wench.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, and a subtle; as he most learnedly delivered.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ADRIAN
SPEECH.LINE: The air breathes upon us here most sweetly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: As if it had lungs and rotten ones.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Or as 'twere perfumed by a fen.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Here is everything advantageous to life.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: True; save means to live.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Of that there's none, or little.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: How lush and lusty the grass looks! how green!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: The ground indeed is tawny.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: With an eye of green in't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: He misses not much.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: No; he doth but mistake the truth totally.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: But the rarity of it is,--which is indeed almost
beyond credit,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: As many vouched rarities are.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: That our garments, being, as they were, drenched in
the sea, hold notwithstanding their freshness and
glosses, being rather new-dyed than stained with
salt water.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: If but one of his pockets could speak, would it not
say he lies?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, or very falsely pocket up his report

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Methinks our garments are now as fresh as when we
put them on first in Afric, at the marriage of
the king's fair daughter Claribel to the King of Tunis.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: 'Twas a sweet marriage, and we prosper well in our return.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ADRIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Tunis was never graced before with such a paragon to
their queen.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Not since widow Dido's time.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Widow! a pox o' that! How came that widow in?
widow Dido!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: What if he had said 'widower AEneas' too? Good Lord,
how you take it!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ADRIAN
SPEECH.LINE: 'Widow Dido' said you? you make me study of that:
she was of Carthage, not of Tunis.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: This Tunis, sir, was Carthage.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ADRIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Carthage?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: I assure you, Carthage.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: His word is more than the miraculous harp; he hath
raised the wall and houses too.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: What impossible matter will he make easy next?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: I think he will carry this island home in his pocket
and give it his son for an apple.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: And, sowing the kernels of it in the sea, bring
forth more islands.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, in good time.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, we were talking that our garments seem now
as fresh as when we were at Tunis at the marriage
of your daughter, who is now queen.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: And the rarest that e'er came there.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Bate, I beseech you, widow Dido.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: O, widow Dido! ay, widow Dido.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Is not, sir, my doublet as fresh as the first day I
wore it? I mean, in a sort.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: That sort was well fished for.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: When I wore it at your daughter's marriage?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: You cram these words into mine ears against
The stomach of my sense. Would I had never
Married my daughter there! for, coming thence,
My son is lost and, in my rate, she too,
Who is so far from Italy removed
I ne'er again shall see her. O thou mine heir
Of Naples and of Milan, what strange fish
Hath made his meal on thee?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FRANCISCO
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, he may live:
I saw him beat the surges under him,
And ride upon their backs; he trod the water,
Whose enmity he flung aside, and breasted
The surge most swoln that met him; his bold head
'Bove the contentious waves he kept, and oar'd
Himself with his good arms in lusty stroke
To the shore, that o'er his wave-worn basis bow'd,
As stooping to relieve him: I not doubt
He came alive to land.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: No, no, he's gone.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Sir, you may thank yourself for this great loss,
That would not bless our Europe with your daughter,
But rather lose her to an African;
Where she at least is banish'd from your eye,
Who hath cause to wet the grief on't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: Prithee, peace.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: You were kneel'd to and importuned otherwise
By all of us, and the fair soul herself
Weigh'd between loathness and obedience, at
Which end o' the beam should bow. We have lost your
son,
I fear, for ever: Milan and Naples have
More widows in them of this business' making
Than we bring men to comfort them:
The fault's your own.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: So is the dear'st o' the loss.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: My lord Sebastian,
The truth you speak doth lack some gentleness
And time to speak it in: you rub the sore,
When you should bring the plaster.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Very well.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: And most chirurgeonly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: It is foul weather in us all, good sir,
When you are cloudy.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Foul weather?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Very foul.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Had I plantation of this isle, my lord,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: He'ld sow't with nettle-seed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Or docks, or mallows.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: And were the king on't, what would I do?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: 'Scape being drunk for want of wine.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: I' the commonwealth I would by contraries
Execute all things; for no kind of traffic
Would I admit; no name of magistrate;
Letters should not be known; riches, poverty,
And use of service, none; contract, succession,
Bourn, bound of land, tilth, vineyard, none;
No use of metal, corn, or wine, or oil;
No occupation; all men idle, all;
And women too, but innocent and pure;
No sovereignty;--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Yet he would be king on't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: The latter end of his commonwealth forgets the
beginning.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: All things in common nature should produce
Without sweat or endeavour: treason, felony,
Sword, pike, knife, gun, or need of any engine,
Would I not have; but nature should bring forth,
Of its own kind, all foison, all abundance,
To feed my innocent people.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: No marrying 'mong his subjects?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: None, man; all idle: whores and knaves.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: I would with such perfection govern, sir,
To excel the golden age.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: God save his majesty!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Long live Gonzalo!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: And,--do you mark me, sir?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: Prithee, no more: thou dost talk nothing to me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: I do well believe your highness; and
did it to minister occasion to these gentlemen,
who are of such sensible and nimble lungs that
they always use to laugh at nothing.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Twas you we laughed at.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Who in this kind of merry fooling am nothing
to you: so you may continue and laugh at
nothing still.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: What a blow was there given!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: An it had not fallen flat-long.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: You are gentlemen of brave metal; you would lift
the moon out of her sphere, if she would continue
in it five weeks without changing.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter ARIEL, invisible, playing solemn music

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: We would so, and then go a bat-fowling.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Nay, good my lord, be not angry.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: No, I warrant you; I will not adventure
my discretion so weakly. Will you laugh
me asleep, for I am very heavy?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Go sleep, and hear us.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: All sleep except ALONSO, SEBASTIAN, and ANTONIO

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: What, all so soon asleep! I wish mine eyes
Would, with themselves, shut up my thoughts: I find
They are inclined to do so.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Please you, sir,
Do not omit the heavy offer of it:
It seldom visits sorrow; when it doth,
It is a comforter.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: We two, my lord,
Will guard your person while you take your rest,
And watch your safety.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: Thank you. Wondrous heavy.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: What a strange drowsiness possesses them!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: It is the quality o' the climate.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Why
Doth it not then our eyelids sink? I find not
Myself disposed to sleep.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Nor I; my spirits are nimble.
They fell together all, as by consent;
They dropp'd, as by a thunder-stroke. What might,
Worthy Sebastian? O, what might?--No more:--
And yet me thinks I see it in thy face,
What thou shouldst be: the occasion speaks thee, and
My strong imagination sees a crown
Dropping upon thy head.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: What, art thou waking?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Do you not hear me speak?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: I do; and surely
It is a sleepy language and thou speak'st
Out of thy sleep. What is it thou didst say?
This is a strange repose, to be asleep
With eyes wide open; standing, speaking, moving,
And yet so fast asleep.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Noble Sebastian,
Thou let'st thy fortune sleep--die, rather; wink'st
Whiles thou art waking.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Thou dost snore distinctly;
There's meaning in thy snores.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: I am more serious than my custom: you
Must be so too, if heed me; which to do
Trebles thee o'er.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Well, I am standing water.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: I'll teach you how to flow.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Do so: to ebb
Hereditary sloth instructs me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: O,
If you but knew how you the purpose cherish
Whiles thus you mock it! how, in stripping it,
You more invest it! Ebbing men, indeed,
Most often do so near the bottom run
By their own fear or sloth.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Prithee, say on:
The setting of thine eye and cheek proclaim
A matter from thee, and a birth indeed
Which throes thee much to yield.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Thus, sir:
Although this lord of weak remembrance, this,
Who shall be of as little memory
When he is earth'd, hath here almost persuade,--
For he's a spirit of persuasion, only
Professes to persuade,--the king his son's alive,
'Tis as impossible that he's undrown'd
And he that sleeps here swims.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: I have no hope
That he's undrown'd.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: O, out of that 'no hope'
What great hope have you! no hope that way is
Another way so high a hope that even
Ambition cannot pierce a wink beyond,
But doubt discovery there. Will you grant with me
That Ferdinand is drown'd?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: He's gone.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Then, tell me,
Who's the next heir of Naples?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Claribel.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: She that is queen of Tunis; she that dwells
Ten leagues beyond man's life; she that from Naples
Can have no note, unless the sun were post--
The man i' the moon's too slow--till new-born chins
Be rough and razorable; she that--from whom?
We all were sea-swallow'd, though some cast again,
And by that destiny to perform an act
Whereof what's past is prologue, what to come
In yours and my discharge.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: What stuff is this! how say you?
'Tis true, my brother's daughter's queen of Tunis;
So is she heir of Naples; 'twixt which regions
There is some space.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: A space whose every cubit
Seems to cry out, 'How shall that Claribel
Measure us back to Naples? Keep in Tunis,
And let Sebastian wake.' Say, this were death
That now hath seized them; why, they were no worse
Than now they are. There be that can rule Naples
As well as he that sleeps; lords that can prate
As amply and unnecessarily
As this Gonzalo; I myself could make
A chough of as deep chat. O, that you bore
The mind that I do! what a sleep were this
For your advancement! Do you understand me?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Methinks I do.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: And how does your content
Tender your own good fortune?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: I remember
You did supplant your brother Prospero.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: True:
And look how well my garments sit upon me;
Much feater than before: my brother's servants
Were then my fellows; now they are my men.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: But, for your conscience?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, sir; where lies that? if 'twere a kibe,
'Twould put me to my slipper: but I feel not
This deity in my bosom: twenty consciences,
That stand 'twixt me and Milan, candied be they
And melt ere they molest! Here lies your brother,
No better than the earth he lies upon,
If he were that which now he's like, that's dead;
Whom I, with this obedient steel, three inches of it,
Can lay to bed for ever; whiles you, doing thus,
To the perpetual wink for aye might put
This ancient morsel, this Sir Prudence, who
Should not upbraid our course. For all the rest,
They'll take suggestion as a cat laps milk;
They'll tell the clock to any business that
We say befits the hour.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Thy case, dear friend,
Shall be my precedent; as thou got'st Milan,
I'll come by Naples. Draw thy sword: one stroke
Shall free thee from the tribute which thou payest;
And I the king shall love thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Draw together;
And when I rear my hand, do you the like,
To fall it on Gonzalo.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: O, but one word.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: My master through his art foresees the danger
That you, his friend, are in; and sends me forth--
For else his project dies--to keep them living.
While you here do snoring lie,
Open-eyed conspiracy
His time doth take.
If of life you keep a care,
Shake off slumber, and beware:
Awake, awake!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Then let us both be sudden.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Now, good angels
Preserve the king.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, how now? ho, awake! Why are you drawn?
Wherefore this ghastly looking?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: What's the matter?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Whiles we stood here securing your repose,
Even now, we heard a hollow burst of bellowing
Like bulls, or rather lions: did't not wake you?
It struck mine ear most terribly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: I heard nothing.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: O, 'twas a din to fright a monster's ear,
To make an earthquake! sure, it was the roar
Of a whole herd of lions.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: Heard you this, Gonzalo?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Upon mine honour, sir, I heard a humming,
And that a strange one too, which did awake me:
I shaked you, sir, and cried: as mine eyes open'd,
I saw their weapons drawn: there was a noise,
That's verily. 'Tis best we stand upon our guard,
Or that we quit this place; let's draw our weapons.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: Lead off this ground; and let's make further search
For my poor son.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Heavens keep him from these beasts!
For he is, sure, i' the island.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: Lead away.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: Prospero my lord shall know what I have done:
So, king, go safely on to seek thy son.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE II. Another part of the island.
SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter CALIBAN with a burden of wood. A noise of thunder heard

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: All the infections that the sun sucks up
From bogs, fens, flats, on Prosper fall and make him
By inch-meal a disease! His spirits hear me
And yet I needs must curse. But they'll nor pinch,
Fright me with urchin--shows, pitch me i' the mire,
Nor lead me, like a firebrand, in the dark
Out of my way, unless he bid 'em; but
For every trifle are they set upon me;
Sometime like apes that mow and chatter at me
And after bite me, then like hedgehogs which
Lie tumbling in my barefoot way and mount
Their pricks at my footfall; sometime am I
All wound with adders who with cloven tongues
Do hiss me into madness.
Lo, now, lo!
Here comes a spirit of his, and to torment me
For bringing wood in slowly. I'll fall flat;
Perchance he will not mind me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Here's neither bush nor shrub, to bear off
any weather at all, and another storm brewing;
I hear it sing i' the wind: yond same black
cloud, yond huge one, looks like a foul
bombard that would shed his liquor. If it
should thunder as it did before, I know not
where to hide my head: yond same cloud cannot
choose but fall by pailfuls. What have we
here? a man or a fish? dead or alive? A fish:
he smells like a fish; a very ancient and fish-
like smell; a kind of not of the newest Poor-
John. A strange fish! Were I in England now,
as once I was, and had but this fish painted,
not a holiday fool there but would give a piece
of silver: there would this monster make a
man; any strange beast there makes a man:
when they will not give a doit to relieve a lame
beggar, they will lazy out ten to see a dead
Indian. Legged like a man and his fins like
arms! Warm o' my troth! I do now let loose
my opinion; hold it no longer: this is no fish,
but an islander, that hath lately suffered by a
thunderbolt.
Alas, the storm is come again! my best way is to
creep under his gaberdine; there is no other
shelter hereabouts: misery acquaints a man with
strange bed-fellows. I will here shroud till the
dregs of the storm be past.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter STEPHANO, singing: a bottle in his hand

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: I shall no more to sea, to sea,
Here shall I die ashore--
This is a very scurvy tune to sing at a man's
funeral: well, here's my comfort. Drinks
The master, the swabber, the boatswain and I,
The gunner and his mate
Loved Mall, Meg and Marian and Margery,
But none of us cared for Kate;
For she had a tongue with a tang,
Would cry to a sailor, Go hang!
She loved not the savour of tar nor of pitch,
Yet a tailor might scratch her where'er she did itch:
Then to sea, boys, and let her go hang!
This is a scurvy tune too: but here's my comfort.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Do not torment me: Oh!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: What's the matter? Have we devils here? Do you put
tricks upon's with savages and men of Ind, ha? I
have not scaped drowning to be afeard now of your
four legs; for it hath been said, As proper a man as
ever went on four legs cannot make him give ground;
and it shall be said so again while Stephano
breathes at's nostrils.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: The spirit torments me; Oh!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: This is some monster of the isle with four legs, who
hath got, as I take it, an ague. Where the devil
should he learn our language? I will give him some
relief, if it be but for that. if I can recover him
and keep him tame and get to Naples with him, he's a
present for any emperor that ever trod on neat's leather.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Do not torment me, prithee; I'll bring my wood home faster.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: He's in his fit now and does not talk after the
wisest. He shall taste of my bottle: if he have
never drunk wine afore will go near to remove his
fit. If I can recover him and keep him tame, I will
not take too much for him; he shall pay for him that
hath him, and that soundly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Thou dost me yet but little hurt; thou wilt anon, I
know it by thy trembling: now Prosper works upon thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Come on your ways; open your mouth; here is that
which will give language to you, cat: open your
mouth; this will shake your shaking, I can tell you,
and that soundly: you cannot tell who's your friend:
open your chaps again.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: I should know that voice: it should be--but he is
drowned; and these are devils: O defend me!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Four legs and two voices: a most delicate monster!
His forward voice now is to speak well of his
friend; his backward voice is to utter foul speeches
and to detract. If all the wine in my bottle will
recover him, I will help his ague. Come. Amen! I
will pour some in thy other mouth.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Stephano!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Doth thy other mouth call me? Mercy, mercy! This is
a devil, and no monster: I will leave him; I have no
long spoon.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Stephano! If thou beest Stephano, touch me and
speak to me: for I am Trinculo--be not afeard--thy
good friend Trinculo.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: If thou beest Trinculo, come forth: I'll pull thee
by the lesser legs: if any be Trinculo's legs,
these are they. Thou art very Trinculo indeed! How
camest thou to be the siege of this moon-calf? can
he vent Trinculos?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: I took him to be killed with a thunder-stroke. But
art thou not drowned, Stephano? I hope now thou art
not drowned. Is the storm overblown? I hid me
under the dead moon-calf's gaberdine for fear of
the storm. And art thou living, Stephano? O
Stephano, two Neapolitans 'scaped!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Prithee, do not turn me about; my stomach is not constant.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Aside These be fine things, an if they be
not sprites.
That's a brave god and bears celestial liquor.
I will kneel to him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: How didst thou 'scape? How camest thou hither?
swear by this bottle how thou camest hither. I
escaped upon a butt of sack which the sailors
heaved o'erboard, by this bottle; which I made of
the bark of a tree with mine own hands since I was
cast ashore.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: I'll swear upon that bottle to be thy true subject;
for the liquor is not earthly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Here; swear then how thou escapedst.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Swum ashore. man, like a duck: I can swim like a
duck, I'll be sworn.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Here, kiss the book. Though thou canst swim like a
duck, thou art made like a goose.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: O Stephano. hast any more of this?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: The whole butt, man: my cellar is in a rock by the
sea-side where my wine is hid. How now, moon-calf!
how does thine ague?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Hast thou not dropp'd from heaven?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Out o' the moon, I do assure thee: I was the man i'
the moon when time was.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: I have seen thee in her and I do adore thee:
My mistress show'd me thee and thy dog and thy bush.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Come, swear to that; kiss the book: I will furnish
it anon with new contents swear.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: By this good light, this is a very shallow monster!
I afeard of him! A very weak monster! The man i'
the moon! A most poor credulous monster! Well
drawn, monster, in good sooth!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: I'll show thee every fertile inch o' th' island;
And I will kiss thy foot: I prithee, be my god.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: By this light, a most perfidious and drunken
monster! when 's god's asleep, he'll rob his bottle.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: I'll kiss thy foot; I'll swear myself thy subject.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Come on then; down, and swear.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: I shall laugh myself to death at this puppy-headed
monster. A most scurvy monster! I could find in my
heart to beat him,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Come, kiss.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: But that the poor monster's in drink: an abominable monster!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: I'll show thee the best springs; I'll pluck thee berries;
I'll fish for thee and get thee wood enough.
A plague upon the tyrant that I serve!
I'll bear him no more sticks, but follow thee,
Thou wondrous man.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: A most ridiculous monster, to make a wonder of a
Poor drunkard!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: I prithee, let me bring thee where crabs grow;
And I with my long nails will dig thee pignuts;
Show thee a jay's nest and instruct thee how
To snare the nimble marmoset; I'll bring thee
To clustering filberts and sometimes I'll get thee
Young scamels from the rock. Wilt thou go with me?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: I prithee now, lead the way without any more
talking. Trinculo, the king and all our company
else being drowned, we will inherit here: here;
bear my bottle: fellow Trinculo, we'll fill him by
and by again.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Farewell master; farewell, farewell!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: A howling monster: a drunken monster!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: No more dams I'll make for fish
Nor fetch in firing
At requiring;
Nor scrape trencher, nor wash dish
'Ban, 'Ban, Cacaliban
Has a new master: get a new man.
Freedom, hey-day! hey-day, freedom! freedom,
hey-day, freedom!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: O brave monster! Lead the way.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE I. Before PROSPERO'S Cell.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: There be some sports are painful, and their labour
Delight in them sets off: some kinds of baseness
Are nobly undergone and most poor matters
Point to rich ends. This my mean task
Would be as heavy to me as odious, but
The mistress which I serve quickens what's dead
And makes my labours pleasures: O, she is
Ten times more gentle than her father's crabbed,
And he's composed of harshness. I must remove
Some thousands of these logs and pile them up,
Upon a sore injunction: my sweet mistress
Weeps when she sees me work, and says, such baseness
Had never like executor. I forget:
But these sweet thoughts do even refresh my labours,
Most busy lest, when I do it.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter MIRANDA; and PROSPERO at a distance, unseen

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: Alas, now, pray you,
Work not so hard: I would the lightning had
Burnt up those logs that you are enjoin'd to pile!
Pray, set it down and rest you: when this burns,
'Twill weep for having wearied you. My father
Is hard at study; pray now, rest yourself;
He's safe for these three hours.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: O most dear mistress,
The sun will set before I shall discharge
What I must strive to do.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: If you'll sit down,
I'll bear your logs the while: pray, give me that;
I'll carry it to the pile.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: No, precious creature;
I had rather crack my sinews, break my back,
Than you should such dishonour undergo,
While I sit lazy by.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: It would become me
As well as it does you: and I should do it
With much more ease; for my good will is to it,
And yours it is against.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Poor worm, thou art infected!
This visitation shows it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: You look wearily.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: No, noble mistress;'tis fresh morning with me
When you are by at night. I do beseech you--
Chiefly that I might set it in my prayers--
What is your name?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: Miranda.--O my father,
I have broke your hest to say so!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: Admired Miranda!
Indeed the top of admiration! worth
What's dearest to the world! Full many a lady
I have eyed with best regard and many a time
The harmony of their tongues hath into bondage
Brought my too diligent ear: for several virtues
Have I liked several women; never any
With so fun soul, but some defect in her
Did quarrel with the noblest grace she owed
And put it to the foil: but you, O you,
So perfect and so peerless, are created
Of every creature's best!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: I do not know
One of my sex; no woman's face remember,
Save, from my glass, mine own; nor have I seen
More that I may call men than you, good friend,
And my dear father: how features are abroad,
I am skilless of; but, by my modesty,
The jewel in my dower, I would not wish
Any companion in the world but you,
Nor can imagination form a shape,
Besides yourself, to like of. But I prattle
Something too wildly and my father's precepts
I therein do forget.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: I am in my condition
A prince, Miranda; I do think, a king;
I would, not so!--and would no more endure
This wooden slavery than to suffer
The flesh-fly blow my mouth. Hear my soul speak:
The very instant that I saw you, did
My heart fly to your service; there resides,
To make me slave to it; and for your sake
Am I this patient log--man.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: Do you love me?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: O heaven, O earth, bear witness to this sound
And crown what I profess with kind event
If I speak true! if hollowly, invert
What best is boded me to mischief! I
Beyond all limit of what else i' the world
Do love, prize, honour you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: I am a fool
To weep at what I am glad of.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Fair encounter
Of two most rare affections! Heavens rain grace
On that which breeds between 'em!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: Wherefore weep you?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: At mine unworthiness that dare not offer
What I desire to give, and much less take
What I shall die to want. But this is trifling;
And all the more it seeks to hide itself,
The bigger bulk it shows. Hence, bashful cunning!
And prompt me, plain and holy innocence!
I am your wife, it you will marry me;
If not, I'll die your maid: to be your fellow
You may deny me; but I'll be your servant,
Whether you will or no.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: My mistress, dearest;
And I thus humble ever.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: My husband, then?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, with a heart as willing
As bondage e'er of freedom: here's my hand.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: And mine, with my heart in't; and now farewell
Till half an hour hence.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: A thousand thousand!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: So glad of this as they I cannot be,
Who are surprised withal; but my rejoicing
At nothing can be more. I'll to my book,
For yet ere supper-time must I perform
Much business appertaining.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE II. Another part of the island.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Tell not me; when the butt is out, we will drink
water; not a drop before: therefore bear up, and
board 'em. Servant-monster, drink to me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Servant-monster! the folly of this island! They
say there's but five upon this isle: we are three
of them; if th' other two be brained like us, the
state totters.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Drink, servant-monster, when I bid thee: thy eyes
are almost set in thy head.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Where should they be set else? he were a brave
monster indeed, if they were set in his tail.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: My man-monster hath drown'd his tongue in sack:
for my part, the sea cannot drown me; I swam, ere I
could recover the shore, five and thirty leagues off
and on. By this light, thou shalt be my lieutenant,
monster, or my standard.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Your lieutenant, if you list; he's no standard.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: We'll not run, Monsieur Monster.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Nor go neither; but you'll lie like dogs and yet say
nothing neither.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Moon-calf, speak once in thy life, if thou beest a
good moon-calf.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: How does thy honour? Let me lick thy shoe.
I'll not serve him; he's not valiant.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Thou liest, most ignorant monster: I am in case to
justle a constable. Why, thou deboshed fish thou,
was there ever man a coward that hath drunk so much
sack as I to-day? Wilt thou tell a monstrous lie,
being but half a fish and half a monster?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Lo, how he mocks me! wilt thou let him, my lord?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: 'Lord' quoth he! That a monster should be such a natural!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Lo, lo, again! bite him to death, I prithee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Trinculo, keep a good tongue in your head: if you
prove a mutineer,--the next tree! The poor monster's
my subject and he shall not suffer indignity.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: I thank my noble lord. Wilt thou be pleased to
hearken once again to the suit I made to thee?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Marry, will I kneel and repeat it; I will stand,
and so shall Trinculo.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: As I told thee before, I am subject to a tyrant, a
sorcerer, that by his cunning hath cheated me of the island.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: Thou liest.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Thou liest, thou jesting monkey, thou: I would my
valiant master would destroy thee! I do not lie.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Trinculo, if you trouble him any more in's tale, by
this hand, I will supplant some of your teeth.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, I said nothing.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Mum, then, and no more. Proceed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: I say, by sorcery he got this isle;
From me he got it. if thy greatness will
Revenge it on him,--for I know thou darest,
But this thing dare not,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: That's most certain.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Thou shalt be lord of it and I'll serve thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: How now shall this be compassed?
Canst thou bring me to the party?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Yea, yea, my lord: I'll yield him thee asleep,
Where thou mayst knock a nail into his bead.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: Thou liest; thou canst not.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: What a pied ninny's this! Thou scurvy patch!
I do beseech thy greatness, give him blows
And take his bottle from him: when that's gone
He shall drink nought but brine; for I'll not show him
Where the quick freshes are.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Trinculo, run into no further danger:
interrupt the monster one word further, and,
by this hand, I'll turn my mercy out o' doors
and make a stock-fish of thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, what did I? I did nothing. I'll go farther
off.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Didst thou not say he lied?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: Thou liest.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Do I so? take thou that.
As you like this, give me the lie another time.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: I did not give the lie. Out o' your
wits and bearing too? A pox o' your bottle!
this can sack and drinking do. A murrain on
your monster, and the devil take your fingers!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Ha, ha, ha!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Now, forward with your tale. Prithee, stand farther
off.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Beat him enough: after a little time
I'll beat him too.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Stand farther. Come, proceed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Why, as I told thee, 'tis a custom with him,
I' th' afternoon to sleep: there thou mayst brain him,
Having first seized his books, or with a log
Batter his skull, or paunch him with a stake,
Or cut his wezand with thy knife. Remember
First to possess his books; for without them
He's but a sot, as I am, nor hath not
One spirit to command: they all do hate him
As rootedly as I. Burn but his books.
He has brave utensils,--for so he calls them--
Which when he has a house, he'll deck withal
And that most deeply to consider is
The beauty of his daughter; he himself
Calls her a nonpareil: I never saw a woman,
But only Sycorax my dam and she;
But she as far surpasseth Sycorax
As great'st does least.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Is it so brave a lass?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, lord; she will become thy bed, I warrant.
And bring thee forth brave brood.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Monster, I will kill this man: his daughter and I
will be king and queen--save our graces!--and
Trinculo and thyself shall be viceroys. Dost thou
like the plot, Trinculo?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Excellent.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Give me thy hand: I am sorry I beat thee; but,
while thou livest, keep a good tongue in thy head.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Within this half hour will he be asleep:
Wilt thou destroy him then?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, on mine honour.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: This will I tell my master.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Thou makest me merry; I am full of pleasure:
Let us be jocund: will you troll the catch
You taught me but while-ere?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: At thy request, monster, I will do reason, any
reason. Come on, Trinculo, let us sing.
Flout 'em and scout 'em
And scout 'em and flout 'em
Thought is free.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: That's not the tune.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Ariel plays the tune on a tabour and pipe

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: What is this same?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: This is the tune of our catch, played by the picture
of Nobody.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: If thou beest a man, show thyself in thy likeness:
if thou beest a devil, take't as thou list.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: O, forgive me my sins!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: He that dies pays all debts: I defy thee. Mercy upon us!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Art thou afeard?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: No, monster, not I.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Be not afeard; the isle is full of noises,
Sounds and sweet airs, that give delight and hurt not.
Sometimes a thousand twangling instruments
Will hum about mine ears, and sometime voices
That, if I then had waked after long sleep,
Will make me sleep again: and then, in dreaming,
The clouds methought would open and show riches
Ready to drop upon me that, when I waked,
I cried to dream again.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: This will prove a brave kingdom to me, where I shall
have my music for nothing.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: When Prospero is destroyed.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: That shall be by and by: I remember the story.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: The sound is going away; let's follow it, and
after do our work.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Lead, monster; we'll follow. I would I could see
this tabourer; he lays it on.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Wilt come? I'll follow, Stephano.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE III. Another part of the island.
SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter ALONSO, SEBASTIAN, ANTONIO, GONZALO, ADRIAN, FRANCISCO, and others

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: By'r lakin, I can go no further, sir;
My old bones ache: here's a maze trod indeed
Through forth-rights and meanders! By your patience,
I needs must rest me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: Old lord, I cannot blame thee,
Who am myself attach'd with weariness,
To the dulling of my spirits: sit down, and rest.
Even here I will put off my hope and keep it
No longer for my flatterer: he is drown'd
Whom thus we stray to find, and the sea mocks
Our frustrate search on land. Well, let him go.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Aside to SEBASTIAN I am right glad that he's so
out of hope.
Do not, for one repulse, forego the purpose
That you resolved to effect.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Aside to ANTONIO The next advantage
Will we take throughly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: Aside to SEBASTIAN Let it be to-night;
For, now they are oppress'd with travel, they
Will not, nor cannot, use such vigilance
As when they are fresh.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Aside to ANTONIO I say, to-night: no more.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: What harmony is this? My good friends, hark!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Marvellous sweet music!

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter PROSPERO above, invisible. Enter several strange Shapes, bringing in a banquet; they dance about it with gentle actions of salutation; and, inviting the King, &c. to eat, they depart

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: Give us kind keepers, heavens! What were these?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: A living drollery. Now I will believe
That there are unicorns, that in Arabia
There is one tree, the phoenix' throne, one phoenix
At this hour reigning there.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: I'll believe both;
And what does else want credit, come to me,
And I'll be sworn 'tis true: travellers ne'er did
lie,
Though fools at home condemn 'em.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: If in Naples
I should report this now, would they believe me?
If I should say, I saw such islanders--
For, certes, these are people of the island--
Who, though they are of monstrous shape, yet, note,
Their manners are more gentle-kind than of
Our human generation you shall find
Many, nay, almost any.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Aside Honest lord,
Thou hast said well; for some of you there present
Are worse than devils.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: I cannot too much muse
Such shapes, such gesture and such sound, expressing,
Although they want the use of tongue, a kind
Of excellent dumb discourse.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Aside Praise in departing.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FRANCISCO
SPEECH.LINE: They vanish'd strangely.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: No matter, since
They have left their viands behind; for we have stomachs.
Will't please you taste of what is here?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: Not I.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Faith, sir, you need not fear. When we were boys,
Who would believe that there were mountaineers
Dew-lapp'd like bulls, whose throats had hanging at 'em
Wallets of flesh? or that there were such men
Whose heads stood in their breasts? which now we find
Each putter-out of five for one will bring us
Good warrant of.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: I will stand to and feed,
Although my last: no matter, since I feel
The best is past. Brother, my lord the duke,
Stand to and do as we.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Thunder and lightning. Enter ARIEL, like a harpy; claps his wings upon the table; and, with a quaint device, the banquet vanishes

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: You are three men of sin, whom Destiny,
That hath to instrument this lower world
And what is in't, the never-surfeited sea
Hath caused to belch up you; and on this island
Where man doth not inhabit; you 'mongst men
Being most unfit to live. I have made you mad;
And even with such-like valour men hang and drown
Their proper selves.
You fools! I and my fellows
Are ministers of Fate: the elements,
Of whom your swords are temper'd, may as well
Wound the loud winds, or with bemock'd-at stabs
Kill the still-closing waters, as diminish
One dowle that's in my plume: my fellow-ministers
Are like invulnerable. If you could hurt,
Your swords are now too massy for your strengths
And will not be uplifted. But remember--
For that's my business to you--that you three
From Milan did supplant good Prospero;
Exposed unto the sea, which hath requit it,
Him and his innocent child: for which foul deed
The powers, delaying, not forgetting, have
Incensed the seas and shores, yea, all the creatures,
Against your peace. Thee of thy son, Alonso,
They have bereft; and do pronounce by me:
Lingering perdition, worse than any death
Can be at once, shall step by step attend
You and your ways; whose wraths to guard you from--
Which here, in this most desolate isle, else falls
Upon your heads--is nothing but heart-sorrow
And a clear life ensuing.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: He vanishes in thunder; then, to soft music enter the Shapes again, and dance, with mocks and mows, and carrying out the table

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Bravely the figure of this harpy hast thou
Perform'd, my Ariel; a grace it had, devouring:
Of my instruction hast thou nothing bated
In what thou hadst to say: so, with good life
And observation strange, my meaner ministers
Their several kinds have done. My high charms work
And these mine enemies are all knit up
In their distractions; they now are in my power;
And in these fits I leave them, while I visit
Young Ferdinand, whom they suppose is drown'd,
And his and mine loved darling.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: I' the name of something holy, sir, why stand you
In this strange stare?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: O, it is monstrous, monstrous:
Methought the billows spoke and told me of it;
The winds did sing it to me, and the thunder,
That deep and dreadful organ-pipe, pronounced
The name of Prosper: it did bass my trespass.
Therefore my son i' the ooze is bedded, and
I'll seek him deeper than e'er plummet sounded
And with him there lie mudded.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: But one fiend at a time,
I'll fight their legions o'er.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ANTONIO
SPEECH.LINE: I'll be thy second.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: All three of them are desperate: their great guilt,
Like poison given to work a great time after,
Now 'gins to bite the spirits. I do beseech you
That are of suppler joints, follow them swiftly
And hinder them from what this ecstasy
May now provoke them to.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ADRIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Follow, I pray you.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE I. Before PROSPERO'S cell.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: If I have too austerely punish'd you,
Your compensation makes amends, for I
Have given you here a third of mine own life,
Or that for which I live; who once again
I tender to thy hand: all thy vexations
Were but my trials of thy love and thou
Hast strangely stood the test here, afore Heaven,
I ratify this my rich gift. O Ferdinand,
Do not smile at me that I boast her off,
For thou shalt find she will outstrip all praise
And make it halt behind her.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: I do believe it
Against an oracle.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Then, as my gift and thine own acquisition
Worthily purchased take my daughter: but
If thou dost break her virgin-knot before
All sanctimonious ceremonies may
With full and holy rite be minister'd,
No sweet aspersion shall the heavens let fall
To make this contract grow: but barren hate,
Sour-eyed disdain and discord shall bestrew
The union of your bed with weeds so loathly
That you shall hate it both: therefore take heed,
As Hymen's lamps shall light you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: As I hope
For quiet days, fair issue and long life,
With such love as 'tis now, the murkiest den,
The most opportune place, the strong'st suggestion.
Our worser genius can, shall never melt
Mine honour into lust, to take away
The edge of that day's celebration
When I shall think: or Phoebus' steeds are founder'd,
Or Night kept chain'd below.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Fairly spoke.
Sit then and talk with her; she is thine own.
What, Ariel! my industrious servant, Ariel!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: What would my potent master? here I am.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Thou and thy meaner fellows your last service
Did worthily perform; and I must use you
In such another trick. Go bring the rabble,
O'er whom I give thee power, here to this place:
Incite them to quick motion; for I must
Bestow upon the eyes of this young couple
Some vanity of mine art: it is my promise,
And they expect it from me.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: Presently?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, with a twink.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: Before you can say 'come' and 'go,'
And breathe twice and cry 'so, so,'
Each one, tripping on his toe,
Will be here with mop and mow.
Do you love me, master? no?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Dearly my delicate Ariel. Do not approach
Till thou dost hear me call.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: Well, I conceive.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Look thou be true; do not give dalliance
Too much the rein: the strongest oaths are straw
To the fire i' the blood: be more abstemious,
Or else, good night your vow!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: I warrant you sir;
The white cold virgin snow upon my heart
Abates the ardour of my liver.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Well.
Now come, my Ariel! bring a corollary,
Rather than want a spirit: appear and pertly!
No tongue! all eyes! be silent.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IRIS
SPEECH.LINE: Ceres, most bounteous lady, thy rich leas
Of wheat, rye, barley, vetches, oats and pease;
Thy turfy mountains, where live nibbling sheep,
And flat meads thatch'd with stover, them to keep;
Thy banks with pioned and twilled brims,
Which spongy April at thy hest betrims,
To make cold nymphs chaste crowns; and thy broom -groves,
Whose shadow the dismissed bachelor loves,
Being lass-lorn: thy pole-clipt vineyard;
And thy sea-marge, sterile and rocky-hard,
Where thou thyself dost air;--the queen o' the sky,
Whose watery arch and messenger am I,
Bids thee leave these, and with her sovereign grace,
Here on this grass-plot, in this very place,
To come and sport: her peacocks fly amain:
Approach, rich Ceres, her to entertain.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CERES
SPEECH.LINE: Hail, many-colour'd messenger, that ne'er
Dost disobey the wife of Jupiter;
Who with thy saffron wings upon my flowers
Diffusest honey-drops, refreshing showers,
And with each end of thy blue bow dost crown
My bosky acres and my unshrubb'd down,
Rich scarf to my proud earth; why hath thy queen
Summon'd me hither, to this short-grass'd green?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IRIS
SPEECH.LINE: A contract of true love to celebrate;
And some donation freely to estate
On the blest lovers.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CERES
SPEECH.LINE: Tell me, heavenly bow,
If Venus or her son, as thou dost know,
Do now attend the queen? Since they did plot
The means that dusky Dis my daughter got,
Her and her blind boy's scandal'd company
I have forsworn.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IRIS
SPEECH.LINE: Of her society
Be not afraid: I met her deity
Cutting the clouds towards Paphos and her son
Dove-drawn with her. Here thought they to have done
Some wanton charm upon this man and maid,
Whose vows are, that no bed-right shall be paid
Till Hymen's torch be lighted: but vain;
Mars's hot minion is returned again;
Her waspish-headed son has broke his arrows,
Swears he will shoot no more but play with sparrows
And be a boy right out.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CERES
SPEECH.LINE: High'st queen of state,
Great Juno, comes; I know her by her gait.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: JUNO
SPEECH.LINE: How does my bounteous sister? Go with me
To bless this twain, that they may prosperous be
And honour'd in their issue.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: JUNO
SPEECH.LINE: Honour, riches, marriage-blessing,
Long continuance, and increasing,
Hourly joys be still upon you!
Juno sings her blessings upon you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CERES
SPEECH.LINE: Earth's increase, foison plenty,
Barns and garners never empty,
Vines and clustering bunches growing,
Plants with goodly burthen bowing;
Spring come to you at the farthest
In the very end of harvest!
Scarcity and want shall shun you;
Ceres' blessing so is on you.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: This is a most majestic vision, and
Harmoniously charmingly. May I be bold
To think these spirits?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Spirits, which by mine art
I have from their confines call'd to enact
My present fancies.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: Let me live here ever;
So rare a wonder'd father and a wife
Makes this place Paradise.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Juno and Ceres whisper, and send Iris on employment

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Sweet, now, silence!
Juno and Ceres whisper seriously;
There's something else to do: hush, and be mute,
Or else our spell is marr'd.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: IRIS
SPEECH.LINE: You nymphs, call'd Naiads, of the windring brooks,
With your sedged crowns and ever-harmless looks,
Leave your crisp channels and on this green land
Answer your summons; Juno does command:
Come, temperate nymphs, and help to celebrate
A contract of true love; be not too late.
You sunburnt sicklemen, of August weary,
Come hither from the furrow and be merry:
Make holiday; your rye-straw hats put on
And these fresh nymphs encounter every one
In country footing.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter certain Reapers, properly habited: they join with the Nymphs in a graceful dance; towards the end whereof PROSPERO starts suddenly, and speaks; after which, to a strange, hollow, and confused noise, they heavily vanish

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Aside I had forgot that foul conspiracy
Of the beast Caliban and his confederates
Against my life: the minute of their plot
Is almost come.
Well done! avoid; no more!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
SPEECH.LINE: This is strange: your father's in some passion
That works him strongly.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: Never till this day
Saw I him touch'd with anger so distemper'd.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: You do look, my son, in a moved sort,
As if you were dismay'd: be cheerful, sir.
Our revels now are ended. These our actors,
As I foretold you, were all spirits and
Are melted into air, into thin air:
And, like the baseless fabric of this vision,
The cloud-capp'd towers, the gorgeous palaces,
The solemn temples, the great globe itself,
Ye all which it inherit, shall dissolve
And, like this insubstantial pageant faded,
Leave not a rack behind. We are such stuff
As dreams are made on, and our little life
Is rounded with a sleep. Sir, I am vex'd;
Bear with my weakness; my, brain is troubled:
Be not disturb'd with my infirmity:
If you be pleased, retire into my cell
And there repose: a turn or two I'll walk,
To still my beating mind.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: FERDINAND
MIRANDA
SPEECH.LINE: We wish your peace.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Come with a thought I thank thee, Ariel: come.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: Thy thoughts I cleave to. What's thy pleasure?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Spirit,
We must prepare to meet with Caliban.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, my commander: when I presented Ceres,
I thought to have told thee of it, but I fear'd
Lest I might anger thee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Say again, where didst thou leave these varlets?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: I told you, sir, they were red-hot with drinking;
So fun of valour that they smote the air
For breathing in their faces; beat the ground
For kissing of their feet; yet always bending
Towards their project. Then I beat my tabour;
At which, like unback'd colts, they prick'd
their ears,
Advanced their eyelids, lifted up their noses
As they smelt music: so I charm'd their ears
That calf-like they my lowing follow'd through
Tooth'd briers, sharp furzes, pricking goss and thorns,
Which entered their frail shins: at last I left them
I' the filthy-mantled pool beyond your cell,
There dancing up to the chins, that the foul lake
O'erstunk their feet.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: This was well done, my bird.
Thy shape invisible retain thou still:
The trumpery in my house, go bring it hither,
For stale to catch these thieves.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: I go, I go.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: A devil, a born devil, on whose nature
Nurture can never stick; on whom my pains,
Humanely taken, all, all lost, quite lost;
And as with age his body uglier grows,
So his mind cankers. I will plague them all,
Even to roaring.
SPEECH.STAGEDIR: Re-enter ARIEL, loaden with glistering apparel, &c
SPEECH.LINE: Come, hang them on this line.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: PROSPERO and ARIEL remain invisible. Enter CALIBAN, STEPHANO, and TRINCULO, all wet

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Pray you, tread softly, that the blind mole may not
Hear a foot fall: we now are near his cell.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Monster, your fairy, which you say is
a harmless fairy, has done little better than
played the Jack with us.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Monster, I do smell all horse-piss; at
which my nose is in great indignation.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: So is mine. Do you hear, monster? If I should take
a displeasure against you, look you,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Thou wert but a lost monster.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Good my lord, give me thy favour still.
Be patient, for the prize I'll bring thee to
Shall hoodwink this mischance: therefore speak softly.
All's hush'd as midnight yet.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, but to lose our bottles in the pool,--

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: There is not only disgrace and dishonour in that,
monster, but an infinite loss.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: That's more to me than my wetting: yet this is your
harmless fairy, monster.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: I will fetch off my bottle, though I be o'er ears
for my labour.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Prithee, my king, be quiet. Seest thou here,
This is the mouth o' the cell: no noise, and enter.
Do that good mischief which may make this island
Thine own for ever, and I, thy Caliban,
For aye thy foot-licker.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Give me thy hand. I do begin to have bloody thoughts.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: O king Stephano! O peer! O worthy Stephano! look
what a wardrobe here is for thee!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: Let it alone, thou fool; it is but trash.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: O, ho, monster! we know what belongs to a frippery.
O king Stephano!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Put off that gown, Trinculo; by this hand, I'll have
that gown.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Thy grace shall have it.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: The dropsy drown this fool I what do you mean
To dote thus on such luggage? Let's alone
And do the murder first: if he awake,
From toe to crown he'll fill our skins with pinches,
Make us strange stuff.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Be you quiet, monster. Mistress line,
is not this my jerkin? Now is the jerkin under
the line: now, jerkin, you are like to lose your
hair and prove a bald jerkin.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Do, do: we steal by line and level, an't like your grace.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: I thank thee for that jest; here's a garment for't:
wit shall not go unrewarded while I am king of this
country. 'Steal by line and level' is an excellent
pass of pate; there's another garment for't.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: Monster, come, put some lime upon your fingers, and
away with the rest.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: CALIBAN
SPEECH.LINE: I will have none on't: we shall lose our time,
And all be turn'd to barnacles, or to apes
With foreheads villanous low.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Monster, lay-to your fingers: help to bear this
away where my hogshead of wine is, or I'll turn you
out of my kingdom: go to, carry this.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: TRINCULO
SPEECH.LINE: And this.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: STEPHANO
SPEECH.LINE: Ay, and this.

SCENE.STAGEDIR: A noise of hunters heard. Enter divers Spirits, in shape of dogs and hounds, and hunt them about, PROSPERO and ARIEL setting them on

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Hey, Mountain, hey!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: Silver I there it goes, Silver!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Fury, Fury! there, Tyrant, there! hark! hark!
SPEECH.STAGEDIR: CALIBAN, STEPHANO, and TRINCULO, are driven out
SPEECH.LINE: Go charge my goblins that they grind their joints
With dry convulsions, shorten up their sinews
With aged cramps, and more pinch-spotted make them
Than pard or cat o' mountain.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: Hark, they roar!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Let them be hunted soundly. At this hour
Lie at my mercy all mine enemies:
Shortly shall all my labours end, and thou
Shalt have the air at freedom: for a little
Follow, and do me service.

SCENE.TITLE: SCENE I. Before PROSPERO'S cell.
SCENE.STAGEDIR: Enter PROSPERO in his magic robes, and ARIEL

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Now does my project gather to a head:
My charms crack not; my spirits obey; and time
Goes upright with his carriage. How's the day?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: On the sixth hour; at which time, my lord,
You said our work should cease.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: I did say so,
When first I raised the tempest. Say, my spirit,
How fares the king and's followers?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: Confined together
In the same fashion as you gave in charge,
Just as you left them; all prisoners, sir,
In the line-grove which weather-fends your cell;
They cannot budge till your release. The king,
His brother and yours, abide all three distracted
And the remainder mourning over them,
Brimful of sorrow and dismay; but chiefly
Him that you term'd, sir, 'The good old lord Gonzalo;'
His tears run down his beard, like winter's drops
From eaves of reeds. Your charm so strongly works 'em
That if you now beheld them, your affections
Would become tender.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Dost thou think so, spirit?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: Mine would, sir, were I human.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: And mine shall.
Hast thou, which art but air, a touch, a feeling
Of their afflictions, and shall not myself,
One of their kind, that relish all as sharply,
Passion as they, be kindlier moved than thou art?
Though with their high wrongs I am struck to the quick,
Yet with my nobler reason 'gaitist my fury
Do I take part: the rarer action is
In virtue than in vengeance: they being penitent,
The sole drift of my purpose doth extend
Not a frown further. Go release them, Ariel:
My charms I'll break, their senses I'll restore,
And they shall be themselves.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: I'll fetch them, sir.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Ye elves of hills, brooks, standing lakes and groves,
And ye that on the sands with printless foot
Do chase the ebbing Neptune and do fly him
When he comes back; you demi-puppets that
By moonshine do the green sour ringlets make,
Whereof the ewe not bites, and you whose pastime
Is to make midnight mushrooms, that rejoice
To hear the solemn curfew; by whose aid,
Weak masters though ye be, I have bedimm'd
The noontide sun, call'd forth the mutinous winds,
And 'twixt the green sea and the azured vault
Set roaring war: to the dread rattling thunder
Have I given fire and rifted Jove's stout oak
With his own bolt; the strong-based promontory
Have I made shake and by the spurs pluck'd up
The pine and cedar: graves at my command
Have waked their sleepers, oped, and let 'em forth
By my so potent art. But this rough magic
I here abjure, and, when I have required
Some heavenly music, which even now I do,
To work mine end upon their senses that
This airy charm is for, I'll break my staff,
Bury it certain fathoms in the earth,
And deeper than did ever plummet sound
I'll drown my book.
SPEECH.STAGEDIR: Re-enter ARIEL before: then ALONSO, with a frantic gesture, attended by GONZALO; SEBASTIAN and ANTONIO in like manner, attended by ADRIAN and FRANCISCO they all enter the circle which PROSPERO had made, and there stand charmed; which PROSPERO observing, speaks:
SPEECH.LINE: A solemn air and the best comforter
To an unsettled fancy cure thy brains,
Now useless, boil'd within thy skull! There stand,
For you are spell-stopp'd.
Holy Gonzalo, honourable man,
Mine eyes, even sociable to the show of thine,
Fall fellowly drops. The charm dissolves apace,
And as the morning steals upon the night,
Melting the darkness, so their rising senses
Begin to chase the ignorant fumes that mantle
Their clearer reason. O good Gonzalo,
My true preserver, and a loyal sir
To him you follow'st! I will pay thy graces
Home both in word and deed. Most cruelly
Didst thou, Alonso, use me and my daughter:
Thy brother was a furtherer in the act.
Thou art pinch'd fort now, Sebastian. Flesh and blood,
You, brother mine, that entertain'd ambition,
Expell'd remorse and nature; who, with Sebastian,
Whose inward pinches therefore are most strong,
Would here have kill'd your king; I do forgive thee,
Unnatural though thou art. Their understanding
Begins to swell, and the approaching tide
Will shortly fill the reasonable shore
That now lies foul and muddy. Not one of them
That yet looks on me, or would know me Ariel,
Fetch me the hat and rapier in my cell:
I will discase me, and myself present
As I was sometime Milan: quickly, spirit;
Thou shalt ere long be free.
SPEECH.STAGEDIR: ARIEL sings and helps to attire him
SPEECH.LINE: Where the bee sucks. there suck I:
In a cowslip's bell I lie;
There I couch when owls do cry.
On the bat's back I do fly
After summer merrily.
Merrily, merrily shall I live now
Under the blossom that hangs on the bough.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Why, that's my dainty Ariel! I shall miss thee:
But yet thou shalt have freedom: so, so, so.
To the king's ship, invisible as thou art:
There shalt thou find the mariners asleep
Under the hatches; the master and the boatswain
Being awake, enforce them to this place,
And presently, I prithee.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ARIEL
SPEECH.LINE: I drink the air before me, and return
Or ere your pulse twice beat.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: All torment, trouble, wonder and amazement
Inhabits here: some heavenly power guide us
Out of this fearful country!

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: Behold, sir king,
The wronged Duke of Milan, Prospero:
For more assurance that a living prince
Does now speak to thee, I embrace thy body;
And to thee and thy company I bid
A hearty welcome.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: ALONSO
SPEECH.LINE: Whether thou best he or no,
Or some enchanted trifle to abuse me,
As late I have been, I not know: thy pulse
Beats as of flesh and blood; and, since I saw thee,
The affliction of my mind amends, with which,
I fear, a madness held me: this must crave,
An if this be at all, a most strange story.
Thy dukedom I resign and do entreat
Thou pardon me my wrongs. But how should Prospero
Be living and be here?

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: First, noble friend,
Let me embrace thine age, whose honour cannot
Be measured or confined.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: GONZALO
SPEECH.LINE: Whether this be
Or be not, I'll not swear.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: You do yet taste
Some subtilties o' the isle, that will not let you
Believe things certain. Welcome, my friends all!
But you, my brace of lords, were I so minded,
I here could pluck his highness' frown upon you
And justify you traitors: at this time
I will tell no tales.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: SEBASTIAN
SPEECH.LINE: Aside The devil speaks in him.

SPEECH.SPEAKER: PROSPERO
SPEECH.LINE: No.
For you, most wicked sir, whom to call brother
Would even infect my mouth, I do forgive
Thy rankest fault; all of them; and require
